[77b5fe]Anti-Matter Generator[-]
This generator produces anti-matter. Upgrade your generator to produce larger quantities of anti-matter.

[77b5fe]Collecting Antimatter[-]
Produced anti-matter can be collected by tapping the Icon or the tapping the "Collect" button.
Anti-Matter is the primary material used to build or upgrade Lab machines.

[77b5fe]Warp Device[-]
Send your characters to train in different dimensions using the Warp Device.

[77b5fe]Mission Procedure[-]
To continue with the mission, you must first select the mission and the character you would like to train.

[77b5fe]Missions[-]
The character's level affects the result of a mission.

[77b5fe]Mission Run[-]
Each mission runs for a certain period of time. Consuming crystals allows you to instantly finish certain missions.

[77b5fe]Mission Result[-]
Missions can result in: "Failed," or “Clear.” You earn nothing for failing a mission, however getting Clear on each mission unlocks great rewards. Don’t forget, characters that cannot acquire XP are unable to receive XP!

[77b5fe]Recommended Characters[-]
You can acquire extra rewards by completing missions with recommended characters, depending on the number of recommended heroes used.

[77b5fe]Dimension Token[-]
Dimension Tokens can be acquired by completing Warp Device Missions. Use them in the Item Shop or to update the Item List.

[77b5fe]Processor[-]
A machine that processes designated materials and produces desired goods.

[77b5fe]Products[-]
Tap the item you’d like to produce. You can produce as many as you would like.
Upgrading the machine will give access to a larger variety of products.

[77b5fe]Super Success[-]
A super success means that more than the expected number of products were produced or that a better version of it was produced.
Upgrade your Processor to increase the chances of a Super Success.

[77b5fe]Item Shop[-]
Access the Item Shop from the S.H.I.E.L.D. Lab. to purchase rare items with Anti-Matter and other resources.

[77b5fe]Items[-]
The Item Shop consists of Normal Shop items and Mission Shop items. Mission Shop items have a chance to be unlocked when Normal Shop items are purchased.

[77b5fe]Item List[-]
The list of items in the shop is periodically updated.
Note, purchasing all items on the list will not automatically update the item list.

[77b5fe]Instant Updating for Item List[-]
Dimension Tokens can be used to instantly update the List with new items.

[FFA500]Story[-] is a game mode where you can experience the main story of the game.
There are two difficulty levels for Story mode: Normal and Ultimate.

[90FF00]Normal[-] difficulty is suitable for all players, including beginners. You can use any character you own.
[FF0000]Ultimate[-] difficulty is for seasoned players. You must use Tier-3 or Potential Transcended characters Lv. 70 or higher.

You can obtain various items such as [7599ca][url=30_1004028][u]Story Fragments[/u][/url][-], as well as upgrade materials such as [7599ca][url=30_1004001][u]Biometrics[/u][/url][-], [7599ca][url=30_1004003][u]Norn Stones[/u][/url][-], and [7599ca][url=30_1004023][u]Type Enhancement Kits[/u][/url][-].
[FFFFFF]Gather Story Fragments to craft chests containing special items.[-]

Use various characters and enjoy the new themes.

In Special Missions, you will get [7599ca][url=30_1004001][u]Biometrics[/u][/url][-] and [7599ca][url=30_1004009][u]Custom Gear[/u][/url][-] based on the theme and characters you use, and [90FF00]plenty of experience[-].

If you play a stage marked with a [90FF00]Hidden Route[-] symbol, it is likely that you will discover a Hidden Route. By using a Hidden Route to clear a Stage, you will get additional rewards.

 [F12F66]*Quest Pack[-]: You can select a Quest Pack in Special Missions.

[FFFF00]Select desired difficulty[-] to start the battle. More rewards are available at a higher difficulty.

[90FF00]Support Tokens[-] can be acquired in Dimension Mission. A variety of items can be purchased with Support Tokens in the Support Shop.

[ffa500]Villain Siege[-] is where you can fight against a powerful enemy in a 1:1 match.\n\nIn Villain Siege, you can collect [90FF00]Chaos Tokens[-]. Chaos Tokens can be used in the Chaos Shop to purchase Character Biometrics and other various rewards.

Fight against powerful bosses in [ffa500]World Boss[-].
Create your own unique team of characters and fight against beings from across the galaxy with the help of your allies.

World Boss difficulty is divided into 6 different modes.
[90FF00]World Boss: Beginner[-] is best for players who don't have much experience against World Bosses.

[ff0000]World Boss: Legend[-] is for advanced players who have strengthened their characters to Tier-3, Transcend Potential or higher.
[C879F5]World Boss: Legend+[-] is for advanced players who have strengthened their characters to Tier-4 or higher.
[DD009F]World Boss: Mythic[-] is recommended for elite players who have advanced their Heroes to Tier-4 or higher and have mastered World Boss: Legend+.

In [ffa500]Timeline Battle[-], you form teams of 3 and challenge other players.
You will be ranked depending on the points you earn, and can be either promoted or demoted.

In Timeline Battle, you can collect [90FF00]Glory Tokens[-]. Glory Tokens can be used in the Timeline Shop to purchase Character Biometrics and other various rewards.

[ffa500]Co-op Play[-] is where you can team up with other players to fight against powerful Villains.
 3 players team up and use characters which must be 4★, level 40.

In Co-op Play, you can collect [90FF00]Gold and Gear Upgrade Materials[-]. You can get more rewards if you have a higher VIP LV.

[FFA500]Team-Up Collection[-] is content where your aim is to increase character stats corresponding to a specific theme.

Team-Up Options are unlocked by completing challenges related to [FFFF00]character growth and uniform upgrade[-]. You can select and apply your picks from the unlocked team-up options.

[90FF00]Team-up options[-] can be leveled up using Gold, and [FFFF00]Collection Tokens[-] can be acquired as rewards at specific levels.

You can enhance [90FF00]Collection Options[-] with the Collection Tokens you've acquired, and enhancing a collection option will [FFFF00]increase character stats[-] corresponding to the specific theme.

[ffa500]Alliance Battle[-] is a mode where you can compete against other Alliances with Stage Clear Points.
Only players who are in an Alliance can participate.

Alliance Battle consists of Boss Battles and Relay Battles
When Boss Battle is unlocked, [90FF00]Normal[-], [1067FF]Extreme[-], and [FF0000]Legend[-] difficulties are made available in that order.
When Relay Battle unlocks, [DD009F]Infinite Challenge[-] mode becomes available.

[1067FF]Extreme[-] mode unlocks when [90FF00]Normal[-] mode is cleared.
[FF0000]Legend[-] mode unlocks when you clear [1067FF]Extreme[-] mode with 1,000,000 points or higher.

When you clear [1067FF]Extreme[-], [FF0000]Legend[-], and [DD009F]Infinite Challenge[-] modes, [FFFF00]Challenge[-] mode becomes available.
[FFFFFF]*You can obtain a reward by reaching a certain score, and you can also set high scores.[-]

Alliance Battle's mode and the day of the week decide the characters who can participate.
The daily requirements may ask for a certain character type, faction, race, or gender. Only the characters that meet the requirements of the day can participate.
[FFFFFF]*Characters who achieved the highest record in each mode are not allowed to participate in different modes.[-]

[90FF00]Score rewards[-] and [90FF00]Weekly Rank rewards[-] are available in Alliance Battle.

[90FF00]Score rewards[-] are granted based on the score achieved in each mode.
The rewards can be Gold, [7599ca][url=30_1004003][u]Norn Stones[/u][/url][-], [7599ca][url=30_1004001][u]Biometrics[/u][/url][-], which are used in character growth, [7599ca][url=30_1004027][u]Mandalay Gem Fragments,[/u][/url][-] and [7599ca][url=30_1004026][u]Awakening Crystals[/u][/url][-], which are required to awaken or transcend potential.

[90FF00]Weekly Rank rewards[-] are granted based on the rank, calculated by the total sum of points earned by Alliance members.
The Alliance member who achieves the highest record in the rank 1 Alliance receives the [FFFF00]MVP reward[-].

[ffa500]Dimension Rift[-] is a special mode where you can play with your friends or your fellow alliance members.
Enter and search for a Dimension Rift. This will create a temporary Dimension Rift that you can select. Once opened, you will be able to play in the stage. Dimension Rifts will close after a period of time.
If a Dimension Rift is opened, your friends and fellow alliance members can enter it.

You can acquire [7599ca][url=30_1004005][u]Dimension Debris[/u][/url][-] and [7599ca][url=30_1004008][u]Comic Cards[/u][/url][-] in the Dimension Rift.

[F12F66]Tip:[-] Dimension Rifts vary in type. Use Auto Search to find your favorite Dimension Rift more easily.

[ffa500]Guard Break[-] is a skill that cancels out an enemy’s skills.
[ffa500]Super Guard Break[-] ignores Guard Break Immunity and cancels the opponent's skill.

[F12F66]Tip:[-] When the enemy uses a Skill, try using a Skill that has the Guard Break ability. This will not only block the opponent's skill but will also give you the opportunity to perform a counter attack.
Dodge depends on the level difference between the character and the Opponent.\n[ffa500]Guaranteed Dodge Rate[-] ignores these differences and dodges at a set rate no matter what.

Critical Rate depends on the level difference between the character and the Opponent.\n[ffa500]Guaranteed Critical Rate[-] ignores these differences and performs a critical at a set rate no matter what.

The damage a character receives is the difference of the opponent's Attack Strength, the Character's Defense, and the Character Type Resistance stat.\n[ffa500]PURE Damage[-] ignores these factors and causes the specified amount of damage.

[ffa500]Team Passive[-] is a passive effect that is shared with all team members even if a particular character is not designated as the Leader.\nThis includes skills that say [ffffff][Applies to: All Team members][-].
[ffa500]Invincible[-] refers to the fact the character is immune to basic attacks, [7599ca][url=30_1006001][u]Guard Breaks[/u][/url][-], Damages, and Debuffs.\n

[ffa500]Super Armor[-] refers to the fact that the character is immune to basic attack motions and [7599ca][url=30_1006001][u]Guard Breaks[/u][/url][-]. The character's moves cannot be canceled out, but they will receive damage.
[ffa500]Barrier[-] is an effect that prevents damage for a set amount of time. The Character does not take Damage but cannot stop the [7599ca][url=30_1006001][u]Guard Break[/u][/url][-] effect.

[ffa500]Shield[-] is an effect that stops damage for a set amount of time. The Character does not receive damage but cannot stop basic attack motions, [7599ca][url=30_1006001][u]Guard Break[/u][/url][-], and Debuffs. There are different types of shields such as a shield that can block all types of damage, a shield that can block only physical damage, and a shield that can block only energy damage.

[ffa500]Damage Immunity[-] is an effect that can stop damage and debuffs for a set amount of time. It can block Damage and Debuffs but cannot stop basic attack motions, [7599ca][url=30_1006001][u]Guard Breaks[/u][/url][-]. They are divided into Damage Immunity that stops all types of damage and debuffs, Physical Damage Immunity that stops all physical types of damage and debuffs, and Energy Damage Immunity that stops all energy types of damage and debuffs.

The [ffa500]Alliance Tournament[-] will determine the best Alliance in the Multiverse.
The [7599ca][url=30_1005009][u]Alliance Battle[/u][/url][-] is a scheduled competition among the Top 16 Alliances.

[FFFFFF]Cheer:[-] Players that are not included in the Tournament will be able to Cheer on an Alliance of their choosing. The Player will get Rewards depending on the final rank of the chosen Alliance. The Alliance will get more rewards if more people cheer them on.

As Daredevil grows increasingly violent, several Heroes must band together to stop the slaughter.\nIn Shadowland, Heroes must face and clear various battlefields to reach the top floor.

[ffa500]Epic Quests[-] follow the journeys of several different heroes.
As you play through the story-based quests, the protagonist character will get stronger.

When you begin an Epic Quest, [90FF00]you will receive the protagonist character[-].

In [ffa500]World Boss Invasion[-], players from different dimensions cooperate to defeat big bosses in real-time.
Up to 3 players can participate in a battle, and the [90FF00]Tier / Rank / Mastery / Level / Skill Level[-] will be matched to an accordingly.
The bosses change depending on the theme, and the themes will change periodically.

If the players win, they get [90FF00]Supply Chests[-]. The rank of the chest determines the time it takes to unlock.

[ffa500]Alliance Conquest[-] is a game mode where alliances compete against one another.
Three Alliances fight against one another and proceed in the following order.

[FFFFFF]1. SELECT REGION[-]
Once a Conquest begins, an Alliance can [90FF00]attack a region bordering their starting point[-].
Each region will be defended and must be cleared for it to be seized.
Once a region has been successfully seized, the Alliance will get Conquest Points.

[FFFFFF]2. BATTLE[-]
[90FF00]Select the Defending Troops to attack[-] a particular region.
Battles will proceed automatically. Once deployed, a character cannot be used again until the next reset.
Once a region is successfully seized, the characters used for the attack will be stationed there for defense.
Characters that are defending a region cannot be used to attack other regions.

[FFFFFF]3. PROTECTED REGIONS[-]

Once a region has been seized, it becomes a protected region.
Once a region is protected, it cannot be attacked or seized by another Alliance until the protection is removed.

[F12F66]Tip:[-] Once the protection is removed, regions can be taken by attacking. Alliances can earn additional conquest points according to the region's conquest duration.

[FFFFFF]4. BATTLE END[-]
Once a conquest has ended, ranks will be determined by the number of conquest points an Alliance has.
Rewards are determined by the rank of the Alliance.
[ffa500]Fear[-] puts enemies in fear for a duration of time, causing the affected target to run away from the character that cast Fear.\nCharacters affected by Fear cannot attack or use skills.
[ffa500]Snare[-] prevents enemies from moving for a short duration.\nBound targets will be unable to move to another location, attack or use skills.

[ffa500]Time Freezing[-] locks the target in time for a short duration, preventing any movement.
Characters caught in Time Freezing will not be able to move or attack.

[F12F66]Tip:[-] Time Freezing is able to trap epic monsters that have no debuffs but is not effective against targets who have skills that remove all debuffs.

[ffa500]Charm[-] will charm enemies for a short duration preventing them from attacking.
Charmed enemies are unable to move or use skills, even preventing automatically activated attacks from activating.

[F12F66]Tip:[-] Charm is able to trap epic monsters that have no debuffs but is not effective against targets who have skills that remove all debuffs.

In [ffa500]Legendary Battle[-], relive famous scenes inspired by the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
Players can enjoy battle scenes from the movies and play in familiar locations with specific characters.

Legendary Battles can only be played with specific characters that fit the theme, and they can be played whether or not you have recruited them.

Clear stages and get various rewards. However, players will acquire [90FF00]bonus rewards[-] depending on the [FFFF00]Growth Score[-] of the character they own.

[ffa500]Ignore Targeting[-] is a status where any targeted skills made by the enemy are ignored. No damage is taken even if attacked.\n\n[F12F66]Tip:[-] Time a Skill with Ignore Targeting when an enemy is attacking to ignore the enemy’s attack entirely and continue with your own attack.

[ffa500]Entice[-] charms enemies for a short duration, preventing them from attacking.
Enticed enemies are unable to move or use skills and slowly walks towards the character who has cast Entice.

[F12F66]Tip:[-] Entice is effective against World Bosses or enemies that don’t have debuffs, but is not effective against targets who have skills that remove all debuffs.

[ffa500]Mind Control[-] is an ability that turns enemies into allies.
Enemies under Mind Control receive additional damage.

[F12F66]Tip:[-] Mind Control is effective against World Bosses or enemies that don’t have debuffs, but is not effective against targets who have skills that remove all debuffs.

[ffa500]Recharge Shield[-]’s effect continuously recharges.\nIf the same type of Shield is gained, the effect is absorbed and Shield power increases. If another Shield type is gained, the Shield power does not increase and each of the separate effects are gained.\nFor example, gaining Physical Shield effects while the Physical Recharge Shield is active would mean that the effects are absorbed and the defensive power is increased. If another Energy Shield effect is gained, the separate effects would apply.

[ffa500]Fracture[-] decreases all Basic Attacks(stackable) for an enemy.
If a Fractured enemy recovers HP, then Fracture is removed, but the recovery effect is decreased.
Fracture cannot be removed by skills that removes all debuffs.

[F12F66]Tip:[-] If Fracture is stacked, then each stack is removed whenever HP is healed.
[ffa500]Incapacitation[-] decreases all DEF (stackable) after removing enemy’s all beneficial buffs.\nThis does not apply to targets with skills that removes all debuffs.

When hit by an enemy, [ffa500]Counterattack[-] activates instead of basic attack motions.\nBecause Counterattack can activate when attacked, it will not activate when [7599ca][url=30_1006006][u]Invincible[/u][/url][-] is in effect.

[ffa500]Elasticity[-] effect can be stacked with Physical Damage Decrease.\nElasticity will not be removed even when Cancel effect or [7599ca][url=30_1006020][u]Incapacitation[/u][/url][-] are applied, but will be removed with Bleed effect.

Ultron’s activities have been detected somewhere in Manhattan. His army is destroying the city, but this doesn’t seem to be their main purpose.
Ultron seems to have targeted Stark Tower. We have to break through his army's barrier and protect it.
The Ultron Army has seized Stark Tower. Among them we spotted the War Machine Suit. Is Ultron somehow controlling the armor?
The mass produced Ultrons look familiar, but Jocasta claims that there is something off about them. Find the real Ultron and reclaim Stark Tower.
The commander of the assault looks familiar. Get rid of remnants of Ultron and find out what’s really going on...
It looks like The Ultrons have left Stark Tower. There's no major damage, but the whereabouts of a scientist working at Stark Industry, Dr. Simmons, is unknown.
While tracking down the retreating Ultrons, we're attacked by yellow-suited enemies. Stop them, and save Dr. Simmons.
While Ultron and A.I.M carry out their full-scale attack, a familiar foe makes an appearance
The input location information from Ultron leads back to an unregistered facility. Check it out.
Dr. Simmons' vital signs are detected from inside the A.I.M. factory. Use Jocasta's intel to save her.
A.I.M. appears to be cooking up a scheme centered on Dr. Simmons' research project. Meanwhile, another villainous hero makes an appearance.
A.I.M. has already started to put their plans into effect with Dr. Simmons's stolen research. We have to stop them before they put the project into overdrive.
Neutralize the A.I.M. facility, the source of the Ultron clones and the incoming villainous heroes from other dimensions.
A.I.M. is raising the stakes and using our most trusted allies against us.
Infiltrate the A.I.M. facility and find the whereabouts of M.O.D.O.K.
M.O.D.O.K is nowhere to be found. Search a different A.I.M facility to find his whereabouts.
M.O.D.O.K.'s location is finally revealed. Now to figure out what he's up to.
S.H.I.E.L.D. agents are being attacked on the streets and they need backup.
The attacks were a diversion to steal a dimensional tracker. Track down the thieves and recover the goods.
We've tracked down the criminals who are using a weapon intensified by a rare energy source called ISO-8. The shadow standing behind them is...
Blade, aka Eric Brooks, has been spotted with the criminals. He must be from another dimension.
The Sinister Six is planning a large-scale attack with the help of criminals made stronger with ISO-8 enhanced weapons. We have to stop them before they can do any major damage.
A terror plot is unfolding and it looks as though multiple attacks were planned from the start. Get to the next site to prevent more damage.
The true objective of the attacks was to steal the particle accelerator in the midst of the chaos. Green Goblin snatched it and is trying to get away.
While the whereabouts of the particle accelerator are unknown, an Ultron Army arrives at the scene lead by, Sharon Carter, Captain America's lover.
The enemies have escaped. Even worse, the research lab developing the multidimensional guide sensor has been attacked.
Take over the seized research lab, and protect the device at all costs.
The Sinister Six's true leader, Dr. Octopus, makes an appearance. Take him down and find out his true objective.
Enemies are on the hunt for ISO-8 and their target is S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secret base.
The Hand is behind the attack, and they are working with A.I.M. transplants from other dimensions.
We received information that Kingpin's deranged assassin, Bullseye, is mixed up in this mess. Worse yet, it has been confirmed that he is collaborating with a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent.
Dr. Simmons predicts that, through the power of ISO-8, a large-scale dimension convergence would be possible. We have to stop The Hand from getting the ISO-8.
Could Iron Fist really be helping The Hand get to the ISO-8?
While the battle with The Hand's ninjas continue, Death's red shadow, Elektra joins the fray.
Out of the Dark, Into the Light
The united villains are moving too systematically. Stealing ISO-8 can't be the Kingpin's only goal. Also, Elektra's comments indicate that something else has to be going on.
Reports indicate that Kingpin's gang is assembling in Hell's Kitchen. We have to stop the situation from spiraling out of control.
The size of The Hand's army dwarfs that of any previous attack. Something massive is in play.
Kingpin finally steps out from the shadows. Is he finally showing his hand, or does he have more cards up his sleeve?
With the world already in chaos, the airborne carriers of A.I.M. unleash a large-scale invasion, including Heroes from alternate dimensions.
A.I.M. battleships are scattering around the world. We have to neutralize the one already heading towards Europe.
We have to neutralize another A.I.M. battleship heading towards South America.
We have to neutralize the A.I.M. battleship heading towards Russia.
We have to neutralize the A.I.M. battleship heading towards the Middle East.
We have to neutralize the A.I.M. battleship heading towards Asia.
A.I.M. Carriers have been grounded around the world, but another appears in the New York sky and begins a violent attack.
We have to stop the attack on downtown New York, and smoke out whoever’s behind it.
A villainous Spider-Man is on the move in New York! Stop him and put an end to this insanity.
Stop the Sinister Six, who are leading the missile attack over the skies of New York.
It's doubtful that HYDRA would sit out of this villainous alliance. Captain America suggests that we track down A.I.M. to smoke out HYDRA.
It appears that A.I.M. is working on additional research in their laboratory.
Track down M.O.D.O.K. to find out where HYDRA is hiding, and put an end to their schemes.
The last attack has paralyzed New York. We have to stop them from inflicting more damage.
HYDRA continues their attack. Keep the damage to a minimum and find the Red Skull.
Realizing that he was being tracked, the Red Skull used HYDRA's attack as a diversion to escape.
The attack has almost been quelled. Take care of the remnants and track down the Red Skull.
We were successful in tracking down HYDRA's main hideout. Infiltrate the hideout and put a stop to the Red Skull's plan.

[FF0000]ISO-8[-] can be enhanced up to +5.^If you combine [FED442]2 pieces of ISO-8 +5[-], you can get [FED442]higher ranked ISO-8[-].^ISO-8 [FED442]can be ranked up to a maximum 6 levels.[-]^ISO-8 of a higher rank is much stronger. Good job.^Through [FF0000]Enhance[-] and [FF0000]Combine[-], [FF0000]ISO-8[-] can be upgrades [90FF00]up to 6[-].^Each [FF0000]ISO-8[-] color has a different effect, so be sure to [90FF00]equip[-] [FF0000]ISO-8[-] that will maximize your Character's abilities.^Now try and [90FF00]equip[-] the combined [FF0000]ISO-8[-].

Mr. Stark? The dimension convergence is showing up strongly at that location.
[ani:speak]If M.O.D.O.K. is there, did he get the device working?
[ani:speak]That's what I thought, but... after analyzing the pattern, it doesn't seem like it.
Dig a little deeper. For the time being, we'll approach him.
Mr. Stark, I've analyzed the dimension convergence mentioned earlier, and there is a 'rift'.
Yes. A dimensional rift.^[ani:speak]A small rift between dimensions, caused by M.O.D.O.K. bringing people in from other dimensions.
[ani:speak]I get what you're saying.\nIs the rift connected to a dimension of someone who was brought over?

Well, it's difficult to give a definitive answer.^According to my analysis, it's connected to the alternate heroes from other dimensions M.O.D.O.K. is trying to enlist.^[ani:speak]We might be able to make contact with them before M.O.D.O.K. does through the same rift.
Hmmm. It's worth a shot. So, let's go and see what's up.
Well, what do we have here? There’s snow everywhere. Are we at the North Pole? Or maybe the South Pole?
I thought someone was peeking through the 'rift', was that you, Iron Man?
Loki? What on earth is going on?
Do you know nothing?^Welcome to my homeland, Mortal.
Loki, what are you up to?
I borrowed M.O.D.O.K.'s list for a bit.\nThe list of my future friends.^Also, I just invited my new friends to enjoy a small party at my house.^I trust you find nothing wrong with that.
Cut the funny stuff! Thor, probably told you not to hang around the wrong crowd.

Maybe you’re upset that you were not invited to the party. Calm yourselves.\nI have no interest in you.^Of course, after the throne of Asgard is mine, your world will be next.^Let us cut the greetings short.^The cuisine did get cold, but if that is acceptable, help yourselves.
Damn it. Maybe M.O.D.O.K. wasn't the only one interested in other dimensions.
[ani:speak]Right. It's getting hard to clean up the situation by ourselves.
[ani:speak]I will send this information to my dimensional counterparts.^One of us might be able to help.\nOr might be in need of help as well.
I'll report any additional dimensional rifts as I spot them.^I'll also work with Jocasta for any assistance you need, or can provide!
[ani:speak]Jemma, is it just me or does it look like you're having fun?
Your hero can now equip additional gear.^[ani:speak]This special gear will maximize abilities or defense.^Check out this special gear item found in a Dimension Rift.

Interestingly, we've found a <STARK> Logo on it.^However, based on our data, STARK has not built such an item.^It is possible that it was transferred from another dimension, an alternate Tony Stark creation.^ We may be able to find more Custom Gear in other Dimension Rifts.

[ani:speak]Jocasta, I just need to clarify one thing here--outside the whole parallel dimension thing.^Do I still get royalties if it's an alternate me that created these things? Seems only fair to me...

Wow... these machines, who built them? They’re no joke.^[ani:speak]Well... I figured I should do my part since I’ve been hanging out with you guys.^I guarantee you, this is going to be useful... once they're up and running of course.^I need a bit more time to perfect them though.^They're actually a bit old so I had to do a lot of analysis to figure out how to reactivate them.^I could use an extra pair of hands though.^Let's start with this Anti-Matter Generator!
Obviously, all I needed was more materials.^Thanks to you, we now have enough to repair this Anti-Matter Generator.^Let's fix it now!

[ani:speak]Tada! My job is done. What’cha think? Isn't it gorgeous?^Umm... act like you didn’t hear that. Huh!? Where did this bolt come from? Anti-Matter is one material you don't want to mess with. Sadly, it takes time to collect.^Anti-Matter is essential to charge many of the devices in this lab so make sure you collect it regularly.^[ani:speak]Well, before this one blows up, go start collecting some anti-matter. I've got more devices to work on!
[ani:speak]Wow! I did it! I fixed the Warp Device!^You'll need more Anti-Matter and other material to run the devices, so get me more! I mean... a lot more... please!
[ani:speak]There are probably other devices here that I can repair.^If I can get them running, I'm sure they'll be useful on our missions.^I better get back to work.

What? You’ve got questions about the Warp Device?^Simple, you can use it to warp to any dimension Jocasta has been able to scan.^[ani:speak]Even a small incident in another dimension could give us a clue on how to protect this world,^... so let's get warping and look for some clues.^Try it out now.

[ani:speak]Here, you can see the events of other dimensions scanned by our systems.^First, select a mission and dispatch a hero to the location. Simple, isn't it?^Also, to activate the Warp Device, you’ll need [90FF00]anti-matter[-], so make sure you have some on hand!
Running a mission takes time^However, you can tweak time in other dimensions by using crystals!^[ani:speak]Just a few crystals will assist you greatly on missions.

[ani:speak]Currently you can only warp to one scanned mission at a time.^What? You want to go on more?^Come on, give Jocasta a break!^Scanning other dimensions for warp coordinates consumes lots of energy.

And now, onto the true prize!^Thanks to you, Sentry, I can finally leave my Goblin days behind me.
The people will marvel as I soar to new heights in this superior, star-spangled suit of --^Scrap metal?!

Ah... that's more like it!^I always thought green was my color, but I'll admit, I can see the appeal of the old red, white, and blue!^But being a hero is about more than dressing the part, gentlemen.^We have to act like heroes as well.^We need to keep our more malicious tendencies in check. While you were away, Sentry, our new Spider-Man found himself struggling with his more sinister side.
We got hungry... and we said we were sorry.

It won't matter who we save if one of our members decides to devour them afterwards.^Fortunately, I recall Reed Richards developing a device capable of disrupting the symbiote's neural network, keeping it docile.^If it still exists, it's likely tucked away in his lab at the Baxter Building.^Wolverine, you have my permission to kill Gargan if he gets out of line again.
Sentry, while the boys play, I need you to go to the Baxter Building and find that device.^But do be careful. The Fantastic Four were very protective of their property...
Reed and I were friends. I can handle this.
The world changed while you were locked away. For your sake, I hope some things stayed the same...
[ani:speak]Reed Richards was one of the few men who truly understood me.^If he could see me now... I can't imagine what he'd have to say about how far I've fallen.
Intruder detected. Identity confirmed: The Sentry.^Threat level: Alpha. Activating security grid...
[ani:speak]Huh. Well, I guess that's my answer...^I know how hard Reed worked to build these defense systems.^Glad he's not here to see how easily I take them apart!

[ani:speak]All clear. Now, to access the mainframe and find the Symbiote Inhibitor.^I have no idea how Osborn got these security codes... and I'm not sure I want to find out...^What matters is that they worked. I've got full access to the Fantastic Four's archives.

With all of the world-bending technology Reed developed in this building...^...I'm just glad Osborn sent me instead of doing this himself.^I may be putting my faith in him, but that's not the same as trusting him.
Looks like the Symbiote Inhibitor is in Reed's old lab.^Should be easy to find, as long as I don't run into any other --

[ani:speak]The door to Reed's lab... It's been ripped clear off!^Those were Vibranium hinges. Whoever did this must have strength equal to my own!^I should have known we wouldn't be the only ones taking advantage of the FF's absence.
[ani:speak]Need to find out who did this and stop them before they accidentally open a portal to the Negative Zone...^...or worse.

Whoever you are, you're not authorized to be here.^The Fantastic Four may not be around to defend their headquarters...^...but they still have powerful friends.^Wait... Ms. Marvel? Is that really you?

[ani:speak]What a relief. I thought a villain was attempting to steal one of Reed's --^Umm... what are you doing with the Ultimate Nullifier...?

Oh, this? I was just... making sure it was safe and accounted for.^You never know who might try to use the heroes' disappearance for their own personal gain.^Which makes me wonder, handsome. What exactly brings you here?
A fair question. One I'd be glad to answer...^...if you put down the weapon of universal destruction and step outside.
I'm fairly certain neither one of us wants to find out.
Then who are you... and why are you wearing her old costume?
[ani:speak]Dr. Karla Sofen. But I used to go by the name Moonstone.
I remember you. You were one of the Masters of Evil!
I also have a Ph.D. in Psychology, but no one seems to focus on that fun fact...
If you were so smart, then why are you running with criminals?

[ani:speak]When the heroes disappeared, the world was devastated.^Most people saw it as a tragedy. Some of us saw it as an opportunity.^We raided the Avengers’ Mansion, took their spare costumes and weapons, remaking ourselves in their image.

At first, it seemed like the perfect plan: Inspiring the desperate populace while we secretly planned for total world domination.^But then, the strangest thing happened. Playing hero started to feel... good.^Not all of my colleagues have turned that corner, but I've been trying to steer them in the right direction without them knowing.
[ani:speak]So you really were returning that weapon?
[ani:speak]Believe it or not, I was. It's not the kind of thing I'd trust in the hands of villains. Even ones dressed like Avengers.
Seems like we have a lot in common.

Maybe so. But now, Mr. Golden Guardian of Good, you have to make a choice. You can punish me for the sins of my past...^...which I admit, I probably deserve...^...or you can take a leap of faith and trust that I'm working towards a brighter future.
[ani:speak]My fate is in your impressively large hands.^So... what's it going to be?
[ani:speak]I'll tell you what...^You help me find what I need, and maybe I can offer you a real chance at redemption.
I can't say I'm not intrigued at the notion...
I've found myself in unusual company since my --
[ani:speak]Recent escape from prison?^Oh, don't be surprised. I've read the files of everyone on the Raft.^I'm a super-powered psychologist, remember? I know all about you. And... him.
Well, I didn't get out alone. And the people I'm with...^It's not that I don't believe they're trying to change...
But having someone else to keep a trained eye on them wouldn't hurt.

I think I have my hands full already, big guy. But I can give you my card.^If any of your friends, even the one in your head, get out of line, you can give me a call.^Wouldn't mind spending an hour with you on my couch...
It's not me I'm worried about. Yet. It's Osborn and his --

Osborn? As in Norman Osborn? Leading a team of heroes?^Know what? I changed my mind. Just out of professional curiosity, I have to see this one for myself.^You've got yourself a date, big guy. You get me a ticket onto your team...^...and I'll bring the popcorn.
Now that we have the Symbiote Inhibitor, we probably should be going. But...
[ani:speak]You don't seem too eager to leave. What's on your mind?
[ani:speak]You read my file. You know that I've got a... how should I put this...
A genocidal alter ego who wants to snuff out all the light in the world?
And you don't have any of your serum left, do you? You poor thing.
[ani:speak]Reed was always one of the few who had the rare chemicals needed to synthesize more.^If I ever start to lose control again, I'd feel more comfortable having some on hand.
[ani:speak]I mean this in the must supportive way possible, but trust me when I say...^...you're not the only one.
That's the last ingredient for the Sentry Serum.
Then we should probably get a move on before --
[ani:speak]Wait. Did you hear that noise? Someone else is here!
About that...^Remember when I said I was working with some other villains who weren't quite as ready to turn over a new leaf?
You brought one of them here with you?
[ani:speak]Any chance he'd change his mind and join us?
Let's just say, as cases go, this is one I've never quite been able to crack.^But I guarantee that he'll be more than glad to try to crack you... wide open.
Then he's about to get his chance.

[ani:speak]Normally he never shuts his mouth. The only time he ever gets this quiet...^...is when he's getting ready to strike.^Stay on your guard. Even the most invulnerable hero has a weak spot...^...and I guarantee, he'll be able to find it.
What'd I say about bringing home more strays, Moonstone?
Not exactly. But you just barely missed the target.^Same precision accuracy, but with far more deadly effect.
And intent! Don't forget my deadly intent! That part's important!
[ani:speak]No. What's important is that you've got skills and the world needs heroes.^You've already got Hawkeye's arrows. Why not fly straight?

Where would be the fun in that? I got in this game for the murder and mayhem!^And no matter how many times the doc here tries to shrink my head on the sly...^...there's no changing who I am deep inside.
Remember how I said that you needed to work on identifying when to stand down, Bullseye?^This was one of those moments.
Come on, Sentry. He's no use to us.
We can't just leave him here. He's too dangerous. Even in this shape.
Heh. What're you gonna do? Lock me away?

Actually... I happen to know of some recent vacancies on the Raft...^With a record like yours, I'm sure they'd be glad to show you straight to my old cell. For life.^Of course, you could always take community service instead...
If you think I'd ever walk with the angels, you're crazier than I am!
Keep it up, Bullseye, and you'll be lucky if you can walk at all.
Y'know... I have been looking to mix things up lately...^Maybe a break from being bad would do me good after all.
And here I thought you weren't capable of making smart choices.^We learn something new every day...
What's that noise? Another stupid intruder alarm?
[ani:speak]No. This one's different. Something's gone wrong.

[ani:speak]Better hurry. More of that weird energy keeps pouring out of the machine...

[ani:speak]Now, all we need to do is activate it.

This is it. Exactly what I feared all those years I spent locked away in the Raft.^Osborn really had me convinced that this could be a new start. Again.^The Void may still be contained... for now... but whatever we released from the Baxter Building might be even more powerful.^Whatever it is, we have to stop it. We don't have any other choice.^It's time to prove who we really are... or at least who we want to be.^It's time to be heroes... or to die trying...

I thought you wanted us to act like heroes, Osborn.
You know who acted like heroes? The actual heroes. And where are they now?

Ooh, is baby Wolvie gonna pop his widdle claws?

A series of complex systems that have functioned in perfect unison for millennia...^...all so that some soccer mom on Long Island can get her morning latte on time.^As long as the Machine keeps running smoothly, no one ever seems to notice.^And for centuries upon end, we Eternals have been the ones at the controls.^We've devoted our extended lives to protecting the Machine that is Earth, rarely stepping from the shadows or seeking glory.^If you ask me, which you didn't, we've done a damn good job.^But no Machine is perfect. Everything has flaws. Even me. And flaws can be exploited...^...especially by those who have had unlimited time to plan...
Death is not a valid construct for Eternals.
And yet here I am, at the heart of the Machine, being reborn.
You will recall your... "death"... in time. But first...

And you know that it is my function to confirm them.
You have to make sure that I've still got it. Trust me... I do.
We will start with the transmutation of matter.
[ani:speak]Of course. Then, maybe once you're satisfied that I'm fully back...
...we can get on to what really matters, Machine.
[ani:worry]I usually remember all of my deaths, though. Why is this one so... foggy?
I am uncertain. Your memory backup was not corrupted.\nBut the data is not available to me either...
[ani:speak]Strange. Do you at least know where I was when I fell?
Babylon. The site of an ancient temple built to worship the Celestials.
Traces of cosmic energy were detected...
...and I went to make sure no one was tampering with forces beyond their control. Right.
[ani:worry]I remember entering the temple... but then everything went black.
[ani:speak]I must have been caught off guard. That rarely happens...
Machine, scan the site for any other activity.
[ani:speak]If someone there bested me, I don't even want to imagine what they could do with Celestial technology...
Multiple life forms detected. All Deviant in nature.
Deviants? I should have expected as much...
[ani:speak]Our blooms may be everlasting, but they are not without thorns...
One genetic signature matches that of the Deviant warlord designated Kro.
[ani:worry]He's crawled out from under his rock again?
Wonderful. What drew him out of the shadows this time?
I'd rather ask him in person...
Your cosmic energy levels are still replenishing, Sersi.
To travel such a distance would cause enormous strain, even at full capacity.
As you wish. Accessing the network.
The closest node to Babylon is Olympia. Will that suffice?
[ani:speak]Sure. I should be able to take it from there. Thanks.
All molecules reassembled, accounted for... and in perfect form, as always.
[ani:speak]But that... that is far from perfect.
Those cretins already killed me once today.
[ani:speak]I've had these hands for less than an hour, and they're already sullied. Typical.
But I've wasted enough time on these evolutionary dead-ends.
There's only one path I need to follow, and it leads to Kro.
[ani:angry]Then I suppose I should keep trying until it does.
That could take a while... Hope you didn't make other plans, Kro...
Oh, my dear, sweet Sersi... You have no idea...
He's gone... but Kro always returns sooner or later...
[ani:speak]The question is, why was he even here to begin with?
I believe I may have an answer.
That temple was built on the site of the Celestial experiment that created the Eternals... and the Deviants... millennia ago.
The knowledge recorded on its walls, if deciphered, offers instructions on how to recreate that process.
Then it's a good thing Deviants are barely smart enough read.
Unlike Eternals, Deviants can evolve. And Kro has had many years to study...
[ani:speak]And yet, also unlike Eternals, he has no cosmic power to speak of.

So... if Kro gathers the components to this ancient Celestial machine, he could... do what exactly?
Turn the Deviants into proper Eternals?
Or wipe out all of humanity. The chances are surprisingly even.

[ani:speak]But the balance of this world counts on their continued survival.
Kro must be stopped. And that's not something I can do alone, not this time...
Shall I alert the others then?
[ani:speak]It's been too long since I got the family back together...

Well... I certainly didn't plan for this...^Kro and his army of Deviant degenerates are searching for six ancient Celestial Components that could evolve everyone on Earth into an Eternal...^...or, more likely, melt their feeble genes into puddles of primordial ooze.^Either way, the results are less than stellar, and the strain on the Machine would be catastrophic.^I've alerted my fellow Eternals to the situation, and they've agreed to join the cause...^...but I've also made other allies over the centuries... and it might be time to call in some favors.
Six missing Celestial Components. Six Eternals willing to help me search for them.
But when the Deviants are involved, there are always unexpected variables.
Thankfully, we've saved all of humanity enough times over the centuries that they owe us the occasional hand.
I've always stepped up when this world needed me.
Let's hope they're willing to do the same...
At first glance, it might seem like the definition of overcompensation...

This is where Earth's Mightiest Heroes assemble.

[ani:speak]Well, I suppose I'm on my own against an army of Deviants.

[ani:speak]Then I guess we found the right place.
Let's hope A.I.M. cast extras who know how to take a punch...
It will not be long before A.I.M. realizes their security has been compromised.
If we want to find a way inside, we will need to move swiftly and quietly.
[ani:speak]Luckily, Ninja Mode is my default setting.
This corridor is lined with sensors. One wrong step could bring our journey to an end.
[ani:speak]Huh. Those were some solid moves. Ever consider taking your talents to the big screen?
I do not seek fortune or glory.
Suit yourself. More roles for me.
My only role is to restore balance and harmony.
Then it looks like you're about to get your chance to shine. A.I.M. is straight ahead.
Strike quickly. A.I.M. is not known for their prowess in combat.
But where they lack in fighting skills, they make up for with deadly weapons.
[ani:speak]There's no telling how much damage those things could do.
Then let's disarm them before they have the chance to show us...
I can deal with these so-called scientists.
If you seek more information on the weapons they've created, this would be the place to find it.
Time to learn what A.I.M. is really up to...
...and what it has to do with the missing Celestial Components.
Oh, no... That's worse than I thought...
[ani:speak]Somehow, A.I.M. has managed to unlock the Celestial technology's potential faster than any human mind should be able to.
These weapons were just a teaser for the main event.
To take back what they stole.
[ani:speak]Machine? There's a lab up ahead. I need you to crack the access codes. Now.
If you want to survive A.I.M.'s plans...
...we need to do whatever we can to bring this production to a halt!
How dare you enter this sacred temple of science uninvited?!
If you really cared about what's sacred...
...you never would have tampered with the Celestials' property.
Their ancient technology has the potential to raise A.I.M. to glorious new heights!
Thanks to them, our reign shall be eternal!
Hate to break it to you, but there's only one Eternal here...
[ani:speak]...and he's about to show you the downside of being mortal.
[ani:angry]We shall become your new gods through science!
I honestly didn't think your head could get any bigger than it already was.
Time to cut you back down to size.
An extra pair of fists wouldn't hurt.
Your pathetic attacks are futile against the sheer power of my mind!
Yet we fight on. And together, we shall prevail.
No! This was not part of the plan...
[ani:speak]That's because it was never your plan to make.
The technology you acquired belongs to the Celestials only.
I'm here to return it to its proper place.
[ani:laugh]Then you should have shown up sooner... and with more money.
Another interested party arrived shortly before you. They offered me a deal I couldn't refuse.
He got the component, I kept all the data... and enough riches to fund A.I.M.'s research for decades!
He called himself Kro. He offered no other information...
...and I deemed it wise not to inquire.
[ani:speak]Perhaps the only wise choice you've made...
I hate to cut and run...
[ani:speak]...but I need to join my family to find Kro and the Celestial Components...
I have already called in the Agents of Atlas.
They'll make sure that M.O.D.O.K. and A.I.M. are removed from these streets.
Indeed. Even so, I would prefer this to be an adventure that does not warrant a sequel...
You and me both. Speaking of which...
Hey, it's me. I might be late for tonight's shoot... Sorry...
I know. I promise I'll make it up to you tomorrow.
But first, I have to make sure there still is a tomorrow...

I've never much cared for gods, even when people have treated me like one.^The Eternals have always looked at humans as if they're mere playthings, placed on Earth for their passing amusement. Here and gone in the blink of an eye.^That's one of the reasons I cut myself off from my people. Why I became the "Forgotten One".^I'm one of the few who realize that "Protecting the Machine" means protecting all life, especially those without the luxury of being reborn again and again.^I tend to reserve my righteous fists for my fellow Eternals... and they usually deserve every blow.^But if Kro wants to try to play god, I'll make sure mine is a name he never forgets...
[ani:speak]Sersi knows better than to bother me unless there is an emergency on a global scale.
So when she calls, I answer.
She told me that Kro and his Deviants are looking to join our ranks as Eternals...
...as if there weren't more than enough of us already.
[ani:speak]To achieve his goal, Kro has his eyes on technology created by the Celestials themselves.
But without their ancient wisdom and guidance, evolution could run unchecked.
[ani:speak]Kro doesn't care. To him, mankind is nothing more than collateral damage.
Hmm. Maybe he'd make a good Eternal after all...
I'm sure the Eternals in Sersi's good graces got the easy assignments.
Of course, she sends me on a quest to Asgard.
[ani:speak]She knows how I feel about these so-called gods.
They revel in their own power, yet rarely hear the desperate prayers of those beneath them.
Perhaps it's time someone showed them what it's like to kneel and beg for mercy...
I have come to deliver a fitting tribute to your All-Father...
[ani:angry]Would you care to receive my blessing first?
[ani:speak]They certainly don't make gods like they used to...
But what you Asgardians lack in divine splendor, you more than make up for in sheer number.
[ani:angry]Come then! Send an entire pantheon of false deities if you must!
None can stop me from saving those you have forsaken!
Pillars of gold built on a foundation of lies.
[ani:speak]As much as I'd like to bring this monument to self-glorification crashing to the ground, I have other business here.
The Celestial Component Sersi sent me to locate is somewhere within this citadel.
I must find it... preferably before the weather changes...
You need not enter this palace as a foe.
You were once one of Earth's Mightiest. That is a sacred bond we share.
To Thor, you are like a brother.
[ani:speak]...Why have you pilfered Celestial technology that does not belong to you?
I thought you fancied yourself a god, not a thief.
Not yet. But I could be convinced...
I have saved Midgard from the cruel judgment of your beloved Celestials countless times.
What is an epic victory without a proper trophy to mark it?
I wouldn't know. I've never needed to steal something to remember my victories.
Perhaps that is why so many of yours have been long forgotten...
[ani:speak]Fair. But when I'm done with you, you'll wish you could forget me.
You have insulted Asgard this day.\nFor that brazen affront, you shall fall.
Maybe. But there's one good thing about being an Eternal.
No matter how hard you hit me with that hammer of yours...
[ani:speak]I'd be more than glad to trade blows for a few more centuries...
...but for once, we don't have that kind of time on our side.
Why did you not say this sooner? Who dares threaten Midgard?
Aye. I remember this Kro well.\nA despicable creature bent on raising his banished brethren to unearned glory.
Then stay thy hand, Gilgamesh.\nIf Kro threatens Midgard, we must call a truce and face his threat as one...
The Celestial item you seek is locked within the palace vault amongst our finest treasures...
I'm not sure which category this falls under quite yet.
Be thankful we will not have to learn.
There is no safer place in any of the realms for it to be kept, of this I can assure you!
The door to this vault is protected by an enchantment. It takes the Odinforce to unseal it...
...and my reserves are still replenishing after our earlier confrontation.
Stand aside, your mightiness. If your fancy door is locked...
[ani:speak]I got us past your vault's magical security system...
...but it looks like someone else beat me to the punch.
Loki? Why are you here within our father's vault? And how did you get inside? Speak, brother...
Well, you see, it's a funny thing, really...
This vault may have been sealed to all those who tried to open its door...
...but in actuality, Odin's enchantment was rather crude. Any good sorcerer could find a way around it.
And I happen to be much better than good.
I've come here to seek solitude since childhood.
I find being surrounded by objects of great cosmic power strangely comforting...
[ani:speak]Have you seen an item of Celestial origin here? A component for one of their machines?
I hate to say, but you weren't the only one searching for it.
I figured an object of such significance belonged in the hands of those who could benefit from it most.
I assume you agree, or else you wouldn't be here...
The same as I always have, Thor. And the same any god worthy of his name would do.
I have helped mortals in need...
Answer me! Where is the Celestial Component?
Long gone. Where exactly, I know not. You would have to ask my new friend...
I've met so many mortals over the eons, it's gotten hard to tell them apart...
Kroll? Krone? Kevin...? Something with a "K"...
He regaled me with his vision for a new Midgard. Quite ambitious.
That realm is long overdue for an upgrade. I do hope he succeeds...
[ani:angry]Even if he does, I'll make sure you never live to see it!
Unhand my brother. You have made our point.
You have no heart, Loki.\nIf you did, you would never have given Kro what he sought...
Loki has made a grave error this day, Eternal. That I cannot deny...
...But should you raise your fist to him once more, you will face my full fury in his stead.
And this time, our battle will not end in a draw.
[ani:angry]On that single point, thunderer, I agree.
I shall ready the Bifrost to return you to Midgard at once.
He will face justice for his transgressions.
He came here to seek solitude. Thus, he shall be given more than his share...
...as he spends the next century or so in the dungeons beneath this palace.
Now, go. The fate of billions rests upon your shoulders.

I may have been born an Eternal, but I have never truly belonged among them.^As my brethren celebrated their brutal victories against the Deviants, I could never take cheer.^If this endless cycle of war was to be broken, I knew it would not be by blade.^And so I came to Lemuria, to help the Deviants rather than hunt them. I lived -- and loved -- among them. And in doing so, I discovered the truth.^The Eternals' place in the Machine was determined ages ago. Our powers are as great as our lives are long, but they are constant. Unchanging.^The Deviants may be fleeting, but they have shown the potential for change. What they could become is fascinating to me...^...and, at moments like this, terrifying as well.^And so, the time has come once more to choose where my allegiance lies... and pray that I can live with the answer in the countless years to come...
[ani:speak]We Eternals have always acted as if we were the chosen ones...
...but we were not the Celestials' only creations.
When we were born a million years ago, the Deviants were born as well.
Two divergent species. Two grand experiments.
[ani:speak]Each one unique. Each one with its own benefits...
Where my brothers and sisters saw only the horrors of evolution gone wild...
...I saw the beauty beneath the surface.
But despite my efforts to prove them otherwise, some Deviants are content to remain as twisted within as they are on the outside.
I cannot sit idly by as a madman leads their race to ruin.
I must answer my family's call...
[ani:worry]...even if it means betraying those I have come to love.
An archaic nation ruled by yet another despot who believes himself worthy of godhood.
[ani:speak]Even after all these centuries, some humans never learn.
It is no surprise this Doom has seized the tools of the Celestials for himself.
I will gladly recover what he has taken from us...
...and, if needed, provide him a clear reminder of his mortality.
I assumed my arrival here would warrant the attention of Latveria's monarch himself...
...but instead, he sends these crude mechanical imitations to greet me?
[ani:speak]It seems diplomacy is off the table.
And so, on to battle once more.
These automatons pose no real threat to one who can forge any weapon from pure cosmic power...
...but I would much rather dismantle them than turn my might against the Deviants.
Doom's mechanical minions still charge forth in droves, but they fall to my spear as soon as they arrive.
I could easily cut my way straight to his throne...
...but I sense something else calling me in another direction...
It is full of ancient wonders far beyond the comprehension of most mortal minds.
And there! That object is of Celestial origin.\nI could spot that anywhere.
It is not the component that Sersi sent me here to seek...
[ani:worry]...But it does not belong in the hands of one who would abuse its infinite power.
I must reclaim it before I continue my search...
[ani:speak]There. The Celestial power source has been recovered.
But my presence here has not gone unnoticed.
More of Doom's artificial attendants have arrived.
After being alive for millions of years, I think I'm finally getting bored...
It seems... that Doom has upgraded his servants...
This life still has a few surprises to offer after all.
They caught me off-guard. Wounded me.
[ani:worry]But I have recovered from far worse.
For just as my power can destroy...
...it can be used to heal as well.
My wounds have been mended, but this needless battle still rages on.
[ani:speak]As much as I wish to lay every member of Doom's mechanical army to waste...
...I must not lose focus of my true purpose here.
[ani:speak]If I am to find the Celestial Component, I must seek out the one true Doom...
...and, for the sake of this world, I must make certain he does not live up to his name.
An Eternal in my court? What an unexpected honor.
I hope my Doombots provided you with a proper Latverian welcome...
Enough games. You have taken that which is not yours.
[ani:speak]Not this. Your power may be absolute in this land...
...but the might of the Celestials is without borders.
Return the component you possess and there will be no further need for hostilities.
Refuse, and you shall suffer the same fate as your synthetic soldiers.
You dare threaten Doom in his own castle?!
Then let us discover how Eternal you truly are!
In all your history, you have never faced a foe as worthy as Doom!
Submit now and prove that the knowledge of the centuries was not wasted on you.
An Eternal does not bow before any man.
You may be the king of this land...
...but I will make you kneel if I must!
This battle... could rage on forever... if we let it...
But Doom offers you another option...
[ani:speak]You may have the Celestial Component. It is of no real use to me on its own.
But in turn, you must allow me to run some simple scans of your Eternal anatomy.
I am not a specimen to be studied.
Should you deny my request, our conflict will resume and rage on...
[ani:angry]...even as this world burns around us!
If this is the price I must pay, then let us be done with it.
Remain still. This should be painless...
For your sake, I should hope so.
My equipment cannot even begin to calculate the vast cosmic power coursing through you...
[ani:speak]Perhaps it is as flawed as its creator.
Blasphemy! Doom is the pinnacle of perfection!
If so, then why do you need to study me?
We must adjourn this test at once, Doom.
[ani:speak]I fear another far more important one awaits us both...
You have something that I seek, little king.
You dare invade this sovereign land? Doom will not stand for such brazen disrespect.
When my Deviants are done with you, human, you will not stand at all.
Can you not see the glory of Doom?!
[ani:speak]Apparently not. And they certainly aren't alone...
Step aside, Thena. Unless you wish me to force you to as well.
[ani:speak]Kro... it does not have to be this way.
Thena, my dear. You know me better than any of your kin.
The Deviants have been lost in the darkness for untold ages.
The time has finally come for us to join you in the light.
You are wrong Kro. You have fought so long to prove the Deviants our equals...
...that you have lost sight of the fact that your differences are what make you special.
Sweet words... betrayed by centuries of oppression.
The Celestials made your people for a purpose...
[ani:angry]And now, at last, I will finish their work!
[ani:speak]I will not fight you, Kro. We have gone down that path too many times.
Take the Celestial Component if you must.
[ani:worry]It belongs to your people as much as it does mine.
Silence, human... before I crush you within your own armor.
[ani:speak]You would be doing all of mankind a favor...
...but Doom is beneath your concern. Leave him be.
Always the noble one, sparing lives on all sides.
Your fellow Eternals will not take your betrayal lightly, Thena.
I am not betraying them. I am merely putting fate in your hands...
...and hoping that you will choose wisely. For all our people.
[ani:speak]Should you not, the next time we meet, it will be in battle.
I will be counting the moments, my dear.
Then I can only hope I have bought us enough to spare...
I wish we came bearing better news.
Kro managed to stay one step ahead of us all.
[ani:speak]He did have hundreds of years to plan...
And he has left us with precious few moments to react.
I know, Makkari. Not a feeling I'm used to either...
Centuries or seconds, it matters not.
[ani:speak]We were created to protect this planet from harm.
And though the years may have taken us on separate paths...
...when we stand together, nothing on this world -- or any other -- can stop us.
I have consulted with some trusted human allies to assist us in our quest.
[ani:speak]This device should be able to lock onto the exact location where Kro is keeping the Celestial Components.
If he's anywhere on this planet, we can find him.
Theoretically. We still need a compatible power source that doesn't burn out the second we switch the thing on.
[ani:speak]I believe I can help with that...
I recovered this piece of Celestial technology during an encounter with the monarch of Latveria.
Wait... Victor just had this thing laying around in his lab? Of course he did...
[ani:speak]That guy is seriously going to blow up the world someday...
...and there's only about a 30% chance he does it on purpose!
This is perfect. Its power readings are off the charts...
[ani:speak]...And since it's Celestial in origin. It should already be synced with the wavelengths emitted by the components.
But like Tony said, ancient cosmic technology like this is volatile.
It'll take time to figure out how to harness it properly...
...And I don't think we have that kind of time.
I'm sorry... We might not be able to save the world this time...
[ani:speak]Then let's see if the world can help save itself.
Machine... Think you could help us out here?
If my assistance holds back the utter annihilation of all that I am...
...I suppose I could spare a few seconds.
[ani:speak]Whatever that Machine of yours just did, it worked.
[ani:worry]Where has Kro taken the Celestial Components?
[ani:speak]It looks like some kind of temple... in what used to be Babylon...
I should have known he would return to where this all started.
[ani:speak]We must move faster than any craft, human, or Eternal, can travel.
[ani:speak]Right? Thousands of years, and I'll still never get used to that...
Get your bearings quickly. We are not alone.
Please. When has an army of Deviants ever stopped me before?
Right. But other than that? Never.
[ani:speak]And that's not about to change today.
Either way, we shall find out soon enough...
[ani:worry]More Deviants are swarming to protect the temple.
I've never seen them fight so savagely.
You seem surprised, Thena. Did you expect our beloved Deviants to welcome you with open arms?
This is what they do... What they have always done.
[ani:speak]They fight to claim the world, while we fight to protect it.
This is why we were charged to correct excess deviation.
Well, if this isn't excess, I don't know what is...
You're too late. The process has begun.
Don't you see? This is what the Celestials created us for.
[ani:speak]And we were made to stop you.
[ani:speak]The Celestial energy is growing too strong.
Not even our cosmic might is enough to contain it.
[ani:worry]Not on our own. But together as one...
True... If we combine our powers and our knowledge, perhaps this world still stands a chance...
Time for some good, old-fashioned family bonding...
Everything we've learned on our journeys...
[ani:speak]...from the beginning of time to now...
...And now we must hone that knowledge like a spear...
[ani:speak]I agree. That was far too close.
Kro scurried off before I could put a proper end to him.
[ani:speak]Let him answer to his fellow Deviants for his failure. He will get what he deserves.
What are we to do with the Celestial Components?
They were a part of our grand design...
[ani:speak]But there is a fine line between creation and destruction.
Finer than we've ever cared to admit.
Our devotion is to the principles, not to ancient artifacts.
As long as these still remain, the Great Machine is in danger.
[ani:speak]Then we are in agreement. They must be destroyed.
I will deliver them to Phastos. He will know how to break them down safely.
[ani:speak]Even with them removed from play, Kro will dream up some other foolish scheme.
Of course he will... after a few centuries of licking his wounds...
But what matters is that the world is safe for now... thanks to all of you...
[ani:speak]Then we should try to enjoy the brief respite.
Unlike us, it won't last forever...

Bodyslide successful.^Destination confirmed: Krakoa. Year: 2024.^When Hope used my chronal beacon to send a distress call into the future,^she said Krakoa needed me back. Now.^And when my daughter calls for help, it doesn't matter how many centuries away I am.^I'll always come running.^From the looks of those demons ripping up my fellow Mutants' little island paradise,^I got here just in time.^Wherever you are kid, and whatever the hell is going on here,^you're gonna be okay. I promise.^Daddy's on his way...

Just when I'm finally getting my life together again,^the living Mutant island I call home gets attacked by the hordes of Hell.^I really shouldn't be surprised.^It's been like this ever since I joined the X-Men.^And just when I thought my day couldn't get worse,^my time-travelling nephew shows up from out of nowhere.^If Cable's here, that's always a sure^sign that the end of all time is speeding straight towards us.^Let me guess, Nate...^Hope called you in from the future to save the day? Great.^Then this must actually be as bad as it looks.^Last I saw your daughter,^she was holed up in the Arbor Magna.^I'll lead the way.^You use those ridiculously large guns of yours^to make sure your dear old Uncle Alex doesn't die in transit, okay?
That's Uncle Alex to you, young... err... old man.
Whatever. This isn't a family reunion. It's war.
Actually, I've got a hunch it might be both, Nate.
...but let's save that part for after we defeat the rampaging horde of demons, okay?
Fine by me... but whatever you're hiding is bound to come out sooner or later...
That big rifle of yours is all fancy and futuristic, kid...
...but it's nothing compared to the plasma blasts I can generate!
Save the beam measuring contests for Cyclops. We don't have time.
You mean like those two over there?
Actually, I was talking about everyone in this timeline...
...but, yeah. We can start with them.
Knowing you, Quire, I'll take that as a 'thank you.'
Forgive him. You have our deepest gratitude, my friends.
Depends. What's in it for us?
If we can find Hope, maybe Krakoa stands a chance of survival. Isn't that enough?
You seek the Mutant Messiah? Say no more. We are your humble servants.
Speak for yourself. Quentin Quire is neither humble nor anyone's servant.
Then stay here and get dragged to hell, Kid. Your choice.
Eh. Might as well come along. Not like I had anything better to do...
This is it. The Arbor Magna. One of the most sacred spots on Krakoa.
Hope is in there. I can sense her.
Too bad the door is sealed tighter than Emma Frost's corset.
Quire, Exodus, let's sync up our TK to force open the entryway.
And a precision plasma pulse should add some extra kick!
Nothing. Krakoa's defenses are too strong.
There may be another way. One that does not require brute force.
That's something I've always had plenty of...
...but the way things are going right now, I'm not sure how long that will last.
Exhibiting force against Krakoa will only raise its defenses.
Instead, we must show the island respect.
I'm totally willing to sacrifice Havok in Krakoa's name...
We ask politely and wait patiently.
Didn't you hear the old man? We're out of time.
Not quite yet. Your fellow X-folk are capable of handling the demons...
That should be enough for Krakoa to grow us a solution.
An organic key capable of opening any doorway on the island.
We must commune with Krakoa telepathically and deliver our request.
If that's what it takes. Linking our minds now...
Okay, cool. I guess I'll just sit here and try to make sure none of us get eaten alive by the legions of Hell.
Praise Krakoa. The key has blossomed.
Summers is right. Krakoa could've just opened the bloody door for us...
The island works in mysterious ways.
All that matters is that access to the Arbor Magna is ours now.
That means we can finally get to Hope.
I guess it's like Xavier used to say... "As long as Hope is alive..."
I'm pretty sure he was referring to the concept, not my niece.
For those of us who believe in her, they are one and the same.
Hope is right up here. But something's off...
I can sense it as well. Her telepathic aura feels different than usual. Darker.
And this psychic residue... Someone else was here. Someone familiar...
You... You shouldn't have come here, dad...
You were the one who triggered my chronal distress beacon, Hope.
Not me... Her... It was all part of her plan...
She wanted you back here... Wanted you all to herself...
But she's jealous of what we share... so she wants to break our bond...
Stand down, Hope. You know I'm not going to fight you.
She's not giving me the choice... She wants you to understand her pain...
...what she lost all those years ago...
After all... You were her baby once...
But don't worry... She promised there's no need for you to be afraid...
I was hoping you could tell me, Hope.
In the techno-organic flesh. The question is, is it really you?
It is... now... But for a moment there, she had complete control.
Who would dare to twist the mind of one so pure?
I know this isn't going to be easy for you to hear, dad, but it was --
Madelyne Pryor. The Goblin Queen. My mother.
Hold on. Spoiler time: Why would your mother do all of this again?
After my father left her, she made a deal with a literal devil to get revenge...
...and then when I was taken to the future as a child, she never really recovered.
She also happens to be a clone of Jean Grey... but that's a whole other thing...
And here I thought my family was complicated...
Madelyne opened the door to these demons. She lured you back from the future, Dad.
And she put a target on you in order to get to me.
Which means, she has to pay.
Hate to interrupt all this juicy Summers family drama, but I've got bad news.
I've psi-scanned the entire island. Only goblins. No queen.
Hmm. I've registered a spike in temporal energy. She may have time traveled.
How? Last I checked, that wasn't one of her abilities...
It was magic. She could sense the boundaries between dimensions growing weaker.
She was going to rewrite reality. Give you both the happy ending you never had.
But when her plan backfired, she used the cross-dimensional chaos to escape instead.
Ooh. A road trip! So... where are we going?
It's not where I'm worried about. It's when...
What are you waiting for, Nate? You can use your tech to follow Maddie, right?
If she had just crossed through time, sure.
But her kind of magic breaches dimensional barriers. She could be in almost any timeline.
To make sure we end up in the right future, I'll need to make some upgrades.
And there's only one Mutant in this era with the tools I need.
Time to pay a visit to Forge's workshop...
That'll do it. Cross-dimensional upgrades on-line and operational.
There's no telling where we're going. You're all welcome to stay here.
And let you have all the fun? Dream on!
We will see this through to the end.
Let's just hope it's somewhere slightly better than this...

Seen a lot of possible futures. Ones like this are some of the ugliest.^And, unfortunately, they're far too common.^Don't need to know the exact history of this reality to figure out the basics.^Humans found more reasons to hate and fear us,^so they sent out their pet Sentinels to wipe every Mutant off the face of the planet.^A few of our kind probably decided to change sides and be good dogs for their new human masters...^...but the rest of us stood up and fought back, just like we always have.^And most of 'em paid the ultimate price.^Not sure why Maddie would've come here.^It ain't safe for any of us. Even her.^She must've been pretty desperate.^And when the Goblin Queen gets desperate, things start getting real bad. Fast.^We'd better find her before this possible future becomes our only one.
Is this truly the future that awaits our people?
One of 'em, if we're not lucky.
Is there anything we can do to help the Mutants here?
Right now, we've got our own problems.
Huh. You landed us somewhere worse than a Mutant island overrun by demons.
Was it just me, or were those Sentinels more annoying than usual?
There was some external force enhancing their abilities.
It's not just the Sentinels. This whole reality has been twisted.

Don't worry, I'll make it quick.

Aren't YOU tired of constantly getting in my way?!
To be honest, I'm starting to enjoy it.

This is scientific progress, you ignorant spider-fool!
It's you again. This time, I'll finish you off.

Vowing to serve his country in any way possible, young Steve Rogers took the Super Soldier Serum to become America's one-man army. Having fought for the red, white, and blue for over 60 years, Captain America is the living symbol of freedom and liberty.
128 lbs (58 kg, Banner); 1,150 lbs (521.6 kg, Hulk)

Caught in a gamma bomb explosion while trying to save the life of a teenager, Dr. Bruce Banner was transformed into the incredibly powerful creature, The Hulk. An often misunderstood hero, the angrier the Hulk gets, the stronger the Hulk gets.

Wounded, captured and forced to build a weapon by his enemies, billionaire industrialist Tony Stark instead created an advanced suit of armor to save his life and escape captivity. Now with a new outlook on life, Tony uses his money and intelligence to make the world a safer, better place as Iron Man.
180 lbs (82 kg, Johnny); 220lbs (99.8 kg, Ghost Rider)

After being tricked for his soul, daring stunt motorcyclist Johnny Blaze was bonded with the demon Zarathos and gained the ability to transform into the Ghost Rider. A skeletal being with a flaming skull, Ghost Rider uses hellfire and his Penance Stare to seek vengeance.

An expert marksman with a penchant for large weaponry, Rocket Raccoon teams up with Star-Lord and other adventurers to form the Guardians of the Galaxy. Together, they travel the galaxy and defend it from those who wish it harm.

Powerful enzymes running through his veins render Blade immune to vampire bites. A trained fighter proficient in practically every form of weaponry known to man, Blade uses his unique skill set in his quest to wipe out the world's vampires.

Natasha Romanova, known by many aliases, is an expert spy, athlete, and assassin. Trained at a young age by the KGB's infamous Red Room Academy, the Black Widow was formerly an enemy to the Avengers. She later became their ally after breaking out of the U.S.S.R.'s grasp, and also serves as a top S.H.I.E.L.D. agent.

As the Norse god of thunder and lightning, Thor wields one of the greatest weapons ever made, the enchanted hammer Mjolnir. While others have described Thor as an over-muscled, oafish imbecile, he's quite smart and compassionate. He's self-assured, and he would never stop fighting for a worthwhile cause.

Felicia Hardy grew up a spoiled daddy's girl, intent on emulating her beloved father. When she discovered that he was the world's greatest cat burglar, she was determined to follow in his footsteps and undertook rigorous training to master martial arts, lock picking, and safe cracking.

Bitten by a radioactive spider, high school student Peter Parker gained the speed, strength and powers of a spider. Adopting the name Spider-Man, he web swings through New York protecting it from evil at any level. Taught that with great power comes great responsibility, Spidey has vowed to use his powers to help everyone he can.

A tree-like creature of few words, Groot formed a bond with Rocket Raccoon. With the Guardians of the Galaxy, Groot and his best friend Rocket travel through space getting into trouble wherever they go.

Gamora was adopted by the villainous Thanos and raised as an assassin. However, she turned on her adopted father and now uses her abilities to help those who cannot help themselves. Gamora now travels with the Guardians of the Galaxy and is known as the Most Dangerous Woman in the Universe.

Arguably the greatest and certainly the most horrific creation of scientific genius Dr. Henry Pym, Ultron is a criminally insane rogue sentient robot dedicated to conquest and the extermination of humanity.

Loki is the biological son of Laufey, king of the frost giants, and the adopted brother of Thor. Known as the God of Lies and Mischief, Loki's malicious lust for power has led to countless attempts through the centuries to destroy Thor and seize the throne of Asgard for himself.
The Red Skull is a skilled unarmed combatant, marksman and master of disguise. He possesses a keen mind for military, political, corporate and subversive strategies.

Abandoned by his mother, Matt Murdock was raised by his father, boxer "Battling Jack" Murdock, in Hell's Kitchen.
