Realizing that rules were needed to prevent people from abusing power, young Matt decided to study law; however, when he saved a man from an oncoming truck, it spilled a radioactive cargo that rendered Matt blind while enhancing his remaining senses. Under the harsh tutelage of blind martial arts master, Stick, Matt mastered his heightened senses and becomes the masked vigilante Daredevil.

After an explosion that grafted a tentacled harness to brilliant scientist Dr. Octavius, his brain created new neuro-pathways so that he could possess the superhuman ability to telepathically control his tentacles at will.
The father of Peter Parker's best friend, Harry, businessman Norman Osborn moonlights as the unstable Green Goblin and has caused Spider-Man more tragedy than any other foe!

Harnessing the power of the Cosmic Cube, the villainous organization A.I.M. mutated technician George Tarleton into M.O.D.O.K. - Mental Organism Designed Only for Killing. A "living computer", M.O.D.O.K. possess fantastic psionic powers and superhuman calculation abilities.

Malekith, ruler of the Dark Elves of Svartalfheim, is one of the Nine Realms' most ruthless and terrifying villains. Armed with magic, he often allies with Loki with the mutual ambition of destroying Thor.
Initially created by Odin as a weapon to protect Asgard, the Destroyer fell into Loki's hands and was animated into a killing machine possessing superhuman strength and energy manipulation abilities.
6’4” (193 cm); 5'9” (175.3 cm, as Arthur Douglas); 7'4” (223.5 cm, in most powerful body)
680 lbs; 161 lbs (73 kg, as Arthur Douglas); 1,050 lbs (476.2 kg, in most powerful body)

Drax the Destroyer is a superhuman warrior seeking vengeance for the murder of his family. Recruited to join the Guardians of the Galaxy, Drax possesses superhuman strength, durability and a healing factor making him strong enough to face any threat he comes across.

Raised as sharpshooting circus attraction, Clint Barton is an expert archer with near-perfect accuracy, keen eyesight, and exceptional reflexes. After witnessing Iron Man in action, Hawkeye was inspired to employ his archery skills in fighting crime as a costumed super hero.

Mockingbird is an excellent gymnast, martial artist, and hand-to-hand combatant. She has a doctoral degree in biology and was well trained by S.H.I.E.L.D. in espionage and counter-espionage techniques. She is also a proficient marks-woman and well-versed in the use of her battle staves.
245 lbs (111.1 kg, Ross); 1200 lbs (544.3 kg, Red Hulk)

As a young man, Thaddeus Ross enlisted in the military and received his nickname from his troops because he "struck like a thunderbolt" when leading them into action. Now he has become the very thing he hated most in life. He is the Red Hulk.

When Air Force pilot Carol Danvers was caught in a Kree energy explosion, she gained the powers of flight, super strength, and energy expulsion. As a protector of the galaxy and a valued member of the Avengers, she is oftentimes looked to as both a leader and an inspiration.
A pilot in the United States Marines, James Rhodes dons the Stark Enterprises-created War Machine armor to take down threats both at home and abroad.

Stephen Strange was a brilliant but egoistical surgeon until a terrible accident permanently injured his hands – and his pride. He scoured the globe desperately for a cure and was led to the mysterious Ancient One, who showed him the way of the mystic arts. Now, Doctor Strange uses his newfound metaphysical abilities to defend the earth from supernatural and interdimensional threats.

The metal monstrosity called Ultron created the synthetic humanoid known as the Vision from the remains of the original android Human Torch, of the 1940s, to serve as a vehicle of vengeance against the Avengers.

With a mental connection to all birds and a suit that allows him to fly, The Falcon has been both partner to Captain America and an Avenger himself. Whether as a super hero, or under his secret identity as a social worker, Sam Wilson, The Falcon, dedicates his life to standing up for others.

The former boy sidekick of Captain America, James "Bucky" Barnes was thought to have died during World War II. However, he resurfaced years later as the Winter Soldier, an assassin brainwashed into villainy by Russian scientists.

A decorated Marine, Frank Castle sought to make the world a safer place for his wife and young children. However, when his family was ruthlessly murdered in front of his eyes, he waged a one-man war against crime as the Punisher, a ruthless, violent, and unstoppable vigilante.

Inspired by the legacy left behind by her Aunt Peggy fighting alongside Captain America during World War II, Sharon Carter joined and trained under S.H.I.E.L.D., becoming one of the agency's most skilled and efficient operatives.
Carl Lucas; legally changed to Luke Cage

Luke Cage was subjected to a science experiment that induced a body-wide mutagenic effect, enhancing his body tissue and strength. A come-from-behind hero, he has proven he can overcome any obstacle through tenacity and sheer force of will.

At the age of 19, Danny Rand gained the power of the "Iron Fist", acquiring the dragon-shaped scar on his chest and the ability to focus his spiritual energies into his fist. A master of martial arts, he took to the streets of New York to fight crime as a costumed hero.

Peter Jason Quill, the self-proclaimed 'legendary outlaw' known as Star-Lord, is the leader of the Guardians of the Galaxy. Formerly a petty criminal, he now travels and protects the galaxy with his team of ragtag misfits.

A powerful, cultured and noble monarch, T'Challa succeeded his father as king of the small, reclusive African nation Wakanda. T'Challa dons the ceremonial garb of the Black Panther, totem of the Wakandan people. As chieftain of the country's Panther Clan, he is the latest in a long line of warrior kings -- steeped in tradition, tribalism and a deeply rooted sense of honor.

Black Bolt, the king of the super-powered beings known as Inhumans, rules his people righteously and seeks peace between all races and species. Black Bolt’s greatest power is in his words, as the shock wave that comes from making a sound has the power to blast away his opponent or even destroy a planet. To keep this ability in check, he often remains silent, his queen, Medusa, speaks on his behalf instead.

Angela is a fierce warrior raised by Angels in Heven. After being taken from her home, she discovers that her true parents are Odin and Frigga, and that her disappearance was a result of Asgard’s war with Heven. The Queen of Angels pardoned, but exiled Angela, who has now dedicated herself to exploring other realms.

A fierce and deadly assassin-for-hire, Elektra is an expert in Ninjutsu, martial arts, and gymnastics. Few have fought her and survived, earning her a reputation as one of the Marvel Universe's deadliest mercenaries.

An alien symbiote bonded with journalist Eddie Brock, transforming him into the monstrous Venom. The symbiote granted him super-strength and extrasensory abilities, making him one of Spider-Man's most formidable foes.
Wilson Fisk, New York's kingpin of crime, is as cunning as he is brutal. One of the Marvel Universe's most powerful and feared crime lords, he will stop at nothing until the city is under his thumb.

Despite having no super powers, Bullseye has the notorious ability to use virtually any object as a lethal projectile. The costumed criminal harbors both psychopathic and homicidal tendencies, a deadly combination for those who wind up in his sights.
The Hulkbuster is a powerful suit of armor created by Tony Stark. It is one of the few weapons that has proved effective against the Hulk's uncontrollable rampages.
As the Centaurian leader of the Ravagers, Yondu works with -- and sometimes against -- the Guardians of the Galaxy. His skill with Yaka arrows makes him both a useful ally and an intimidating foe.
Nebula is a fierce and deadly pirate feared throughout the galaxy for her crimes. Her path of chaos and terror has led to clashes with various heroes such as Nova, Spider-Man, and the Avengers.

Born a Kree on the planet Hala, Ronan joined the Accuser Corps and quickly ascended to the top of the ranks. As The Supreme Accuser, Ronan enforces the laws of the Kree Empire throughout the galaxy and frequently clashes with Earth’s Super Heroes and other alien races.
6'0” (183 cm, can shrink to a half inch as Ant-Man)

An electronics expert who could not support his family doing repair work, Scott Lang turned his talents to burglary. Apprehended by the authorities, he served his prison sentence and was paroled for good behavior. When his daughter Cassie was diagnosed with a serious illness, Lang sought the aid of a renowned surgeon who was kidnapped by Darren Cross. In order to rescue her and save his daughter, Lang broke into the home of Dr. Henry Pym and stole his original Ant-Man suit. After a successful rescue, Lang tried to turn himself in, but Pym allowed him to keep the suit for the purpose of good.

Dr. Henry "Hank" Pym was a brilliant scientist who discovered "Pym Particles", subatomic particles that allowed the user to shrink to the size of an ant. Using the Pym Particles in conjunction with a cybernetic helmet he created to communicate with ants, he donned a newly designed protective suit and began using his new abilities as the first Ant-Man!

Janet van Dyne was a daughter of a wealthy scientist Vernon van Dyne. During an experiment, however, an alien monster was unleashed and Dr. van Dyne was killed. Her father's associate, Dr. Henry "Hank" Pym, had created a substance called "Pym Particles", which allowed the user to grow or shrink in size, and had become the Super Hero Ant-Man; when Janet's father died, she convinced Pym to help her, and he gave her a supply of "Pym Particles" and subjected her to a procedure which granted her the ability to, upon shrinking, grow wings and fire blasts of energy, which she called her "wasp's stings."

After learning the science behind Hank Pym’s astonishing shrinking suit, the ruthless tech mogul Darren Cross devoted his resources to creating a prototype suit with similar abilities. Cross envisioned this high-power cybernetic rig as a means to take modern warfare to a new level, personally overseeing its retrofitting and weaponization. Cross dons the imposing armor himself in hopes of achieving final victory as Yellowjacket!

At a young age, Nico Minoru discovered she had magical powers and the ability to summon the powerful Staff of One. As Sister Grimm, she was formerly a member of The Runaways, and is now a member of A-Force where she has quickly bonded with the being known as Singularity.

The A-Force discovered the cosmological entity Singularity when she fell from the sky in a bright flash of light. She is a pocket universe that gained self-consciousness and ultimately chose a female identity in her pursuit to understand the human race. She possesses a mysterious ability to move between different worlds and dimensions.
5'10” (177.8 cm, in human form); 6'7” (200.7 cm, as She-Hulk)
140 lbs (63.5 kg, in human form); 650 lbs (294.8 kg, as She-Hulk)

Seriously wounded, young lawyer Jennifer Walters was given a blood transfusion from her cousin Bruce Banner and subsequently gained the ability to transform into She-Hulk. Usually in better control of her powers and temper than the Hulk, She-Hulk has been a high-profile New York lawyer as well as an upstanding member of the Avengers.

Agent Daisy Johnson, the upstart hacker formerly known as Skye, is now a highly trained S.H.I.E.L.D. agent. After meeting her father Cal and Inhuman mother Jiaying, Daisy learned her real birth name and how to hone her ability to channel vibrations and cause earthquakes. She now leads S.H.I.E.L.D.’s mission to find and protect Inhumans around the world.

Sif possesses the conventional attributes of an Asgardian woman ("goddess"). Like all Asgardians, she is extremely long-lived (although not immortal like the Olympians), superhumanly strong (the average Asgardian female can lift about 25 tons; Sif can lift 30 tons) immune to all diseases, and resistant to conventional injury (Asgardian flesh and bone is about 3 times as dense as similar human tissue, contributing to all Asgardians' superhuman strength and weight).

Mike Peterson, better known by his alias “Deathlok,” is an elite combat operative whose cybernetic modifications give him superhuman strength and a deadly arsenal of weaponry. Deathlok serves S.H.I.E.L.D. as one of Coulson’s “blue dots,” a network of agents tracking Hydra around the world.

Lincoln Campbell is an Inhuman from Cincinnati who was selected to undergo the process of Terrigenesis. As a result of his transformation, all of the cells in Lincoln's body were differently charged, giving him the ability to generate static electricity. Since then, Lincoln has remained at the place called "Afterlife" as a "transitioner," someone who helps other Inhumans transition through Terrigenesis smoothly.

Born in the hidden Inhuman city of Orollan, Greenland, Lash was one of the few chosen among his generation to receive the gift of Terrigenesis, an honor he believed not every member of his race was due. When King Black Bolt activated a Terrigen Bomb above New York, flooding the world with Terrigen Mist and awakening the powers of Inhuman descendants living among humanity, Lash embarked on a mission to find all the individuals affected, and judge for himself whether they were worthy to live with their new abilities.

S.H.I.E.L.D. Director Phil Coulson is back, protecting the world from the shadows with his team of elite agents. Since taking over as director for Nick Fury, Coulson has confronted Hydra foes, the appearance of Inhumans, and even a civil war within S.H.I.E.L.D. But through it all, Coulson still believes that his team of agents can make a difference, no matter the odds.
Vince Marcus, aka Warwolf, is the field commander of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Howling Commandos Monster Force. Unlike other lycanthropes, Warwolf is affected by Mars instead of the Moon.

Beautiful and feisty, Elsa Bloodstone is the daughter of famous monster hunter Ulysses Bloodstone. Though ignorant of her father's career, she was plagued by dreams about vampires and other creatures of the night. Shortly after Elsa's 18th birthday, Ulysses died and left his Boston home (the Bloodstone House) to Elsa and her pregnant mother, along with all of its contents, accumulated during his millennia of adventures. Adam, the caretaker of the house helped indoctrinate Elsa into her true heritage, offering her the mystic Bloodstone Choker which bonded with and empowered Elsa. Elsa and her mother elected to remain at Bloodstone House, turning it into a curiosity shop run by her mother while Elsa continues exploring the family vocation of monster hunting.

Jessica Jones possesses superhuman strength; the parameters of her strength are unrevealed, but she can lift an automobile with no discernible effort. She possesses an enhanced level of resistance to physical injury, although she is unsure of whether or not she is bulletproof. She is also a reasonably skilled detective and hand-to-hand combatant.

Young Miles Morales was poised to start the next chapter in his life in a new school. Then, the bite of a stolen, genetically altered spider granted the grade schooler incredible arachnid-like powers. Now Miles has been thrust into a world he doesn't understand, with gut instinct and a little thing called responsibility as his only guides. Can he live up to the legacy of Spider-Man?

As a teenager, Gwen Stacy went to a demonstration on radioactivity and was bitten by a mutated spider. The bite transformed her, granting her amazing powers: a precognitive awareness of danger, adhesive fingertips and toes, and the proportional speed and strength of a spider. To the residents of New York, she is the dangerous vigilante called Spider-Woman, but you know her as Spider-Gwen!

As a teenager, Cindy Moon was bitten by the same spider that bit Peter Parker, giving her powers similar to those of the Amazing Spider-Man: powers of adhesion, a unique precognitive awareness of danger, and the ability to weave spider webs from her fingertips, she now swings through the skies of New York City as Silk!

Amadeus Cho, the seventh smartest person in the Marvel Universe, is the new, gamma-powered, Totally Awesome Hulk! With the help of his sister, Maddy Cho, his mission is to be the best Hulk ever! He's out to prove that the Hulk isn't the world's most terrifying monster, but its greatest hero.
Proxima Midnight is a master combatant in the armies of Thanos. She can kill most beings with one throw of her spear, which was forged by Thanos himself. It is said that she never misses.

A Muslim-American teenager growing up in Jersey City, Kamala Khan gained shape-shifting powers when a strange Terrigen Mist descended upon the city, awakening her Inhuman genes. A fan of Super Heroes, in particular Carol Danvers, Kamala took up Captain Marvel's former identity and became the new Ms. Marvel. This up and coming hero works to fight evil, protect her community, and create her own place in the world.

When Dr. Jane Foster lifts the mystic hammer Mjolnir, she is transformed into the Goddess of Thunder, The Mighty Thor! Her enemies are many, as Asgard descends further into chaos and war threatens to spread throughout the Ten Realms. Yet her greatest battle will be against a far more personal foe: the cancer that is killing her mortal form.

Cletus Kasady was a psychopathic serial killer known for his brutality and violence. He bonded with an alien symbiote that gave him abilities similar to those of the Amazing Spider-Man and enabled him to craft bladed weapons out of the creature's living tissue. Deadlier than ever, he became the killer called Carnage.

The powerhouse of the Mad Titan's army, Black Dwarf is a member of Thanos' elite Black Order. He possesses super human strength, density, and durability, making him a terrifyingly formidable opponent. \n

Corvus Glaive was a member of Thanos' Black Order alongside his wife, Proxima Midnight, and served as the right-hand of the Mad Titan. Cruel and ruthless, his duties included collecting sacrificial tributes from planets all across the galaxy.

The Mad Titan Thanos, a melancholy, brooding entity consumed with his love of Death, sought out personal power and increased strength, endowing himself with cybernetic implants until he became one of the most powerful beings in the Marvel Universe.
Supergiant is a mental parasite who can steal and devour the minds of her victims. A member of Thanos' Black Order, she is as unpredictable as she is dangerous.

Ebony Maw, a member of Thanos' Black Order, is a master of deceit and manipulation. His black tongue spreads mischief and evil wherever he goes, able to manipulate even the most powerful of Super Heroes.

A feared mercenary and one of Captain America's most persistent enemies, Crossbones is a world-class, hand-to-hand fighter with extensive experience in street-fighting, martial arts, and military combat techniques.

Soldier and mercenary Marc Spector died in Egypt, under a statue of the ancient deity Khonshu. He returned to life in the shadow of the moon god, and became Moon Knight to fight crime for his own redemption.

As one of the last surviving members of his alien race, Hyperion was sent to earth as a baby. He was raised under the name of Marcus Milton by a human father and learned to harness his incredible powers to protect the world.

Sinthea "Sin" Schmidt is the daughter of the Red Skull and a villainous ally of Crossbones. Highly-trained and dangerously unpredictable, she has inherited her father's diabolical intellect and combat skills.

In an alternate universe where Captain America was never frozen in ice at the end of World War II, Steve Rogers and Allied resistance fighter, Agent Peggy Carter, helped secure victory during the great conflict and celebrated V-Day with a private marriage ceremony. Shortly after their honeymoon, when Peggy was assigned to the Korean peninsula as part of a S.H.I.E.L.D. peacekeeping task force, the couple relocated and welcomed the birth of their daughter Sharon a year later. Decades later, when her father and mother retired from active service, Sharon took up her parents’ quest for peace and justice. Highly trained in martial arts and espionage, and equipped with a blaster lance and energy absorbing shield, Sharon battles evil and tyrants around the world as Captain America!
When Ava Ayala inherited mystical amulets from her niece, she became the Super Hero White Tiger. The amulets grant her super human powers and reflexes, as well as razor-sharp claws.

William "Billy" Kaplan is a teenage magic-user who has been part of both the Young Avengers and the New Avengers. He is considered a powerful mage, and was revealed to be the Demiurge - a being of great power - destined to one day rewrite the laws of magic.

Alien teenager Hulkling was raised as a human and joined the Young Avengers when he realized the full potential of his incredible shapeshifting powers. He later joined the New Avengers, along with his partner Wiccan.

A former Super Villain turned Hero, Songbird possesses supersonic sound abilities that can incapacitate and stop her enemies. With the help of some intricate technology, she is also able to generate solid sound "wings" for flight and maneuverability.
Doreen Green, a.k.a. Squirrel Girl, possesses a bushy prehensile tail and the ability to control squirrels at will. She fights crime with her ally, a super-genius squirrel named Tippy-Toe.

Gwen Poole was a comic book fan who was one day mysteriously transported into the Marvel Universe that she had only read about in her own world. Under the impression that the Marvel Universe is all make-believe, she's taken on her own Super Hero identity to kick butt and have fun -- with zero consequences!

Born to a wealthy international crime lord in the People’s Republic of China, Shang-Chi was raised in isolation, never suspecting that his father was training him to become the ultimate living weapon. Upon learning the awful truth of his father’s evil nature, he renounced his family and employed his exceptional martial arts skills for good. Since then, Shang-Chi has dedicated his life to overthrowing his father’s evil empire and protecting the innocent as the Master of Kung-Fu!

A decorated New York City detective, Misty Knight is a skilled investigator, capable of observation, forensics, and inductive and deductive reasoning of the highest caliber. After losing her right arm in the line of duty, she was gifted a bionic arm made of Vibranium from Tony Stark himself. The mechanical arm allows Misty to generate anti-gravity fields, produce concentrated blasts of cryogenic energy, and stop criminals in their tracks with a deadly vice grip.

Once lost and broken, Karl Mordo channeled his anger towards the path of enlightenment. As a dedicated and experienced apprentice of the Ancient One, Karl Mordo befriended Stephen Strange and served as his mentor in the mystic arts.
Wong is an expert in the martial arts of Kamar-Taj. A dutiful associate of Doctor Strange‘s, he has proved valuable as both a friend and an ally.

As a student of the mystic arts, Kaecilius sought out the powerful secrets of the Multiverse. Once a student of the Ancient One, he discovered a darker use for his mystical abilities and has since used them to fulfill a villainous purpose.

A master of the mystic arts, the Ancient One serves to defend the earth from otherworldly threats. For generations, the Ancient One has passed down sacred wisdom to dedicated disciples, training them in extraordinary arts and abilities.

Satana is a succubus who, along with her brother Hellstrom, inherited supernatural powers from their demon father. Able to manipulate magical forces and bend them to her will, she can also project powerful bolts of hellfire and hypnotize her victims.
Daimon Hellstrom is the son of demon and brother to Satana. Known as the “Son of Satan", his powers are virtually unlimited in his home dimension of Hell -- truly a force to be feared.

A powerful practitioner of the mystic arts, Clea was raised in the Dark Dimension but would later become an ally of Doctor Strange, training with him on Earth in the Sanctum Sanctorum. As the Sorceress Supreme of the Dark Dimension, she possesses great power in both magical and physical combat.

Ulik, the most formidable of an ancient race of Rock Trolls, possesses brutish strength and a durable hide that is nearly impervious to damage. An enemy of Thor, he often clashes with the God of Thunder in earth-shaking battles.
A charming and winsome swashbuckler, Fandral is known for his superior swordsmanship, bravery, and optimism. Like his fellow members of the Warriors three, he is a loyal friend and ally to Thor.
Lively and boisterous, Volstagg is the indomitably cheerful heart of the Warriors Three. As an Asgardian, he possesses superhuman strength as well as enhanced durability and endurance.
Hogun is the calmest and most level-headed member of the Warriors Three. An expert hand-to-hand combatant, he wields a powerful mace and is a master of Asgardian weaponry.

The immortal sorceress Amora uses her manipulative, magical abilities in the pursuit of power and pleasure. Rapt by her beauty and ensnared by her cunning, even the mightiest warriors of Asgard bend to the will of the Enchantress!

As the most powerful of the Norse gods, the All-Father Odin has ruled and protected the Nine Realms of Asgard for eons. Odin is the father of Thor and remains ageless and nearly invulnerable through the power of the “Odinforce".
Hela is the goddess and ruler of Asgard’s undead realms. Holding the power of life and death over her kinsmen, she often conspires against Odin and his rule.

Kate Bishop was a regular civilian before a chance encounter made her an honorary member of the Young Avengers. Armed with nothing but Mockingbird's battle staves, Black Widow's utility belt, and Hawkeye's bow, she managed to save the young Super Heroes from an attack by Kang the Conqueror. Since then, Kate Bishop has donned the persona of the All-New Hawkeye, taking down Super Villains using her quick wit and deadly aim.

As a certified genius, Riri reverse-engineered Tony Stark's Iron Man Armor at the age of 15. What started as a small challenge quickly became her greatest ambition: to create her own version of the Iron Man suit and help those in need. After learning of Riri's first successful prototype, Tony Stark visits her and decides to endorse her desire to become the Invincible Ironheart!

Medusalith Amaquelin is the wife of Black Bolt and the queen of the Inhumans. A strong-willed and benevolent matriarch, Medusa serves as the voice of Attilan as her husband remains the silent king. She uses her psycho-kinetically controlled hair to create tendrils, shields, and blades, which are stronger and sharper than steel.

Though just a small child, Lunella Lafayette is the smartest person on Earth. As a human and Inhuman hybrid, Luna possesses vast intelligence and a knack for inventing strange gadgets. After creating her latest invention, the Omni-Wave Projector, Luna opens a portal to Dinosaur World and befriends the monstrous Devil Dinosaur, who aids her in her adventures. Exposure to the Terrigen Mist strengthens the bond between Luna and Devil Dinosaur, as her latent Inhuman powers allow her to swap consciousness with the gigantic beast.

Karnak Mander-Azur is a member of the Inhuman Royal Family and cousin to both Medusa and Black Bolt. At a young age, Karnak was enrolled in his father's religious seminary in the Tower of Wisdom, where he trained in various physical and mental disciplines. Through intense practice, he developed the incredible ability to perceive weaknesses -- both physical and psychological -- in all objects or persons around him. Karnak currently serves as the Magister of the Second Tower of Wisdom where he passes along the teachings of his father.

Gorgon Petragon is a member of the Inhuman Royal Family and cousin to both Black Bolt and Maximus. With swift hooves and monstrous strength, Gorgon is one of Attilan's greatest warriors. Currently, Gorgon assists Crystal in a diplomatic mission to recover new Inhumans created by the Terrigen Mist.

Dante Pertuz was the first human to have his latent Inhuman genes triggered by the Terrigen Mist. After emerging from his Inhuman cocoon, he was granted the ability to manipulate flames and take on a heated, molten form. Medusa takes an interest in Dante after he successfully fends off the evil Inhuman, Lash, from harming his family. She invites Dante to move to Attilan, making him the first NuHuman (people of both human and Inhuman ancestry) to join the city.

Like her older sister Medusa, Crystal Amaquelin is an Inhuman that was subjected to the Terrigen Mist as an infant, causing her powers to manifest at a very young age. She has the ability to psionically manipulate the elements of earth, water, wind, and fire. With her elemental powers at the ready, Crystal serves as the Inhuman Ambassador, overseeing diplomatic relations and protecting the Inhuman Royal Family at all costs.

Maximus is the brother of the Inhuman king, Black Bolt. Jealous of his brother since birth, he seeks to usurp the throne and rule Attilan himself. With his amazing intellect and mind control abilities, Maximus poses a constant threat to the Inhuman Royal Family.

Dormammu was born untold millennia ago in the dimension of the Faltine -- a realm flowing with mystical energy. After slaying his parent Sinifer and amassing enough power to become the Faltine dimension's most powerful sorcerer, Dormammu was banished to the Dark Dimension for his crimes. Now residing as the ruler of the Dark Dimension, he seeks to conquer new universes and absorb their energy into his shadowy domain.

As a talented young mechanic, Robbie takes it upon himself to work at Canelo's Garage in order to support his disabled younger brother, Gabe. Desperate to change their lives for the better, Robbie enters an underground street race. However, when the race doesn't end as planned, Robbie is killed by the cartel and later resurrected by the spirit haunting the car he borrowed, Eli Morrow. Not only does Morrow resurrect Robbie, he embeds himself in Robbie's psyche and gives him the power to transform into the All-New Ghost Rider!

Inspired by the Super Heroes of comic books, Patsy Walker sought out her own Super Hero identity after the bitter end of her first marriage. Patsy dubbed herself "Hellcat" and utilized her natural athletic ability to become the Super Hero she envisioned. As Hellcat, Patsy trained on Titan and honed her psionic abilities and martial arts skills. Upon her return to Earth she became a member of the Super Hero team, the Defenders.

Kei Kawade is a child who grew up in Oahu, Hawaii but has moved several times since. From his young age Kei manifested an ability to bring his art to life, literally. As Kid Kaiju, Kei can summon and communicate with monsters through his drawings. Kei is also an expert when it comes to comics, books, and films in the genres of sci-fi and horror.

Raised in a temple by the pacifist Kree Priests of Pama, Mantis was to become the Celestial Madonna, the mother of the Celestial Messiah. Mantis is an exceptional martial artist as well as a master of meditational disciplines, giving her incredible control over her body. She also has empathic abilities allowing her to sense others' emotions and communicate with plants.

Flash Thompson is a war veteran who lost his legs in Iraq protecting an ally from enemy fire. While bonded to the Venom symbiote Flash gains the ability to reproduce his legs as well as gains all the abilities of the symbiote that had once bonded with Spider-Man. In addition to his other-worldy powers, Flash is a trained sharpshooter and a skilled hand-to-hand combatant.

Anton Vanko was a young scientist who lived in a small Russian village named Volstok. One day his village was attacked and many townspeople lost their lives -- including Anton's father. The assailant appeared to be Iron Man and Anton vowed he would avenge his father by destroying him. Through reverse engineering Iron Man's technology, Whiplash was born! Using the arc reactor to power his own suit, he attacks with signature electrically charged whips.

Scott Summers is a mutant with the ability to harness energy and direct it through his eyes to deliver blasts of concussive force. Scott wears a visor made of ruby quartz in order to control his potentially devastating gaze.
A central figure to her fellow X-Men, Jean Grey is an Omega-level mutant telepath and telekinetic. She is also the physical manifestation of the Phoenix Force, a devastatingly powerful cosmic entity.

A product of the secret government project Weapon X, Wolverine is a mutant possessing retractable adamantium claws and a remarkable healing factor. Though he carries a troubled and bloody past, he joined the X-Men to fight for the protection of both mutants and humans alike.

Ororo Munroe, also known as Storm, is a descendant of an ancient line of African priestesses, mutagenically imbued with the ability to manipulate elemental forces of weather. She has been many things -- a thief, a goddess, a leader of mutantkind - but her focus has always been dedicated to protecting her fellow mutants and the world.
One of the founding X-Men, Hank McCoy is a mutant with animal-like strength and agility. Despite his beast-like appearance, Hank possesses a brilliant intellect, particularly in the area of science.

Originally a member of the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants, Rogue has become a longtime, loyal member of the X-Men. She is capable of absorbing others' abilities, thoughts and memories through physical contact, granting her access to a diverse variety of powers.

The Master of Magnetism and a mutant revolutionist, Magneto is one of the most powerful and infamous nemeses of the X-Men. Despite their conflicting views, Magneto has fought alongside the X-Men just as many times as he has fought against them.

From an early age, William Baker chose to live a life of crime, often finding himself behind bars. Baker escaped one of his incarcerations, only to find himself on a beach near an atomic testing site. After being bombarded with a massive dose of radiation, Baker awoke with the ability to transform himself into sand-like forms that he could manipulate and reshape at will. Eager to put his new abilities to use, he attempted a series of audacious robberies as the Sandman!

Dr. Curt Connors graduated medical school with two doctorates, in biology and biochemistry. When he lost his arm in an explosion, Curt turned his research to developing a serum to regenerate lost limbs using reptile DNA. When he tested this serum upon himself he successfully regenerated his arm, but at the cost of altering his own DNA and turning himself into the vicious creature known as the "Lizard”.

Kraven was born and raised in Russia during the time of the Russian Revolution. Born into an aristocracy that had come to the end, Kraven turned to the hunt in order to fulfill his sense of lost nobility. His talent for the sport led him to Africa, where he was given a potent potion that granted him the abilities and strength of a jungle cat and extended his lifespan. He eventually grew bored of hunting big game and instead decided to turn his focus to hunting the ultimate prey -- Spider-Man!

Russian immigrant Aleksei Sytsevich used his great size and strength as a hired thug for the mafia in hopes of financially supporting his family. When offered money to undergo a secret experiment, he accepted and was thus permanently bonded with a durable polymer armor as tough and powerful as a rhino's hide. With heightened strength and speed, the newly-named Rhino embarked on a criminal career that often puts him head-to-head with his most troublesome adversary, the Amazing Spider-Man!

Quentin Beck began work as a stuntman for movies and became an accomplished special effects wizard. Beck wanted to become an actor, but, without the talent or the looks, he was out of luck. Upon realizing that his dream was not to come true and that his true talent lies with illusion, he turned to a life of villainy to obtain the recognition he craved. He dubbed himself "Mysterio" and has since become one of Spider-Man's most elusive foes.

Adrian Toomes was an electrical engineer and inventor who co-founded Bestman and Toomes Electronics. While working there, he developed an electromagnetic harness which enabled its wearer to fly like a bird. His thirst for revenge grew wild after being betrayed by his business partner, Bestman. Toomes began to use his technology for villainy and became one of Spider-Man's recurring rivals.

Miguel O'Hara is an engineer who worked for Alchemax in the year 2099. He was a genius in the field of genetics, but was reluctant when pressured by his higher-ups to imprint foreign genetic codes onto human physiology. After a test resulting in the hideous transformation and then death of the test subject, O'Hara attempted to resign from his position. However, he had a drink laced with a drug that bonds to the victim's DNA. To counteract the drug, he used a procedure to save himself, splicing his DNA with that of a spider, granting him enhanced senses and abilities.

Carl "Crusher" Creel started out as a boxer under the ringname of "Rocky Davis." After being charged for aggravated assault, he spent time in prison. Here, Loki selected Carl to be an unwitting agent in his scheme against Thor. Loki enchanted a potion of rare Asgardian herbs that Carl would drink, giving him the ability to absorb the physical properties of anything he came in contact with. With that newfound power he escaped from prison and pursued a life of crime.

Mary MacPherran was born prematurely in the suburbs of Denver. As the smallest of several siblings she was often overlooked both at home and at school. Mary had to take up menial jobs to make ends meet and began to grow bitter over her hard life. Using alien tech, she obtained a much taller and more muscular physique with a high level of superhuman strength and durability.

Pietro Maximoff, the son of Magneto and twin brother of Scarlet Witch, was born with superhuman speed as well as an accelerated healing ability. Along with his enhanced physical abilities, Pietro has access to his quick intellect allowing him to think at great speeds. Quicksilver can also utilize molecular acceleration and destabilization, a byproduct of his incredible speed, in order to become intangible when necessary.

Wanda Maximoff is the daughter of Magneto and twin sister of Quicksilver. She is known for her reality altering powers and along with reality warping, Scarlet Witch is able to teleport herself and others over long distances and she is able to manipulate objects with telekinesis. Wanda has expert knowledge of sorcery and is an expert tactician when mentally stable.

En Sabah Nur was born nearly five-thousand years ago in the Valley of the Kings. He was born with gray skin and blue lines running across his mouth inspiring fear even as a child. Apocalypse's original body was immortal, however with the use of celestial technology, he can enter a state of suspended animation to recover from any wounds. He has superhuman physical abilities, psionic powers and an incredible intellect. Apocalypse also has control over his own molecular structure which allows him to biomorph as he pleases.

The son of Cyclops and a clone of Jean Grey, Nathan Summers' destiny was certain even before his parents met. Cable is a genetically superior mutant who has Omega-Level telekinetic abilities. As a child he was infected with a Techno-Organic Virus that would permanently alter his appearance and slowly transform him into a cyborg. To keep this infection from spreading and ultimately killing him, Cable uses his mutant abilities to keep the virus at bay while mastering his physical abilities and becoming master combatant.

Skurge the Executioner is one of Asgard's greatest warriors. He was born the son of a Storm Giant and an Asgardian. With his Storm Giant and Asgardian physiology, Skurge possesses great speed, strength, stamina and durability. He is a formidable hand-to-hand combatant and is particularly adept at wielding a battle-axe.

Valkyrie is the leader of the Valkyrior, the Choosers of the Slain, a group of warrior goddesses who would lead those who have fallen in battle to Valhalla, the land of honored dead. As an Asgardian, Valkyrie has superhuman strength, speed and stamina as well as impressive reflexes and longevity.

Heimdall is an Asgardian with unmatched powers of perception, being able to see and hear across time, it was for these abilities that Odin named him the guardian of the Bifrost. Heimdall also possesses all the abilities typical of Asgardians including strength, speed and stamina. He is also able to project an avatar of himself which often aids in communication and as a warrior, Heimdall is particularly skilled with bladed weaponry.

After gaining superhuman abilities during an antimatter explosion, Blue Marvel became one of the most popular heroes of his time. Although retired, he was forced back into action to face his former best friend and greatest enemy, Anti-Man.

Hailing from the Utopian Parallel, America Chavez possesses superhuman strength, can fly, and has the ability to create inter-dimensional portals. Her toughness and strong leadership abilities have made her an invaluable member of the Young Avengers and the Ultimates.

Aspiring to follow in his father's footsteps to protect the galaxy, young Sam Alexander joined the Nova Corps, an intergalactic peacekeeping force. The Nova Force grants him strength, speed, and the ability to fly, hence the nickname "The Human Rocket."
Formerly a S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent, Avril Kincaid was given the Galactic Quantum Bands and became the new Quasar. As Quasar, she has a vast amount of pure quantum energy at her disposal.

When a lab accident dissolved him into Anti-Matter, Conner Sims became Anti-Man. While he has devastating energy attacks at his disposal, his power is so unstable that he can only exist in our world for brief periods of time.

Cloned from Wolverine's DNA, X-23 is a product of Weapon X, a top-secret genetic research experiment. Though she was created and trained to be a deadly weapon, she broke free and joined the X-Men using her abilities for good.

Genetically engineered to be the ultimate man, the artificial being known as Adam Warlock abandoned his native planet to search for meaning among the stars. A wandering sage, the cosmically powered Warlock specializes in metaphysical or interstellar conflicts.

When A.I.M. ambushed a Stark Industries party where aspiring singer Seol Hee was performing, her attempts to defend the partygoers caused A.I.M. agents to lock her in a storage freezer. During her escape, she knocked over the contents of an energy experiment, exposing her to elements that granted her ice powers which she then used to defeat A.I.M. Her heroic actions made her an overnight sensation, and she continues to use her talent and powers under the name "Luna Snow" -- part time pop star, part-time Super Hero!
Shuri is the younger sister of T'Challa and the princess of Wakanda. A genius inventor and innovative spirit, she uses her skills to create advanced technology for the betterment of Wakanda.

Exiled from Wakanda, Erik Killmonger vows to overthrow T'Challa from the throne and run the nation his way. He is a powerful warrior and also an expert in politics and economics, making him one of Black Panther's most formidable enemies.

A black market arms dealer and smuggler, Ulysses Klaue terrorizes the nation of Wakanda for its most precious resource -- Vibranium. His cybernetic arm gives him enhanced strength and sonic abilities.
Mutant teleporter and sorceress Illyana Rasputina is the ruler of Limbo and the sister of Colossus. She wields the Soulsword, a magical and powerful blade she created with her own life force.

Piotr Rasputin possesses the ability to transform his body in a form of “organic steel” which grants him superhuman durability and strength. Though he is physically one of the strongest X-Men, he has a gentle demeanor and advocates for peace between mutants and humankind.
Warren Worthington III's mutation granted him the ability of winged flight. As one of the original X-Men, he is a harbinger of hope and heroism.

Emma Frost, also known as the White Queen, is a powerful mutant telepath who can transform herself into a pure, organic diamond form. Her moral flexibility makes her an unpredictable villain and sometimes, a reluctant hero.

Brilliant scientist Bill Foster began his career as Dr. Hank Pym's lab assistant, but would soon become a Super Hero in his own right. He synthesized Pym Particles to give himself the ability to grow in size, replicating the powers of his former employer and mentor.

Ghost is a hacker, industrial saboteur, and mercenary with a high-tech suit that grants him invisibility and intangibility. These abilities allow him to phase through objects and stealthily infiltrate his enemies.

The daughter of Hank Pym. Nadia Pym never knew her biological parents, as she was raised in the Red Room until the day she used a Pym Particle sample to escape. She used Hank Pym's resources to create her own Wasp suit, adopting the last name "Van Dyne" because the original Wasp, Janet Van Dyne, was the only person who believed in her and inspired her to become a Super Hero.

Ever-quipping mercenary Wade Wilson’s healing factor—and big mouth—make him one of the most relentlessly wisecracking heroes in the universe. A product of the Weapon X program and dubbed "Merc with a Mouth", he is a wild and unpredictable mercenary with a quip for every occasion.
A skilled mutant mercenary with the ability to manipulate probability in her favor, Neena Thurman's powers lie in her constant and incredible luck.

Developed by the Weapon Plus program, Fantomex is an artificially-evolved, technologically advanced mutant. His enhanced systems and cunning skills in misdirection make him a highly effective operative. His primary nervous system is a detachable techno-organism named E.V.A.

A skilled and deadly martial artist, Elizabeth "Betsy" Braddock is a mutant with powerful telepathic and telekinetic abilities. She wields a variety of psi-powered weapons -- most notably, her signature telekinetic katana blade.
Stryfe is the evil, enhanced, Omega-level clone of Cable. He possesses all of Cable's abilities, including telekinesis, psionics, and telepathy.

Chosen as the Avatar of the Spider-Totem, Peter Parker is the dark guardian of destiny doing the bidding of the great weaver of fate... a role that has shattered his mind into multiple personas: a tech genius, a photographer, a teacher...
The King of Wakanda made a deal with powerful and sinister forces to gain the power to lead and protect his people.

Stark Odinson, the brainy but arrogant son of the All-Father, was kidnapped by Ice Giants and forced to make them an armory. He cleverly turned their forges against them and became the armored Asgardian, Iron Hammer!

On their 23rd attempt, the dark weapons program's mystic combat project was able to produce a viable subject. Now called Laura, she commands incredible power – making her one of the deadliest people on the planet!

Remy LeBeau -- also known as Gambit -- is a charming master thief and member of the X-Men. In addition to being skilled with a bo staff, he is able to charge any inanimate object with kinetic energy, causing them to explode.
Despite his demonic appearance, Nightcrawler is one of the most trusted and respected members of the X-Men. He possesses the ability to teleport and is also a highly skilled swordsman.
Originally created by Dr. Bolivar Trask, Sentinels were constructed with the sole purpose of hunting down and destroying mutants.

Ten year-old Dan Bi grew up in Korea, raised by her missing father, an antiques dealer who was forced to acquire powerful artifacts for the ancient sorceress Morgan Le Fay. When she puts on her father's ancient mask, she is embued with the "half-moon" bear spirit, Io. Together, with their newfound strength and determination, they set off on a quest to find Dan Bi’s father.
Morgan Le Fay is a sorceress from ancient times. Though she was originally a pupil of Merlin, her thirst for power has turned her to darkness.
Ami Han is a super-agent for the South Korean National Intelligence service. As the last of the Kumiho, she brings the mystical powers of the nine-tailed fox to the battlefield.

A scientific genius, and one of the most intelligent humans on earth, Reed Richards led the outer space expedition that changed the Fantastic Four's lives forever. As such, he feels especially responsible for the group's well-being, particularly that of his friend Ben Grimm, who was more physically altered by the cosmic ray's effects than the rest. Though ever-pragmatic and solution-oriented, Reed has found that his hyper-logical approach is not always the best, and has come to rely heavily on the rest of his team for their insight and heart, especially his wife Sue.

The undisputed heart of the Fantastic Four, Sue Storm often finds herself mediating between her teammates' conflicting personalities. Her strength, spirit, and determination are perhaps the greatest among the FF, and she serves as a steady source of inspiration even in dark times. Still, Sue's unique powers of invisibility allow her to slip away when the need to chart her own course arises from time to time.

The hot-headed younger brother of Sue Storm, Johnny appropriately gained fire-based powers from the cosmic rays that transformed his team, which he announces using his trademark cry, "Flame on!" His fiercely independent (and often irresponsible) attitude often leads him into arguments, especially with the more uptight Ben Grimm, who commonly finds himself on the receiving end of Johnny's pranks. Ultimately though, Johnny is a kind soul who cares far more for his strange family than he might seem to on the surface.

Unlike the rest of his team, pilot Ben Grimm was the only member of the Fantastic Four whose outward appearance was changed by the cosmic rays. His body was transformed into a hulking, rock-like “Thing.” Disgusted by his appearance, Ben resigned himself to a life of cursed solitude, until his friends convinced him that he could use his tremendous new power to help others in need. Eventually, Ben came to accept his strange form and put his strength to good use, causing villains everywhere to fear the words, "It's clobberin' time!"
200 lbs (91 kg) / 415 lbs (188 kg) in armor

A brilliant scientist and one-time colleague of Reed Richards', Victor Von Doom's arrogance turned to unfettered megalomania when a lab accident scarred his face for life. Blaming Reed for his own mistake, Von Doom obsessively plotted his revenge, encasing himself in a suit of metal armor and brooding in secret. He staged a violent coup against his home country of Latveria, a small eastern European nation, and emerged as its new ruler, the dreaded Doctor Doom. From his throne, Doom enacts his diabolical machinations, slowed only by the valiant efforts of the Fantastic Four, as well as his own unbridled hubris.

A dedicated patriot and freedom fighter in her homeland of Latveria, Zora Vukovic sought out the reclusive Doctor Doom in his hermitage and convinced him to once again take up the leadership of their nation, which had fallen into ruin in his absence. Having done so, Doom bestowed upon Zora cosmic powers, transforming her into Victorious, the national champion of Latveria.

Nick Fury has proudly served the free world in many capacities over the long years as a U.S. Army sergeant, then as a tech-savvy super-spy, and as Director of the world's preeminent peacekeeping & intelligence organization, S.H.I.E.L.D. Though always reliable, Fury typically works in secret, orchestrating events and communicating to those he can trust from the shadows. Fury comes out fighting when the forces of good are backed against the wall, often resurfacing with vital information and much needed backup when things seem most dire.

Minn-Erva is one of the Kree Empire’s greatest minds. A gifted scientist and member of the Kree Starforce, she gained super-strength and the ability to fly through the Psyche-Magnitron, the same Kree machine that gave Captain Marvel her powers.

A member of the elite Kree Starforce, Korath the Pursuer specializes in tracking down enemies of the Kree Empire to the ends of the galaxy. He possesses augmented strength and can psionically locate individuals by tracing and following their brain patterns.

James Proudstar, known as Warpath, is a powerful mutant of Apache descent. Though he started as a member of the Hellions, he has proven himself a valuable part of many X-Teams over the years, including X-Force. In addition to superhuman strength, speed, and stamina, he is an expert combatant and possesses shamanic abilities and senses.

The Crimson Gem of Cyttorak granted Cain Marko vast brute strength, powering him up to be the unstoppable Juggernaut. One of the strongest beings on earth, he uses his powers for criminal pursuits and destruction.
375 lbs (170 kg) with Adamantium / 275 lbs (125 kg) without Adamantium

Born with deadly claws and fangs, Victor Creed fully embraces his primal nature as Sabretooth. A merciless killer, he possesses superhuman strength and stamina, a healing factor, and the animalistic instinct to kill.
Pepper Potts is the CEO of Stark Industries, as well as one of Tony Stark's most trusted and beloved allies. She dons her own high-tech suit and takes to the skies as the armored hero, Rescue!

The youngest of the original X-Men, Iceman is an Omega-Level Mutant with a lot of potential. He has the ability to create masses of ice by manipulating the moisture in the air. He can also lower the temperature of his target by freezing them.

In a grim future where most of the mutants have been murdered, Bishop creates a police force, the X.S.E., to ensure that any crimes committed by Mutants are handled by others of mutantkind. Despite the fact that he can never return to the future, Bishop goes back to the past in pursuit of criminals, eventually joining the X-Men.

Jubilee serendipitously awakens her mutant powers as she leads a life of crime, but is plunged into danger when mutant hunters suddenly appear. Luckily, she is saved by the X-Men and then meets Professor Charles Xavier, leading her to join the team.

When corrupt scientist Mark Raxton tried to steal an experimental liquid alloy he was developing at Oscorp, he accidentally spilled the substance all over himself. The alloy turned his body into a solid metallic substance, giving him super strength and the ability to generate intense heat. With his newfound powers, he turned to a life of crime as Molten Man to satiate his greed.

Morris Bench, a cargo ship crewman, was accidentally knocked overboard by Spider-Man and sucked into an experimental underwater generator. The cells in his body were turned to water, transforming him into the villain known as Hydro-Man.

While attempting to repair a power line, electrical engineer Maxwell Dillon was caught in a freak lightning accident that transformed him into a living electric capacitor. Able to generate and expel massive quantities of electricity, he uses his powers for evil and often collides head-to-head against Spider-Man.

Half-human and half-Atlantean, the mutant Namor the Sub-Mariner has fought both with and against mankind. Though he has been both a hero and a villain to the surface world, his priority is always to protect his kingdom of Atlantis and its people.

Norrin Radd serves as the herald of Galactus, the devourer of worlds. Imbued with the Power Cosmic and a board that travels faster than the speed of light, he crosses the distant stars and universes as the Silver Surfer.

Born in the Philippines, Pearl Pangan always showed an affinity for water and swimming from a very young age, becoming a championship swimmer with Olympic aspirations by high school. However, when AlonTech recruited her for swimming ability tests, she was accidentally exposed to an illegal biotech chemical. Now with telekinetic powers over water molecules, Pearl stands against all threats as the Super Hero Wave, one of the newest members of the Agents of Atlas!

An ordinary girl, Kitty Pryde's mutant powers awakened at age 13 with the ability to freely pass through matter. Kitty was targeted by the Hellfire Club but was rescued before they used her powers for evil. Now, she helps save mutants like her by taking them to Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters and protecting them as one of the X-Men!

Rachel Summers, the daughter of Jean Grey and Scott Summers from another dimension, is an elite mutant who possesses powerful telepathic and psychokinetic abilities. She is a potential host of the Phoenix Force, having inherited her mother's power. After being rescued from a dark timeline, she actively supports her fellow X-Men across time and space as the new Marvel Girl!

Quentin Quire is a powerful telepath recognized as both a genius and an Omega Level Mutant. While attending the Jean Grey School of Higher Learning, he infuriated his teachers, such as Wolverine, with his antics and tendency to rebel. Now a member of the West Coast Avengers, Kid Omega fights to save the world from all threats, including its own stupidity.

Once an American psychologist, Jericho Drumm became a voodoo priest after the death of his twin brother Daniel. After leveraging his tremendous talent to became a master Houngan, Jericho became a Sorcerer Supreme, using the mystic arts to save the mortal realm. Now, Doctor Voodoo defend the world against the forces evil with his phenomenal voodoo powers.

Lei Ling, a prominent Chinese architect, defends Shanghai with her powers of aerokinesis. When not constructing skyscrapers, she controls the air, flying through the sky, by creating powerful gusts of wind. As an agent of Agent of Atlas, Aero works to protect Shanghai, the world, and beyond.

When he was young, Lin Lie enjoyed solving puzzles and studying history. However, after being attacked by the demonic forces of Chiyou, the special magic sword left by his missing father activated in order to protect him. Now the Sword Master, he delves into the mystery surrounding his father's disappearance and protects the world with the Fuxi Sword.

As a junior high school student, Steven Harmon hunted down the clowns who kidnapped his friend by entering a mirror-like portal. After crossing thousands of dimensions through the portal, Steve's body became composed of unstable molecules, transforming him into a living cartoon character. With many wacky, unreal abilities, he battles bad guys with his wide variety of tricks, goofs, and gags.

Kenneth Hale, once an ordinary human soldier, killed a legendary gorilla on his quest for immortality. After he slew it, Ken gained the immortal life he sought, but was cursed to live as a gorilla. Now with massive strength and superhuman stamina, Gorilla-Man heroically fights as a member of the G-MEN, Howling Commandos, and Mercs for Money.

Ellie Phimister was once a student of Emma Frost's telepathy class in the mutant country, Genosha. Because of her strong precognitive ability, she struggled as various groups sought her power for their own desires. On her journeys, she met Deadpool and saw another future fighting with the Merc with a Mouth. Deciding to join Deadpool as his assistant, the Negasonic Teenage Warhead seeks fortune with her fellow Mercs.

Defending the East, Blue Dragon possesses the ability to transform whatever she touches into a draconic weapon. With her heirloom spear whip in hand, this child of Vietnamese nobles leads the Warriors of the Sky with her protective spirit and wise judgment through any challenge they may encounter.

Leaping from the West, the massive War Tiger slices through evil with the mystical Tiger’s Fang. This ancient Thai general ensures the success of his fellow Warriors of the Sky with his immense power and hardened combat experience.

Strategizing in the North, Shadow Shell disables enemies from afar and defends her teammates with her highly advanced rifle and Ba Gua energy shield. When Shadow Shell’s adopted family in Taiwan attempted to poison her, the extremely intelligent tactician gained her unseen powers of toxic immunity and now provides battle strategy for the Warriors of the Sky.

Soaring into battle as guardian of the South, the searing Sun Bird provides healing support for the Warriors of the Sky. With agile charm, this Malaysian pirate from the 1600s reborn by the power of his twin krises seeks to make the most of his new life by supporting the world however possible.

Helmut Zemo, the thirteenth baron of the Zemo family, was molded by his father to rule the world. Now, he fights against heroes with his strategic genius and incredible swordsmanship. Baron Zemo stands against the heroes of the world to wreak havoc and claim his rightful power.

As an orphan, Ophelia Sarkissian joined Hydra and was taught by the head of Hydra, Kraken. She grew up to become head of the evil organization under the name of Madame Hydra, leading them with an iron fist. A brilliant strategist and master of combat, the toxic Viper sends a wave of fear through her followers and targets alike.

Tony Masters, a former S.H.E.I.L.D. agent, was born with the ability to perfectly mimic the movements of others, even the most difficult techniques. After being exposed to a flawed super-soldier serum, he lost the memories of his family and past. Now, Taskmaster is a mercenary, oftentimes working for villains, training criminals with the many memorized techniques of heroes and villains alike.

Charles Xavier, an incredibly powerful telepathic mutant, spent his life fighting for the peaceful coexistence between humans and mutants. He founded the Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters to teach young mutants how to use their abilities and also created the iconic superhero team known as the X-Men. Together, they defend the world from all threats and fight for the betterment of mutants around the world.

Raven Darkholme, a shapeshifting mutant and spy, has been an integral part of the Brotherhood of Mutants, even leading the team with the idea that mutants should rule over man. Deceiving others with her ability to shapeshift, she teeters between fighting alongside the X-Men, all mutants, and delving into darker espionage to further her own goals.

Biologist Nathaniel Essex casually carried out immoral biological experiments, dreaming of perfecting the evolution of mankind. One fateful encounter brought him before En Sabah Nur who imparted unto him his mutant power, further fueling his desire to experiment. His advanced studies of genetics continually make him a threat to mutants and humans alike.

Alexi Shostakov was an incredible pilot in the Soviet Union, catching the notice of the KGB. The organization arranged a wedding between him and Natasha Romanov, the famed Black Widow. However, after furthering his devotion to his country, Alexei took on the title of Red Guardian, a direct counter to Captain America, and ended his marriage. A man devoted to country above all else, Red Guardian succeeds in any mission where the fate of Russia is on the line.

Yelena Belova is a highly trained assassin gifted in hand-to-hand combat and espionage after training in the infamous Russian Red Room. After becoming a Black Widow, she battled against Natasha Romanov, another graduate of the Red Room who had abandoned Russia, to prove herself truly worthy of the title of Black Widow. As an excellent spy with a taste for battle, this Black Widow takes her knowledge and abilities to any part of the world in need of her skills.

Beta Ray Bill is a Korbinite, a race of extraterrestrials that lived peacefully for thousands of years. Beta Ray Bill volunteered to be a champion to his people for his strength and courage, and underwent a bio-engineering experiment to enhance his power. Now, wielding the mighty Stormbreaker gifted to him by Odin, he roams the universe, protecting any who are in need.

Phyla-Vell, a heroine from another universe, escaped from her universe during an incident known as the Infinity Wars. While exploring her new realm, she received a suggestion from Star-Lord to join the Guardians of the Galaxy. Now, as a member of the Guardians, she fights for peace in the universe with her Quantum Sword in hand!

Christopher Powell, an ordinary boy in New York City, discovered a strange amulet while trying to escape a mob boss. The amulet transformed him into a Darkhawk, a Shi'Ar android infused with extra-dimensional magic. Using his amazing powers to gain an edge against crime, he spreads his wings to go beyond the protection of Earth, journeying through the rest of the galaxy on a quest to defeat evil.

Richard Rider was an everyday New York teenager before he was chosen by the last survivor of the Nova Legion to become his successor as Nova Prime. After defending his city for a time, he was called into space to protect the newly rebuilt Xandar, home of the Nova Corps. With the ability to access the Super Intelligence known as Worldmind, Nova has defended the universe against numerous threats, as few can match his power and even fewer his speed.

Kallark served as an imperial guard of the Emperor of the Shi'Ar before becoming their Praetor. While he feels most comfortable as a warrior of his people, Gladiator took up the mantle as emperor of the Shi'Ar after the loss of their leaders over the course of several intergalactic wars. Though an adept leader, Gladiator earns his respect from heroes across the universe for his decisiveness in battle and his nearly unparalleled power.
110 lbs (50 kg, Betty); 700 lbs (317 kg, Red She-Hulk)

Elizabeth Ross, daughter of General Thaddeus Ross, met Bruce Banner during their research of the Gamma Bomb, eventually falling in love and marrying him. After her death at the hands of Abomination, she returned as the Red She-Hulk, able to manifest her rage as superhuman strength while being able to absorb all forms of radioactive energy.
180 lbs (82 kg, Blonsky); 980 lbs (444 kg, Abomination)

After being exposed to gamma radiation, secret agent Emil Blonsky transformed into the massive monster known as Abomination. Gaining dangerous abilities while retaining his intelligence, Blonsky became the eternal archenemy of the Hulk, having matched his power through countless battles.

Alison Blaire dreamed of becoming a famous singer long before her mutant powers awakened. Before she ever joined the X-Men, she performed under the stage name “Dazzler.” With the ability to manipulate sound by transforming it into hard light, she made her shows all the more entertaining with her personal special effects. However, it wasn't long until she realized that her gifts could be used for a greater purpose. She now leverages her vocal and mutant powers to save all she can as a Superhero.

Thane is the secret son of an Inhuman mother and Thanos. For ages before his Inhuman genes awakened, Thane lived under the rule of Black Bolt with his fellow Inhumans. However, when a Terrigen bomb exploded during a massive war with Thanos, Thane's incredible powers over life and death awakened. Confused about his power and purpose, Thane was manipulated by Ebony Maw into following a path of evil. Now, he fights to become the sole ruler of the universe, vowing to best his father and any who oppose him.

Ben Reilly, more commonly known as the Scarlet Spider, is a clone of Peter Parker created during an experiment by the villainous Jackal. Implanted with Peter Parker's memories as well as all of his arachnid abilities, Ben believed he was the real Spider-Man and fought Peter Parker to claim his existence as the original. Eventually, Ben came to terms with being a clone and carved out his own path as the web-slinging hero known as the Scarlet Spider.

Michael Morbius, a profoundly successful biochemist, learned that he was dying of a blood disease. In desperation, he turned to using vampire bats in search of a cure. However, he instead transformed into a pseudo-vampire, gaining a number of supernatural abilities along with a thirst for blood. Now, after years cleansing himself of villainous tendencies, Morbius stalks the night as an antihero, draining the life of villains while solving numerous occult events.

Jessica Drew, the daughter of the renowned scientist Jonathan Drew, was injected with a regenerative and immunological serum composed of spider blood in order to save her life. After being put into stasis for decades, she developed amazing arachnid abilities and ventured into the world. She has since found herself as an agent for both Hydra and S.H.I.E.L.D., a private detective, a Spider-Hero, a mother, and, after a terrifying stint of being replaced by a Skrull, a full-fledged member of the Avengers.

Andi Benton was an average high school student when Flash Thompson, the once Agent Venom, became her P.E. teacher. When a portion of Flash's symbiote merged with her, she started down the long path of becoming a permanent partner to the alien life form. During the events of Absolute Carnage, Andi managed to free a rampaging symbiote from Knull's control, during which time Carnage mortally wounded her. In order to save the one that freed it, the yellow symbiote merged with Andi, together becoming Scream!

Robert Reynolds, a former addict, stole the Golden Sentry Serum from a laboratory researching a way to recreate and enhance the Super Soldier Serum. However, upon consuming the serum, the power of a million suns exploded within Bob, transforming him into the Sentry. He has been hailed as the most powerful hero on Earth; however, within him lies the dark side of his million suns: a destructive entity known as The Void. While he battles to contain his alter ego, the Sentry always strives to become a true hero and fight for all things good.

When Investigator Mac Gargan was hired to uncover Spider-Man's identity, he took part in a genetic experiment, which infused him with the power and agility of a scorpion. However, while he gained great power, he lost his sanity and became a violent villain known as the Scorpion. Equipped with technology that allows him to embody his namesake, he has vowed to defeat Spider-Man at all costs, joining many a villainous team in order to achieve his goals.

Ares is the god of ancient warfare, hailing from the godly dimension of Olympus. After many centuries of battle, Ares finally found himself amongst heroes like him during the modern era, battling as both hero and villain over the years. After the secret invasion of the Skrull, Ares accepted a position on Norman Osborn's Avengers, fighting to instill order upon the world.

Akihiro was adopted by another Japanese family after the loss of his mother, not knowing the power of his lineage. After a childhood filled with turmoil, this son of Wolverine accepted the slur that he had been secretly called his entire life: Daken. He has since sought revenge against his father, seeking retribution for the pain he had endured due to his supposed abandonment. After many years on this path of villainy, Daken now fights as a hero alongside his fellow X-Factor teammates.

Dr. Karla Sofen was once an incredible psychiatrist, often participating in unethical manipulation of her patients. After persuading the original Moonstone into giving her the Kree artifact that acted as his sole source of power, Karla took on the mantle and the power of the former hero. The moonstone gives her immense powers, revolving around energy blasts, gravity manipulation, and flight. After using her stolen gifts as a supervillain, Moonstone joined the Dark Avengers and the Thunderbolts to deliver her unique form of justice.

Owen Reece was once an ordinary man working for ACME Atomics Corporation, hoping his hard work would earn him recognition. After suffering an accident while repairing a device powered by atomic energy, Owen was engulfed in radiation, transforming his body into a molecular being capable of manipulating matter and energy at the smallest level. Now known as the Molecule Man, Owen wields his tremendous power to impact the universe on an incalculable scale.

Knull, the Lord of the Abyss, existed before the universe exploded into being. After sleeping in the endless abyss, he rampaged across all of space, decimating entire galaxies with his armies of symbiotes. After being imprisoned for eons, the King in Black now begins his invasion of Earth as he sets out to conquer the universe.

Ikaris is the most powerful warrior of the Eternals, beings created by the Celestials to defend the Earth from the threat of the Deviants. Known as the "Prime Eternal," the leader of his people fights alongside his own kind, as well as other heroes of humanity, against those who threaten the world with evil intentions.

Sersi, another member of the Eternals, has been the closest to humans throughout her eons of life. As a witness of Earth's long history, she stood alongside many famous warriors to defend the planet, including the Avengers. Despite her desire for a normal human life, Sersi fights for her own people and all who live on the planet they share.

Mephisto is the sole ruler of his own hellish dimension. A malevolent collector of souls, this vulgar and wicked hell-lord has committed countless evil deeds throughout the history of the universe with a particular focus on Earth. He threatens the entire mortal realm with his powers, such as contracting with humans to claim their souls or transforming into twisted forms beyond human comprehension.

Monica Rambeau gained the extraordinary ability to transform into an energy form after getting exposed to a dangerous weapon while serving with the New Orleans Harbor Patrol. Having once carried the title of Captain Marvel, she changed her name to Spectrum to claim her own identity and eventually joined the Ultimates to protect the Earth and solve interdimensional catastrophes.

Shang-Chi's father is the feared leader of the Ten Rings organization, which has lurked in the shadows for ages. The experienced and masterful Wenwu utilizes direct, explosive strikes that stop his opponents in their tracks. He wields the Ten Rings, a mystical weapon that grants the wearer unimaginable power, including immortality. Worn on his arms, the Ten Rings, combined with his knowledge of Tiger Style Kung Fu, make Wenwu an unstoppable force.

As Shang-Chi's oldest and closest friend, Katy is free-spirited, carefree, and fiercely loyal. Katy is a stalwart companion with her own journey of self-discovery who accompanies Shang-Chi on his quest to free himself from his past. With her bow in hand, Katy strikes at the heart of villainy with precision and pointed sarcasm.

As one of the Eternals, Makkari has spent her time protecting mankind from the threat of the Deviants for millennia. She is the fastest of the Eternals and can generate massive sonic booms by breaking the sound barrier. She has developed her abilities through exploring the world countless times.
Kingo is one of the Eternals who protected humanity for a long time. Once a free-spirited samurai active in Japan, he now uses his talents as an action movie star.

Daughter of Zuras, Thena is one of the greatest warriors among the Eternals. After losing all of her memories of the Eternals, Thena found herself living a mortal life as a researcher at Stark Industries. Eventually, she regained her memories and rejoined the fight to protect her own people, summoning weapons of all sorts with her cosmic energy.

Gilgamesh is the most powerful warrior among the Eternals. Although he has been called by various names since ancient times and served as a hero to humans, he was expelled from the Eternals for his excessive interference with the affairs of Earth. Having regained his freedoms, this unstoppable cosmic force returned to Earth to protect all of the planet's inhabitants along with the many heroes of the modern age.

After the death of her father, Maya Lopez was taken under the wing of Kingpin, becoming a master assassin and brawler by the name of Echo. However, after learning the truth of her father's passing through Daredevil, Maya left Kingpin to become a hero of her own. With the ability to perfectly imitate the movements of others, Echo defeats villains with her exceptional martial arts skills and has recently become the host of the Phoenix Force.

An ordinary inhabitant of a nameless planet, Gorr lost his family during times of great strife. When given the opportunity to meet his god, Gorr was ridiculed and had his wishes denied. In his fury, Gorr awoke the power of the Necrosword, vowing vengeance on all the gods who shun the mortals that believe in them.

Toxin is a symbiote created by Carnage through self-reproduction. Having acted as a villain while attached to a police officer, Toxin found himself almost destroyed at the hands of Chthon. After surviving this crisis and the arrival of Knull, Toxin latched onto a teenage boy named Bren Waters to serve as a hero amongst his fellow symbiotes.

M'BAKU is the chieftain and brave warrior of the Jabari tribe. At T'Challa's succession ceremony, M'BAKU opposed T'Challa's attempt to become king in a duel upon Warrior Falls, only to face defeat and return to his village in the mountains. Eventually, M'BAKU recognized T'Challa as a friend and leader, fighting alongside him to best any threats to Wakanda.

Magneto's daughter, Lorna Dane, having inherited her father's abilities, is one of the most powerful Mutants in the world. After awakening her mutant powers at a young age, her hair turned green and she gained the ability to manipulate magnetic forces. Once a villain, she later joins the X-Men to stand in support of Mutants and world peace, taking the name 'Polaris'.

Cassie Lang, the daughter of Ant-Man, Scott Lang, has always supported her father. Having grown up with a particularly active mind, Cassie started making various devices to help her father. However, after one particular experiment went haywire, Cassie found herself alongside her family, lost in the Quantum Realm. Thus, Cassie's journey to becoming a hero begins with fighting alongside her father to protect the world.

Spot possesses the ability to travel to the unknown Spotted Dimension, allowing him to warp through space by extending his own body and using teleportation. Using the black spots across his white body as portals, moves through spaces or move his opponents to commit crime as a Super Villain. Scheming towards an unknown evil goal, Spot has encountered Spider-Man on numerous occasions as a regular enemy.

As one of many Kangs, Nathaniel Richards calls himself the Conqueror and destroys countless timelines to rule the Multiverse. Exiled by other Kangs for the sake of establishing order in all dimensions, he became trapped in the Quantum Realm. However, Kang the Conqueror raised an army in the Quantum Realm and set out to enact his plan to conquer all dimensions after he escaped his prison.

Once known as Arkady Rossovich, Omega Red was born of a super soldier program similar to the one that made Captain America.
