Tentacles made of Carbonadium, a flexible man-made alloy similar to Adamantium, were implanted inside the Omega Red's arms. However, in order to stabilize Omega Red's state, he needs either a Carbonadium synthesizer or to drain the life force of others, which has led him into many a conflict with Wolverine and other X-Men.

Once a human scientist secretly developing a drug similar to the Super Soldier Serum for a government agency, Theodore "Ted" Sallis found himself face-to-face with A.I.M. on their quest for power. With nowhere to turn, he administered the faulty serum in attempt to save his life as he fell into a swamp. However, instead of dying, he became a monster fused with the Florida Everglades. Now with memories of a previous life and his humanity largely lost, the Man-Thing guards the Nexus of All Realities as a mystical defender.

Another version of the Asgardian trickster god Loki from an alternate timeline, Sylvie has traveled across worlds in order to escape deletion at the hands of the TVA. She has managed to escape capture across all of time through the wily use of her magic powers and stolen temporal technology.

From a timeline when the Tesseract fell in pre-independence America, Kahhori hails from the Mohawk tribe, one of the five Native American tribes of the Iroquois Confederacy, with powers given by the Space Stone.

Alex Summers is a Mutant who has the ability to absorb energy from the world around him and emit it as powerful plasma blasts. When his abilities first manifested, he suffered many hardships due to not being able to control them, but after joining the X-Men, he worked hard and was gradually able to control them.

Hope Summers, known as the Messiah of Mutants, is the first Mutant born after M-Day. Considered the new hope for mutants from birth, she was trained and raised by her stepfather, Cable, until she became the host of the full Phoenix Force. She then reversed the effects of M-Day, allowing new Mutants to be born once again. She has the power to mimic the abilities of all Mutants, and thanks to Cable's training, she is also adept at using firearms.

Born as a nobleman in medieval France in the 12th century, Bennet du Paris had awakened as a Mutant through the hardships during the Crusades. Bennett possesses incredible psionic abilities that become stronger as more people believe in him and is one of the most powerful Mutants. He always acts for Mutantkind, but his stubborn beliefs often bring out the worst in him.

Madelyne Pryor is a clone of Jean Grey created by Mister Sinister. As Scott Summers' wife, she was devastated when he couldn't forget Jean Grey. After separating, her emotions gradually turned into hatred and anger, and her darkness transformed her into the Goblin Queen. As a clone of Jean Grey, she possesses exceptional psionic abilities and has become even more powerful through her connection to the hellish dimension of Limbo.

Ikon, a Galadorian Spaceknight of the Alpha Class level, possesses the ability to evaluate the strengths and weaknesses of the opponents. Equipped with the advanced intergalactic technology of Galador, Ikon has served as a member of the Annihilators with her indestructible poleaxe.

Wendell Vaughn was once a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent bonded to the Quantum Bands owned during an experiment gone wrong at the hands of A.I.M. After undergoing special training, Vaughn gained control of his powers through the Quantum Bands, eventually learning of their special purpose: to designate the protector of the universe. Accepting his fate, Vaughn took off to the stars to protect countless planets as Quasar.

Born into the royal family of the Hidden City, Yabbat Ummon Turru joined the ranks of the Black Swans, women of immense power that guard the Library of Worlds. Ascending to the title herself, she served the great destroyer Rabum Alal, another name for Doctor Doom, along with the rest of her coven. After she abandoning her affiliation with Doom, she joined the Black Order and now follows the Mad Titan, Thanos.

Franklin Richards, the son of Reed Richards and Susan Storm of the Fantastic Four, and the older brother of Valeria Richards, has been one of the most powerful beings in the universe since childhood as he possesses the ability to manipulate reality. Having saved the entire universe with Omega-level superpowers, he and his family are protecting the young teenager to keep his powers from being used by evildoers.

Valeria Richards is the daughter of Reed Richards and Susan Storm of the Fantastic Four as well as the younger sister of Franklin. When she was in danger of dying from the radiation of the Negative Zone while Susan was pregnant with her, Franklin sent her to another universe where she grew up as "Valeria von Doom", the daughter of Doctor Doom. She vanished while saving the world with the Fantastic Four and was then reincarnated as "Valeria Richards" with Franklin's powers. She is one of the smartest girls in the world and protects the universe with her family.

Cassandra Nova was a life form known as "Mummudrai". A bodyless parasitic species made up of psychic energy, she copied Charles Xavier's DNA and grew as a twin in the same womb, but Charles, sensing her innate evil, killed her instinctively. However, Cassandra Nova was able to survive and reconstitute herself using her powers. She feels intense hatred toward Charles Xavier and seeks to destroy the trust he has built between mutants and humans.

Okoye is a general of Wakanda and a director of the Dora Milaje, a special security unit. Growing up with T'Challa since childhood, she fiercely protects the king of Wakanda not only as a bodyguard but also as a friend.

Sleeper is the seventh descendant of Venom, created in the laboratory of the chemical company Alchemax. Venom and Eddie were concerned that the young symbiote would go berserk if it bonded with its host, so they decided to entrust it to Alchemax's care. Unlike Carnage, Sleeper, who grew up with a just heart, mostly stays in the cat form. However, he uses his chemical powers when needed.

Samuel Sterns, an ordinary worker at a chemical research plant, gained superpowers after an accident while transporting radioactive waste. With the gamma power, he gained the potential to have a Limitless Superhuman Intelligence and a hideous appearance, becoming the Hulk's greatest opponent against his infinite power.

Joaquín, born in Mexico, moved to the U.S. at age six. At age seventeen, he was kidnapped while helping border crossers and subjected to experiments by Dr. Karl Malus, who turned him into a falcon/human hybrid using the vampirc falcon Redwing's genetic material, leading him to become the second Falcon and partner to Sam Wilson, the new Captain America.

John Walker enlisted in the U.S. Army to serve and to pay tribute to his brother who died in the war. However, after the war, John realized that it was hard to become a hero, and he joined the Power Broker Corporation's super soldier project to become the U.S. agent. He once took over as Captain America from Steve Rogers, and is currently a member and a leader of various Avengers teams.

Roberto Da Costa is a mutant with the ability to harness the power of the sun. Originally from a wealthy Brazilian family, Roberto became a target of mutant haters when he activated his powers. After being rescued by Professor Xavier, Roberto uses his wealth and insight to bring peace to mutants and humanity, and is now a key member of the New Mutants.

Parker Robbins dropped out of high school to pay his mother's medical bills and entered the world of crime. One day while he was out stealing, Parker was attacked by a caped demon, but Parker shot the demon dead. After acquiring the demon's cape and boots, he discovered that these items gave him special abilities. Parker Robbins, who had always dreamed of becoming a supervillain, gradually became corrupted by the cursed power and turned into a cruel demon himself.

Shalla-Bal was the lover of Norrin Radd. In order to protect her beloved homeland, Zenn-La and its people, she took Norrin Radd's place as the Silver Surfer and became Galactus' herald, the messenger of the planet's demise.

Dane Whitman, a gifted scientist, became the third Black Knight following in his uncle Nathan Garrett's footsteps. After defeating the demon sealed in the cursed Ebony Blade, he was recognized as the true Black Knight, using his formidable but unstable powers for good.

Hercules, the hero of heroes, is a mythical figure who has conquered countless challenges, including the legendary Twelve Labors. Beneath his immense strength, the Olympian Lion carries a compassionate heart. Together with his best friend, Amadeus Cho, he sets out on a new adventure to face yet another threat.

Hades is the Olympian god of death and the supreme being of the underworld, presiding over the souls of the dead. However, not content with simply being the tyrant of the underworld, he is constantly seeking to seize more souls.

Zeus, the god of the sky and ruler of Olympus, was revered by the mortals of ancient Greece and Rome. An immortal being possessed by immense power and authority, he commands thunder and lightning, and together with his children, Ares, Athena, Aphrodite, and Hercules, he protects the Olympian realm.

Athena, goddess of wisdom and war, is one of the Olympians. Worshipped by ancient Greeks and Romans, she was born from Zeus’s forehead after he swallowed her and her mother, Metis, to avoid a prophecy of his downfall. Today, she continues to guide heroes in times of need.

\nVenus, one of the world's most influential and long-revered goddesses of love, was originally called Aphrodite by her early worshippers, the ancient Greeks. Even today, she remains the most beautiful woman on Olympus, and is still revered by those who desire beauty.

Noh-Varr was a Kree living in the alternate reality of Earth-200080. Recruited for an experiment to alter cockroach DNA, he become a Kree super-soldier and a member of the "18th Kree Diplomatic Gestalt" to negotiate peace with the Skrulls. However, a conflict with a cosmic entity led to his loss in the multiverse and his ship and crew were destroyed by the cosmic power-obsessed Dr. Midas on Earth-616. Now settled on Earth-616, he uses his powers as a member of various hero teams, including the Guardians of the Galaxy and the Young Avengers.
250 lbs (113.4 kg) (without armor), 310 lbs (140.61 kg) (with armor)

Born the son of yakuza boss Shingen Harada, he was rejected and scorned by his family because of his mutant nature. He trained in samurai swordsmanship and learned how to apply his mutant powers to his blade, gaining the ability to cut through most substances. He sometimes allied with villains to become a Hydra mercenary, and sometimes joined forces with heroes, all for his own interest and beliefs.

Originally created by M.O.D.O.K. as part of a pack of land sharks meant to attack the West Coast Avengers, Jeff turned out to be very different from the rest. Small, sweet, and lethally adorable, he quickly won over Gwenpool, who adopted him after being charmed by his irresistible level of cuteness. Now, Jeff serves as the West Coast Avengers' beloved and mischievous mascot.

Kevin Sidney, known among the X-Men for his lighthearted spirit and ability to lift morale, is a hero gifted with remarkable shapeshifting powers. During a mission gone wrong, he is gravely wounded by Sentinels and taken in by Mister Sinister, who manipulates his mind and turns him against everything he once stood for. With the help of Professor X, Kevin eventually breaks free from Sinister's control. Reclaiming his identity and purpose, he returns to the X-Men, determined to use his abilities once more in the fight for justice.

Driven by relentless paranoia and a fanatical obsession with survival, Annihilus reigns over the Negative Zone. Wielding the almighty Cosmic Control Rod, he leads the vast, terrifying insectoid forces of the Annihilation Wave. After waging a universe-spanning war that destroyed whole star systems and siphoned the power of Galactus himself, he stands as one of the ultimate threats to all existence.

Galactus is a cosmic entity who devours the life energy of entire worlds. Functioning as both a force of universal balance and a living calamity, he traditionally dispatches a herald to announce incoming destruction. Though once virtually unstoppable, he fell victim to Annihilus’s scheme, having his powers stolen and his physical form diminished. Now, he enters the world of Future Fight to restore his power and unleash his wrath upon Annihilus.

[FFEB00]What is the Superhuman Registration Act?[-]\nThe government has ordered the world's Super Heroes\nto sign the "Superhuman Registration Act" to regulate their actions.
[FFEB00]What is PREDICTIVE JUSTICE?[-]\n Using Super Hero abilities to see the future\nand shutting down potential crimes before they occur.
[FFEB00]THE THUNDERBOLTS PROGRAM[-]\nenables Super Villains to assemble and get rehabilitated.

[FFEB00]What is the Terrigen War?[-]\nThe Inhumans and X-Men are fighting for control of the Terrigen Mist.
The government has ordered the world's Super Heroes to sign the "Superhuman Registration Act" to regulate their actions.
Predictive Justice uses Super Hero abilities to see the future\nand shuts down potential crimes before they occur.
Program to rehabilitate and assemble Super Villains into a special task force.
Grants permission for vigilantes like Punisher to punish criminals directly, outside of the law.
Terrigen Mist helps Inhumans manifest and harness their hidden abilities, but poisons Mutants. This is causing an intense rift between the two factions.

- The reckless acts of a few young heroes have resulted in a large explosion in the middle of the city resulting in the loss of innocent lives.\n\n - Since then, public sentiment now leans towards the managing of all Heroes. As a solution, The Superhuman Registration Act, which restricts Heroes from superhuman activity unless they are registered with the government, has been proposed.

- With the arrival of the Inhumans who can see into the future, a team of Heroes has been formed to prevent crimes before they happen.\n\n - However, during this process, an unpredicted problem occurs and the discord between the Heroes begin to grow.

- To fight against the growing number of criminals, a team of Super Villains is formed, the Thunderbolts.\n\n - The Thunderbolts show great promise until conflict brews among its members. Now the public demands their disbandment.
- Trust in the law begins to wane as more and more villains live above the law.\n\n - Civilians begin to distrust the law and demand harsher punishment for crime.
- Tensions are at an all-time high between the Inhumans and X-men because of the Terrigen Mist.\n\n - Agents must prepare to face the threats that will arise from the two colliding factions.
Scientific and technological advancements are necessary to protect the Earth from supernatural phenomena and cosmic threats. However, reckless development can be even more dangerous.
Mutantkind has decided to rise up from Krakoa and reclaim their rights once and for all.\nTheir confrontation could be the beginning of a great war that could plunge the entire world into chaos.
Iron Man is for the Superhuman Registration Act, as he believes that Heroes should be better managed and educated.
Captain Marvel believes that if there is even a 1% chance of preventing crime, then it is imperative to do anything possible.
Luke Cage uses his formidable charisma to lead the Thunderbolts and help them rehabilitate into better people.
Punisher doesn’t believe in the law, instead he believes in his own conviction to punish wrongdoers.
The Inhumans seek to protect the Terrigen Mist. It is required for the advancement of their people as it is the catalyst that manifests their Inhuman abilities.
Reckless advances in science and technology can have side effects. In order to keep the right balance, proper management is essential.
Mutants are extremely powerful, and a unified movement among mutantkind could throw the world into chaos. Negotiations are necessary for the world to survive.
Captain America believes in the free will of all Super Heroes. He is against the Registration Act because he knows that once registered, Heroes can be manipulated to work for the government.
Iron Man is against using the Inhumans to look into the future and preventing crimes because the future is not determined, but rather one option among many options.
Captain Marvel is against the Thunderbolts because she is worried that the violent nature of the Super Villains could betray good at any time.
Daredevil is strongly against making subjective judgments on criminals and believes everyone should go through due process.
The X-Men have to destroy the Terrigen Mist in order to save Mutantkind. Mutants exposed to Terrigen Mist become sterile and contract the terminal illness M-Pox.
A variety of supernatural forces across the vast universe pose unknown threats. To create a peaceful future for our planet, we must arm ourselves with more advanced science and technology.
We Mutants have endured so much to maintain order throughout our long history. Now is the time to prove our right to exist amongst everyone else.

The heroes have arrived at Necropolis and have begun to search for Black Panther.
Wolverine arrived at Necropolis and witnessed Storm, an ex-member of the X-Men, attacking the city. She must be stopped before she causes even more damage.
Storm summoned a torrential rain to drown the streets of Wakanda, putting the citizens in danger. The citizens must be saved.
After saving the citizens, Wolverine finds that Storm has sustained severe injuries. In order to treat her injuries, he goes into the jungles of Wakanda to find a special herb that only grows there.
Wolverine must help Black Panther make the potion that will treat Storm.
Storm must be treated with Black Panther’s medicine.
Storm was unable to recover with just the potion. Her soul has departed for another dimension. Wolverine must find the Ancient Book of Reapers in Necropolis to treat Storm.
In order to recover Storm’s soul, the proper incantation must be found in the Book of Reapers.
Wolverine and Black Panther were able to open a portal to another world with the Book of Reapers, but it wasn’t Storm’s soul that returned, but ancient demons. The demons must be destroyed.

After defeating the demons, Storm was able to get her soul back, but she is still in critical condition. Black Panther plans to use a tribal ritual to move Wolverine’s healing power into Storm to heal her.
The damages Storm levied on Wakanda must be restored.
Black Panther learns that Storm was being controlled by Maximus using high tech equipment capable of working from long distances. Wakanda must be searched in order to find the missing equipment.
Magneto is attacking New Attilan once again. It must be protected.
The robot army lead by Magneto is stronger than ever. Retreat and recoup.
Wolverine and his team returned to the X-Mansion to investigate the reason for the sudden power surge by the robots.
The Inhuman robots were enhanced with Vibranium, a rare metal that is only found in Wakanda. Black Panther must be contacted to find a way to destroy the robots.
Hydra was found to have been supplying Vibranium to Maximus. Attack Hydra to cut off the Vibranium supply.
According to Black Panther, a semimetal material can solve the Vibranium problem. This rare semimetal material must be found.
Rogue and Beast must search the wasteland in sub-zero temperatures to find the semimetal material.

Wolverine is being attacked in the frozen wilderness by Cyclops, who is being mind-controlled. In order to prevent Maximus from getting his hands on the semimetal material, the X-Men member must be stopped.
Cyclops is gravely injured in battle. He must be treated.
Rogue and Beast must continue their search even with Hydra’s attempt to stop them.
After meeting up with Cyclops, you must now return with New Attilan.
After returning from New Attilan, Wolverine must use the semimetal to get rid of the robots and Magneto.
The Beast begins his research to develop a machine that can prevent Maximus’ skills.
You must help Beast concentrate on his research.
You must get back to X-mansion to use Cerebro.
Robots have invaded X-mansion, but all semimetals were used in new Attilan and the heroes must use their own strength to fight them.
Having returned to X-mansion, Cyclops and Wolverine must use Cerebro to search for the enemy.
Jean’s powerful mind energy wave short-circuited the system. Repair Cerebro to find Jean Grey’s location.
Cerebro has been repaired and within it is information about the hidden city, Afterlife. Check Blackbird’s engine and head over right away.
The enemy is hiding in an ancient temple in Afterlife that is only accessible using Terrigen Crystals. Collect Terrigen Crystals and open its door.
The Terrigen Crystals opened the door, but Magneto and his followers are preparing for a fight. You must defeat Magneto.
The further in we go, the stronger the signal of Maximus’ mind control device becomes. The team must use the counter-control device to stop the signal before it’s too late.
Maximus has escaped, and he plans on using Jean’s mind powers to enhance his own and control the entire human population. Charge the Inhuman device and stop the mind link right away.
The forced break of the mind link has greatly knocked Jean out. Take her to the school and get her treated right away.
[VEILED SECRET] Clear Rise Of The Phoenix
Jean’s mind has already been corrupted. A battle against the Dark Phoenix is awaiting the X-men and the Avengers at the X-mansion.
It’s not clear what the Phoenix’s warning is, but the X-men are prepared for anything that may happen.

Apocalypse has been defeated, but he left behind Death Seeds -- four ancient artifacts capable of restoring him to life. Cable must call in reinforcements to retrieve them before they fall into the wrong hands.
All Deadpool wanted was a taco from his favorite NYC food truck. But nooo! Hydra is attacking the city... again. If Wade wants his grub, he's gonna have to fight for it!
After defeating Hydra, Wade gets a visit from his old pal Cable, who gives him an important mission. He needs to find the Death Seeds... but first he needs to convince Cable to pay for his food!
Once a deal is made, Deadpool sets off to find the first Death Seeds. But he doesn’t even know what they are. Luckily, he has friends in dark places he can beat answers out of!
[MESSY FRIENDS] Aw, Man. This Guy? 1 time
Deadpool manages to shake some leads out of his criminal contacts and learns that a very powerful artifact has recently popped up in Paris. Time to grab some guns and brush up on your Spanish!

Wade's teleporter is on the fritz, so he has to buy a plane ticket like every other normal Joe. But even economy class costs too much for a merc down on his luck! Where's a loot box when you need one?
Deadpool finally collects enough cash to get on the plane. It's a long boring flight, so he has plenty of time to research the Death Seed. But he'll probably just read the in-flight magazine instead.

Once the plane lands in Paris, Deadpool searches the city for the Death Seed. Oddly enough, Hydra is here too! Are they looking for the same thing? Or are they convenient reusable character models that fit the story?
Hydra is defeated and Wade figures out that they were after the Death Seed. He has to ‘persuade’ one of the Hydra Agents into giving up its location. And by persuade, we obviously mean torture.
The Hydra Agent squeals before losing any body parts. The Death Seed is in a warehouse on the opposite side of Paris. Wade must travel across the city, taking out Hydra forces along the way.
While looking for the Death Seed, Deadpool realizes he's being trailed by a giant floating orb that seems way too interested in him. Time to do some homework and figure out what this crazy thing is.
When Deadpool arrives at the warehouse, he learns he is not alone. He has been beaten to the Death Seed by France's own pretentious super-thief, Fantomex! Zut alors! It's boss battle time!

Fantomex flees with the Death Seed before Deadpool can defeat him. Now, Deadpool has to chase his rival through Paris while Hydra chases them both! As the French say, omelette du fromage! Or something like that.

There's that freaky orb again! Deadpool's internet search said that it's called E.V.A. and it has a symbiotic relationship with Fantomex. Too bad he fell asleep before he found out how to beat it. Oops.
Deadpool finally catches up with Fantomex and plans to put him down for good. There's only room for one wisecracking mercenary on this quest, and it sure as hell ain't the French one!

Before Deadpool can pull the trigger, Fantomex offers him a deal. He knows where the next Death Seed is, and he is willing to take Deadpool to it... as long as Deadpool is willing to split any profits with him.

Deadpool and Fantomex decide to team up. They head back into Paris to catch a train. And fight some more Hydra Agents. Because, hey, it would be weird to use different character models now, right? Go to the Louvre?
The pair of mercs need to get to Siberia. Fantomex suggests riding inside E.V.A. if they gather some materials first. Deadpool thinks that’s gross... but he doesn’t have money for the train.
When they arrive in Siberia, Deadpool and Fantomex fight their way through the arctic wasteland to rendezvous with an old pal: The X-Man named Colossus. He knows where the next Death Seed is!

Fantomex says E.V.A.'s sensors can lock onto Colossus, but she will have to realign her physical form to be able to do so. That sounds completely disgusting, but for some reason Deadpool is excited to watch.

Colossus leads the team into a frozen Hydra base, there they bash in some enemy heads and locate the second Death Seed. Hmm. It was almost a little too easy. (Why do you move your lips when you read silently?)
It figures. Hydra has used the Death Seed to build some sort of mind-altering weapon that sends Colossus into a mindless rampage. To survive, you get to kick his shiny metal butt! About time!
After taking some serious dents, the weapon's effects begin to wear off and Colossus returns to normal. The team has to disable the weapon and claim the second Death Seed before Hydra uses it again.
Fantomex needs a little extra time to recover from his wounds. But while he's healing, he can hack into Hydra's computer to see if they have any info on the third Death Seed. (Spoilers: They do!)

The third Death Seed is in Shanghai, but there’s good news and bad news. The good news, Colossus has an X-Jet, eliminating the need for pricey public transportation. The bad news, tanks are dry and the fuel it uses is rare and expensive. Sigh.
After farming for fuel, the team jets to Shanghai. They expect to find Hydra waiting for them, but the Hand is there instead. Have they formed a nefarious partnership? Who cares! Just punch them!
Okay, so the Hand and Hydra aren’t working together, but they are both trying to find the Death Seeds. Spread false information and pit them against each other to keep them out of your way!
That worked like a charm! While Hydra and the Hand... HANDLE each other, you can upgrade the X-Jet's high tech gizmos to find the third Death Seed. And maybe some decent takeout.

Death Seed #3 is protected by another X-Man: Psylocke! She has seen the evil they possess and won't let another fall into the hands of morally bankrupt scoundrels like Fantomex and Deadpool. Ugh. Heroes.

Once the fight ended, Psylocke reads Deadpool's mind... Despite some disturbing thoughts she sees he is actually doing this job for the right reasons. Spoiler: He is! She decides to join the team, if only to keep an eye on Fantomex.

As Colossus discovered, Death Seeds give off a dark psychic energy. To find the final Seed, Psylocke needs to gather parts to build a mini-Cerebro and amplify her telepathic powers to a global search.
Psylocke pinpoints the Death Seed in Wakanda, so the team travels to yet another continent. Reload your guns while Colossus forces you to suffer through hours of Russian folk music in the X-Jet!
The X-Jet lands in Wakanda, but Psylocke has lost her mental connection with the Seed. The team will have to scour the jungle to find it, praying they don’t get mauled by panthers along the way.

The Death Seed is nowhere to be found, but Psylocke has a theory. Someone got to it before they did and shielded it from her detection. Was it Hydra? The Hand? S.H.I.E.L.D.? Stop reading this! Go find clues!
Deadpool recognizes the handiwork of his fellow merc. It was Domino who took the Death Seed! Fantomex needs help upgrading the X-Jet computer to find her. Anyone have a magazine?

While the computer searches for Domino, raid the Wakandan jungle for resources. Look, they're one of the most advanced nations on the planet and have one of the most successful movies of all time! They're not gonna miss a little Vibranium, are they?
Domino has been located in Alaska at one of Cable's old safehouses. ‘Borrow’ some Wakandan tech to enhance the X-Jet's systems in order to get this bird in the air faster and get this job over with!
It's a lot colder here than it was in Wakanda, so let's make this quick! Find the location of Domino's safehouse and beat up anyone crazy enough to voluntarily live in this climate along the way!
You're closing in on Domino, but if you know anything about her (or this game), you know she's not going down without a fight! So give her one that'll peel that stupid spot right off her stupid eye!
[THE BIG TWIN] Clear Cutting Cable 1 time
Domino claims she's one of the good guys. In fact, she says Cable hired her to find the final Seed before anyone else could. Huh? Open a secure channel to contact Cable so Domino can prove her story.
Cable confirms Domino's story and says he never hired Deadpool! Feeling used and embarrassed, Deadpool and the team (along with Domino) head back to New York to find the Cable copy.

When the team reaches NYC, Hydra is attacking... again. Thank goodness! Deadpool needed to take out his frustrations on someone, and this is way better than shooting at the Times Square street performers!
Deadpool leads the team back to the phony Cable that hired him. Time to find out who this punk really is underneath those giant shoulder pads, pouches, and comically over-sized weapons!

Stryfe got away! You really are the worst at this! But at least you've got a jet full of ‘borrowed’ vibranium that you can sell for weapons and info. And Domino knows all the seedy places to make that happen!
While you polish your guns and debate team names, Domino called in some back-up... in the form of the real Cable. Just to make sure he's not Stryfe, though, you'd better kick his cyborg butt!

This Cable is the real deal and he's ready to lead you to Stryfe. He dubs your team X-Force (without really considering your feelings) and uses the mini-Cerebro to find Stryfe's secret weapons factory.
Stryfe has created massive missiles that will spread the dark energy of the Death Seeds across the world, unleashing the rage of Apocalypse on every man, woman, child, and probably koala. Stop him!
You've disarmed the first Death Seed missile. Only three to go! You don’t even have time to stop and wonder why Hydra and the Hand are suddenly working for Stryfe! Don’t ask questions! Just fight!

Two Death Seeds recovered, but the clock is ticking. Or is that a bomb? Did you accidentally set a bomb and forget about it? I hope not. Either way, you're running out of time. Get that third Seed now!

Stryfe's factory is making more than missiles. Cable sends Colossus to destroy the other slightly-less-important weapons of doom, but the big guy will have to be at full strength for this solo mission.
One more Death Seed to disarm before you can face Stryfe and take out all your pent-up Cable issues on him. You know the drill: Fight the goons. Stop the missile. Dance like there's no tomorrow.

Cable knows how to send Stryfe back to his own dark future timeline, by building some sort of... oh who cares what it is... just gather the right parts and let Cable handle the time travel mumbo jumbo!
[THE BIG TWIN] Clear Ending the Stryfe

The final battle is here! X-Force versus Stryfe for the fate of the world! If you fail? Stryfe gets the Death Seeds and Apocalypse will be unleashed once again! If you win? I guess we all go out for tacos?
Cable's weird time bomb worked and X-Force was able to defeat Stryfe! Game over! Roll the credits! (But stick around anyway, just in case there's an extra scene!)
Reed Richards has been trapped in another dimension for nearly three years without his teammates or the means for interdimensional travel. His journey home begins as he finally returns to Earth.

Upon returning to Earth, Mister Fantastic must gain entry to the Fantastic Four's headquarters, the Baxter Building, to locate members of the Fantastic Four and a means to travel back to his own dimension.
Reed is shocked to find the Baxter Building abandoned. He has to get the building's power up and running again if he hopes to locate his family, the heroes known as the Fantastic Four.
With power restored to the Baxter Building, Mister Fantastic needs to activate powerful scanning equipment designed to lock onto the cosmic energy signature that gave the FF their powers.

Reed discovers no trace of the Fantastic Four in this universe... but he locks onto a familiar signal in another dimension. He must search the Baxter Building for a device capable of interdimensional travel.

Mister Fantastic can't locate his transdimensional Bridge in this dimension's Baxter Building, so he'll have to build one from scratch. First, he must draw up the schematics and determine what parts he needs.
With the new Bridge designed, Reed must gather some rare parts. The first stop on his search is a top-secret military factory where many of his inventions have been stored during the FF's absence.
Mister Fantastic must travel to New Attilan, the home of the Inhumans, in search of some more advanced components to finish the Bridge. Sadly, the welcome he receives is not a warm one.
Reed hoped to gain an audience with the Inhumans' King and Queen, Black Bolt and Medusa. But instead, he finds himself face-to-face with the Queen's sister, the elemental Inhuman named Crystal.

Mister Fantastic defeats Crystal and convinces her that they are on the same side. Crystal gives Reed the parts he was seeking so that he can begin the construction of the new transdimensional Bridge.

With the Bridge complete, Reed powers it up and prepares to leave this dimension in search of his missing teammates... but first, he needs to make sure that he leaves this world in safe hands when he departs.
Before he departs via the Bridge, Reed must use the Unstable Molecules he's gathered to make Crystal a Fantastic Four uniform, leaving the future of this world in her hands.

Reed activates the Bridge and prepares to depart. Before he can travel to another dimension, he must first synchronize the Bridge's energy frequency with the cosmic power signature he detected earlier.
Mister Fantastic successfully arrives in another dimension via the Bridge, but he has no way of finding his family. He must scavenge for the parts to build a device capable of tracking them down.

Reed needs to construct a portable version of the Cosmic Energy Scanner he used in the Baxter Building on the previous dimension's Earth. If properly attuned, he can use it to locate his family members.

Locking onto a signal, Mister Fantastic fights his way through the ruins of a decimated NYC, realizing that this world did not survive the war that he and his family tried to stop all those years ago.

Reed arrives at the Baxter Building, hoping to find his family, but the upper levels they called home have been damaged. He must search for anything that could be of value on his quest to find the FF.

Mister Fantastic locates the remains of the Fantasticar, but is ambushed by S.H.I.E.L.D. forces! Despite his efforts to diffuse the situation, Reed has no choice but to defend himself against his former allies.
Once Reed has subdued the S.H.I.E.L.D. agents, he is confronted by an unexpected agent of the organization: Ben Grimm -- The Thing! Reed must fight his oldest friend if he hopes to survive!

The Thing thought Mister Fantastic was just another ultra-dimensional imposter, but Reed convinces Ben that he's the real deal. The two old friends must work together once again to repair the Fantasticar.

Once the Fantasticar is repaired, Mister Fantastic and The Thing need to integrate the Bridge and the Cosmic Energy Scanner into its systems so that they can travel between dimensions to find their family.
Before they can leave to find the other members of the FF, the Scanner detects a surge in gamma radiation elsewhere in New York City. The heroes must race to find the source of the power surge.

The heroes arrive at a decimated A.I.M. base oozing with gamma radiation and have to fight their way to the center of the facility to find the source of the massive radiation leak before it's too late.

Mister Fantastic and The Thing defeat She-Hulk, returning her to her senses. Ben realizes that leaving this world means that S.H.I.E.L.D. will have a job opening for her... but Reed has a better idea...
[RESEARCH] Craft Fantastic Four Uniform for She-Hulk
Before they depart via the Fantasticar, Reed decides to make She-Hulk a Fantastic Four uniform, leaving the fate of this world in her enormous green hands... if she accepts the offer.
Reed must realign the Cosmic Energy Scanner to the proper wavelength before departing, so that the Bridge takes them to the next member of the Fantastic Four and not a world full of Hulks!

As Mister Fantastic and The Thing prepare to embark on the next chapter of their adventure, Ben asks Reed to make a quick stop at the S.H.I.E.L.D. bunker so that he can grab supplies for the long trip ahead.
Mister Fantastic and The Thing arrive in a new dimension, ready to locate their next missing teammate. But before they can, a surge of cosmic energy forces them to make an emergency landing.

The heroes soon realize that they are in the nation of Latveria -- the home of their arch-foe, Doctor Doom. The army of Doombots ready to attack the heroes proves that Doom is the same in any dimensions!

The Thing and Mister Fantastic make quick work of the Doombots, but the Fantasticar needs serious repairs. Luckily, they have plenty of parts they can gather from the android army they just destroyed.

The Doombots did some serious damage to all of the Fantasticar's upgraded systems during the battle. Reed and Ben must repair the Fantasticar quickly if they hope to get out of Latveria with their lives.
With the Bridge severely damaged, Reed decides they have no choice but to enter Castle Doom to plead their case with Victor von Doom himself. But first they must face his soldiers!
Victorious, the cosmically powered defender of Latveria, has taken Doom's place on the throne. She says she saved this world when its heroes left it to die... and now all invaders must answer to her!
The heroes are no match for Victorious's cosmic might. Reed and Ben are forced to make a strategic retreat if they hope to live to locate the rest of their family. Next stop, the Baxter Building!

Mister Fantastic and The Thing return to this world’s Baxter Building to search for something to aid them against Victorious. Once there, they realize that the entire Baxter Building is under S.H.I.E.L.D. control!

Reed and Ben are shocked to find Johnny Storm being held as a prisoner inside his own home! They let Johnny out of captivity, but he lashes out and attacks, assuming S.H.I.E.L.D. is messing with his head.

After the battle, Johnny finally has some sense knocked into him and is elated to finally be back with his family. He leads his friends to the pieces of an item that might help them: The Ultimate Nullifier.

The Ultimate Nullifier is a weapon that could erase all of reality with the pull of a trigger. While Ben and Johnny bicker like old times, Reed must concentrate as he puts the delicate device together.
The three members of the Fantastic Four rush back to Castle Doom in the Fantasticar and are greeted inside by more of Victorious's forces. They need to make their way back to the throne room.
The heroes head deeper into Castle Doom and fight their way back to the throne room. Together, they must face the cosmic might of Victorious in battle if they hope to advance in their mission.
After the battle, Reed threatens to use the Ultimate Nullifier on Victorious. Fortunately, she isn’t willing to call his bluff and offers the heroes a deal to help them find their final member.
Victorious opened a cosmic portal, sending the heroes back to their own Earth, where she claimed that the Invisible Woman was already waiting for them. The team must race home for a family reunion!
The Invisible Woman is nowhere to be seen, and the Cosmic Energy Scanner in the Fantasticar is broken. Reed must use the Baxter Building's scanners to track down his wife's energy signature.

The three heroes are dismayed to discover that the scanners tracked the Invisible Woman to Latveria. Once the Fantasticar is refueled they must travel back to the hostile nation to save their teammate.
Mister Fantastic realizes that the Baxter Building's fuel supplies have run dry in the three years that they were gone. He must mix up a new batch to refuel the Fantasticar for their journey.
The Fantasticar is refueled and ready to go. Knowing that Doom will have plenty of tricks up his metal sleeve, the Fantastic Four must gather supplies for their dangerous mission back to Latveria.
The heroes are shocked that Latveria has been untouched by the war sweeping the world. They're even more shocked that a mind-warped Invisible Woman is ruling the nation by Doctor Doom's side!

Using dark sorcery, Doom commands the Invisible Woman to attack the FF, but her will is too strong. She overcomes his spell and returns to her normal self, ready to join her family and set things right.

Mister Fantastic plans to set things right by using Doctor Doom's Time Platform to return them to the very beginning of the war, before their mission failed. But he has to get the machine working again first...
As Reed reconstructs the Time Platform, more of Doom's forces close in on the heroes. They must defeat the waves of soldiers and Doombots if they hope to save the day... and the world!
[TWISTED WORLD] Clear In the Shadow of Doom 3 times
Before Mister Fantastic can repair the Time Platform, Doctor Doom tracks them down and destroys the device. The reunited Fantastic Four have no choice but to take the battle straight to Doom himself.
The Fantastic Four are triumphant! Doctor Doom falls to his knees in defeat! But the war is far from over, so Reed offers his enemy the chance to be a hero for once and join them in saving the world.

Doctor Doom has no desire to aid the Fantastic Four. Mister Fantastic was worried that might be the case, so he has one more trick up his elongated sleeve that could stop Doom's reign of terror for good.

Reed completes his plan -- the construction of a new Bridge. When he activates it, a challenger from another dimension arrives to claim Latveria's throne. The FF must get to the Fantasticar and depart.
The reassembled Fantastic Four must quickly escape Castle Doom before the entire structure comes crashing down around them. But now that they are reunited, they can accomplish anything together!
Beta Ray Bill has crash landed in Times Square bringing a warning for the universe. Luckily, Star-Lord was visiting Earth during some time off from guarding the galaxy.
Star-Lord and Beta Ray Bill must gather the other Guardians of the Galaxy. Gamora's communicator is off, but her locator beacon leads them to a secret Hydra factory.
After defeating the Hydra cell, Star-Lord next travels to find Drax, who has spent his day off seeking more peaceful pursuits by playing the saxophone in the subway.
Mantis has kept busy using her empathic abilities to help New Yorkers lower their stress levels. She won't leave until everyone in the city is happy. It might be a while...
Star-Lord tracks Rocket to Hell's Kitchen, where he has run afoul of an underground gambling ring. Unfortunately, he's fresh out of credits and thermal detonators.
Groot has managed to escape the drama of the big city, soaking up some sun in Central Park. But the time has come to prepare for the cosmic storm lies ahead...
Taking Beta Ray Bill's warning seriously, the Guardians return to the Hydra weapons facility that Gamora decimated to gather an arsenal for the confrontation ahead.
Before returning to the ship, Star-Lord decides he needs more than just a weapons upgrade. There's no style in the galaxy like Earth style, so it's time for a new outfit!
Just as Star-Lord puts the finishing touches on his new suit, panic erupts in the streets. The Guardians need to investigate the source of the disturbance and end the threat.
When the Guardians arrive at the scene, they discover Gamora's "sister" Nebula on a rampage. She is infected by the same unknown force that Beta Ray Bill encountered.
Nebula recovers, claiming that more of the Guardians' infected allies are being held at the Kyln. With the universe at stake, she reluctantly agrees to aid the heroes.
The Milano's engines are running dry, and starship fuel isn’t exactly easy to locate on Earth. The Guardians will need an alternate energy source to make it to the Kyln.
The Guardians leave Earth behind, but the crew of the Alpha Flight Space Station, which monitors intergalactic threats, wants to know where they're off to in such a hurry...
Following Nebula's lead, the Guardians head towards the maximum-security space prison called the Kyln. For once, they'll actually be trying to break into a prison!
Once inside the Kyln, the heroes don't receive the warmest welcome from the prion's guards. Maybe they're still sore from the last time the Guardians broke out...
The guards are defeated, but the cell block controls have been damaged. Prisoners are escaping from their cells... many of whom were put there by the Guardians!
The prisoners have been detained, but in order to lock them safely back in their cells, Rocket will have to repair the damaged cell block controls. He'd better move fast!
The Guardians encounter the first of their infected allies, the quantum-powered protector Phyla-Vell. Sadly, she does not look happy to see her old friends...
The fight is over, but Phyla-Vell is still struggling against the darkness corrupting her mind. Mantis must use her telepathic powers to purge the strange infection.
During the battle against the Guardians, Phyla-Vell's Quantum sword was damaged. It must be repaired if she is to regain her full powers in time to face the threat ahead.
[SPACE PRISON] Clear Wings of Darkness 5 times
As the Guardians return to the Milano, they are blocked by the hero known as Darkhawk. He has also succumbed to the corruption and will not let them pass.
Darkhawk's body is still infected by the extradimensional darkness. His Raptor amulet can purge his system by shifting him back to human form... but the amulet is missing.
The storage locker containing Darkhawk's amulet has been located, but Rocket can't break the locks with conventional tools. Luckily, Beta Ray Bill brought along a special one.
The Guardians retrieve Darkhawk's amulet and race to return it to him, but their path is blocked by another group of Kyln prison guards eager for some payback.
The Guardians realize they will need more backup if they want to survive the coming battle. Darkhawk has an idea, but they'll need to break into the Kyln's storage room.
Inside the Kyln storage room, the heroes find the pieces of a broken Nova Corps helmet. They can use this to send out a distress call... if they can fix it...
With all of the Nova helmet pieces in hand, the Guardians must repair it and contact the entire Nova Corps. Without their help, the universe might be doomed...
The Guardians follow a distress call from Nova Centurion Rich Rider, leading them through dangerous debris fields and straight into the heart of the Kree Empire.
[SPACE PRISON] Clear Wings of Darkness 8 times
Nova informs the Guardians that the Kree warship has been attacked. The heroes need to blast their way on board and neutralize the threat while it is still contained.
Once on board, the Guardians realize that the entire crew of the Kree warship has already been annihilated. Whoever did this needs to be found and stopped.
Upon reaching the Bridge, the Guardians must face the being that attacked the Kree warship: the interstellar force of vengeance known as the Cosmic Ghost Rider.
Cosmic Ghost Rider claims he was delivering vengeance to the Kree for detonating a weapon in Shi’ar space that opened a dimensional rift. He offers his help to seal it.
Cosmic Ghost Rider claims that his Hell Cycle won’t respond when he summons it. The Kree must have locked it down during his attack. He asks the heroes to find it.
Reaching the hangar bay, the Guardians are attacked by a small cell of Kree soldiers who survived Cosmic Ghost Rider's rampage. They are not in the mood to talk.
Before they are defeated, one of the Kree soldiers initiates the warship's self-destruct sequence. The heroes must scramble to deactivate it before the timer reaches zero.
During the battle with the Kree Soldiers, Cosmic Ghost Rider's Hell Cycle sustained some minor damage. They decide to repair it rather than face the Rider's wrath.
With the Hell Cycle as good as new, the heroes return with it to the Bridge. When they arrive, they are greeted by a new dilemma: Nova has somehow been infected!
The Nova Force held Nova's infection at bay longer than other heroes who examined the rift, but he has finally succumbed. The Guardians must fend off his attacks.
If the Nova Force slowed the infection, perhaps an amplified blast of that energy, from the Nova Corps helmet found in Kyln, could cleanse Nova's system for good.
As Nova recovers from the corruption, he realizes that he has experienced the exact same type of infection before -- during the time he was trapped beyond The Fault.
With the truth about the cosmic rift revealed, the Guardians must refuel their ship and head off to seal it before the things beyond The Fault overtake our universe!
Nova leads the heroes through space towards the site of The Fault. As they travel, he reminds the Guardians that Shi'ar space is fiercely protected by the Imperial Guard.
Alarms sound, detecting intense energy in the region due to the Kree weapon that created the breach. The Guardians must divert power to the Milano's shields.
The heroes arrive at The Fault, which is growing larger by the moment. Nova suggests that they seal it, but the Milano's scanners pick up a familiar signal on the other side...
As they travel to the other side of The Fault, the heroes locate the Silver Surfer. He has been fighting against the infection, but even he can barely withstand its corruptive force.
The Silver Surfer warns that this deathless dimension may not be the only threat they will face. He offers to guide the Guardians through this realm if they can find his surfboard.
[THE FAULT] Clear The Fallen Herald 2 times
The Silver Surfer may possess the power cosmic, but his extended time beyond the Fault has finally overcome him. He lashes out and attacks the heroes.
Cosmic Ghost Rider was once a Herald of Galactus, so he too can harness the power cosmic. He must use that bond to restore the Silver Surfer's cosmic awareness.
The Silver Surfer returns to his senses and tells the Guardians that the Shi’ar Majestor, Gladiator, was infected and traveled far beyond The Fault. He must be rescued.
Knowing that this dimension's corruptive influence stems from a biological infection, the heroes decide to gather tissue samples from the strange universe for further analysis.
[THE FAULT] Clear The Fallen Herald 3 times
When saturated with cosmic power and psionic energy, the infection reverses. The heroes must combine their powers with the tissue samples to create a vaccine.
As the Guardians and their allies wait to see if they have developed a viable cure to the infection, they must also devise a way to administer that potential cure to Gladiator.
The infection has overcome Gladiator, one of the most powerful beings in the universe. It will take the Guardians and all their assembled allies to bring him down.
Gladiator has been stopped for the moment, but he must be cured of the infection before he can recover and unleash the full fury of this deathless dimension into our reality.
With the help of the recovered Gladiator, the Guardians and their cosmic companions must exit The Fault and seal the rift between dimensions once and for all.

As a riot rages at the Raft, the Green Goblin releases the former hero known as the Sentry from solitary confinement, hoping he can convince this powerful being to join his quest to save all of reality from destruction.

Having been locked away for years, the Sentry is unaware of what has transpired in the world outside of the Raft. Before he is willing to team up with someone as infamous as Norman Osborn, he demands proof that the universe is in trouble.

The Green Goblin attempts to lead the Sentry to the Raft's records room, but along the way, they must fight through a number of escaped super-powered inmates who are in the process of ripping the Raft to shreds.
Upon reaching the Raft's records room, the Sentry must search the database for proof of Osborn's claims that the world's heroes have vanished and that all of time and space are collapsing.

The Sentry is shocked to learn what has happened to the world during his exile. Knowing he must help save the people he was once sworn to protect, the Sentry vows to help the Green Goblin restore order... starting with the Raft!
Before the Sentry can truly join the battle, the Green Goblin must first deactivate the inhibitor collar that has been keeping the Sentry's vast superhuman abilities in check while he was imprisoned.

The power of one million exploding suns flows through the Sentry once again... but the sudden surge takes an immediate toll on his mental state. The Green Goblin suddenly realizes that his attempt to save the world might have doomed it.

As the Sentry begins to spiral out of control, he tells the Green Goblin that their only hope to contain the darkness within him lies in the Raft's infirmary -- but the only way there is currently blocked by more rioting prisoners!

Finally arriving at the infirmary, the Sentry must search for any remaining doses of his Sentry Serum, a chemical concoction designed to keep his darker half in check. He cannot risk unleashing the Void on the world ever again...
[REFORMED ROGUES] Clear Sting of the Scorpion 2 times

A vial containing the Sentry Serum is located. The dose restores the Sentry's control over his powers and calms his fragile mental state... and not a moment too soon! The Scorpion arrives on the scene seeking revenge against the Goblin!

Osborn grants the defeated Scorpion the chance to join his cause alongside the Sentry, an offer the Scorpion knows he can't refuse. Together, these unlikely allies fight their way through their fellow prisoners to make their escape.

Before they can exit the Raft, the Sentry and his allies see that Venom is running amok. Realizing that he could be a powerful ally, Osborn decides to use the prison database to research ways to subdue the Venom symbiote.

With the Venom symbiote now separated from its host, the Green Goblin manages to capture it. Scorpion offers to bond with the alien entity, which transforms him into a dark reflection of his greatest foe: Spider-Man.

As the Green Goblin starts to put his master plan into motion, he sends the Sentry out to gather some critical supplies. The Sentry's first stop is a top-secret weapons factory run jointly by Stark Industries and S.H.I.E.L.D.

When the Sentry enters the factory, he finds himself confronted by a squad of S.H.I.E.L.D. agents. Though he does not wish to harm these innocent soldiers, he will not let anyone stand in the way of his mission to save the world.

The Sentry locates one of the weapons being stored in the facility: a prototype Iron Man armor seemingly designed for Captain America. As he attempts to secure the armor, its self-defense protocols initiate and it begins to fight back!

The Iron Patriot armor is deactivated, but not without sustaining significant damage. The Sentry must download the armor's schematics from the S.H.I.E.L.D. servers to make sure that it can be properly repaired.

Before he can continue his mission, the Sentry senses another presence lurking in the shadows of the facility. He must explore the factory to find out who followed him and whether or not they pose a threat.
[CUTTHROAT COMPANIONS] Clear Legacy of Blood 5 times

The Sentry is suddenly ambushed by the ferocious mutant called Daken. Whatever this metal-clawed maniac is after, he's willing to slice his way through anything in his path to get it -- including the Golden Guardian of Good himself!

Once Daken realizes he is outmatched, he reveals the reason he came to this factory. Rumor has it that Stark Industries mysteriously acquired a supply of Adamantium not long after Daken's father, Wolverine, went missing.

The Sentry decides to aid Daken, joining the mutant in his search for the missing Adamantium. Together, they must scour the facility and search through Stark Industries’ records in hopes of determining Wolverine's fate.

After discovering a mysterious "Item X" listed in the Stark shipping logs, Daken and the Sentry must locate the storage container hidden in the factory. Whatever is inside, Daken is certain that it cannot be good...

Daken and the Sentry locate "Item X" and are surprised when there are no traces of Adamantium inside. But the contents of the container still confirm Daken's worst fears: Wolverine is no more... and Tony Stark may be to blame!

Daken recovers his father's old costume and swears his revenge. Using the advanced technology in the factory, he attempts to repair the damage to Wolverine's uniform so that he can take up his fallen father's mantle.

The Sentry offers Daken a chance to channel his rage in positive directions, just as his father did before him. At first, Daken scoffs at the idea of playing hero, but he changes his mind when he realizes the potential for personal gain.
[CUTTHROAT COMPANIONS] Clear Legacy of Blood 8 times

Daken and the Sentry secure the Iron Patriot armor and deliver it to the Green Goblin. Osborn is impressed not only by the fancy new toy that the Sentry recovered, but also by the newest recruit to their team. Things are going better than planned.

Before he can don the Iron Patriot armor, Osborn must perform repairs on the suit based on the schematics recovered by the Sentry. Osborn promises that, once the armor is fully operational, a new era of heroics will finally dawn...
Iron Patriot dispatches the Sentry to the Baxter Building, home of the Fantastic Four, to find a Symbiote Inhibitor that will help to quell the Sinister Spider-Man's disturbingly violent tendencies.

The Fantastic Four may no longer be at their headquarters, but their automated security systems are still fully functional. The Sentry must fight his way past the building's defenses to find the item he is seeking.

The Sentry reaches the Baxter Building's control room and accesses the mainframe using a password provided by the Iron Patriot. Once in the system, he must search for any information on the Symbiote Inhibitor.

Discovering that the Symbiote Inhibitor is located in Reed Richards' main lab, the Sentry makes his way through the Baxter Building to recover the device. But when alarms trigger elsewhere in the building, he realizes he might not be alone.

Upon reaching the top-secret lab, the Sentry is surprised to find that the heavily reinforced door has been ripped from its hinges. Someone else has beaten him to the punch, and whoever it is, they have strength that matches his own!

The Sentry is momentarily relieved to discover his fellow hero, Ms. Marvel, alive and well inside the lab. But when the Sentry notices that Ms. Marvel is stealing the Fantastic Four's tech, he realizes that everything is not as it seems.

Eager to avoid an unnecessary fight, "Ms. Marvel" reveals that she is actually the supervillain known as Moonstone. She exploited the heroic identity when the real Ms. Marvel vanished with the Avengers. And her plan worked... until now...

The faux Ms. Marvel is pleasantly surprised when Sentry offers her a chance to redeem her wicked ways by joining Osborn's squad of Dark Avengers. To prove she can be trusted, she must first hand over the Symbiote Inhibitor.

Before leaving the Fantastic Four's lab, the Sentry decides to gather the secret ingredients required to synthesize his Sentry Serum. He knows that the serum could come in handy should he ever start to lose control again.

The Sentry hears a noise nearby and prepares to seek out the source. Ms. Marvel admits that she did not come to the Baxter Building alone, and that her partner may not be so quick to share her change of heart about heroics...

Even though Ms. Marvel's partner is dressed as Hawkeye, behind the bow and arrow he's really the assassin known as Bullseye. He laughs at the Sentry's offer to "go straight", deciding to attack the hero -- and his former partner -- instead.

The Sentry and Ms. Marvel are triumphant in taking down the Hawkeye hoax. When the Sentry tells the battered Bullseye that he'll be locked up for life, the assassin begrudgingly changes his mind and agrees to join the good fight.

The Sentry and his new allies discover that one of the Baxter Building's containment units was damaged during the battle with Bullseye. They must find a way to keep the powerful molecular energy within the chamber from seeping out.
[RESEARCH] Research the Molecular Energy Containment Unit

The would-be heroes must work fast to repair the containment unit and stabilize the situation. But even if they manage to patch the leak, there's no telling what damage could be caused by the strange energy that has already escaped.

The Dark Avengers arrive at Central Park, finding themselves face-to-face with the Molecule Man, who claims that he had been imprisoned in the Baxter Building for years and is now finally free thanks to their unwitting assistance.

The Molecule Man offers to let the team help him reshape the world, finally earning them the power and respect they've desired for so long. Before the Iron Patriot can consider accepting, the Sentry steps forth and refuses the offer.

Claiming that he'll have to save the universe on his own instead, the Molecule Man admits that a world made in the Dark Avengers' image would have been too warped to survive in any way -- and he intends to show them why!

The Molecule Man snaps his fingers, twisting New York into a dangerous realm filled with portals to other realities. Before the Dark Avengers can stop his madness, villains emerge from the cross-dimensional rifts and attack!

The Dark Avengers search for a solution to close the rifts between realities, but more and more portals are opening every second, with stronger foes emerging from each of them. The only way to survive is to keep on fighting.
[GOLDEN GODS] Clear God of War 3 times

Ares, the God of War, unexpectedly emerges from a portal. He claims that, on his world, the Iron Patriot and his Dark Avengers destroyed Asgard and enslaved all of mankind. He vows that he will not let that happen on another Earth.

After a hard-fought battle, the Sentry spares the God of War's life. Ares shows his respect, realizing that perhaps even villains can change. He offers to join the Dark Avengers in their final battle with the Molecule Man.

Before they can reach the Molecule Man, the heroes need to deal with another wave of threats emerging from the dimensional portals. If they can't close these rifts soon, there won't be a world left to save!

Iron Patriot analyzes the rifts and formulates the energy frequency required to shut them down. The Sentry and Ms. Marvel must use their powers to supercharge the Iron Patriot armor so he can deliver a blast capable of closing the portals.

With some of the cross-dimensional portals starting to close, the Dark Avengers finally reach the Molecule Man. He is impressed by their tenacity, but he refuses to let their darkness tarnish the world any longer.

As all of reality warps around him, the Sentry finally loses his tenuous grip on reality. The mighty hero begins to succumb to his darker half, the Void, a threat potentially far more dangerous than even the Molecule Man!

The Dark Avengers are forced to make a choice. Do they focus on stopping the Molecule Man's misguided attempts to save the universe? Or do they try to stop their own ally before he devolves into an unstoppable force of darkness?

The Dark Avengers make the heroic choice, formulating a batch of Sentry Serum and stabilizing their friend. But by the time they administer the dose and return the Sentry to his right mind, it may already be too late to stop their true foe.

As the Molecule Man disappears through a rift, the Dark Avengers know that the other worlds he has sworn to "save" might be in peril. Together, they leap into the portal after him, ready to face whatever comes next... as heroes.
Sersi awakens in the Resurrection Machine, unaware of how she fell in battle. She is an Eternal, so her rebirth is expected. Her sudden death... most definitely was not...
Upon waking up, the Machine asks Sersi if she remembers the Principles. Of course. She has known them for a thousand lifetimes: "Protect Celestials. Protect the Machine. Correct Excess Deviation."
As her new physical form acclimates, Sersi communes with the Machine, seeking out any information on the cause of her most recent demise.
As the Machine helps Sersi retrace her steps, the memories suddenly flood back. Sersi was visiting Babylon, an ancient site of Celestial activity when she was blindsided by an attack. But by whom...?
The Machine confirms Sersi's attacker: Warlord Kro, leader of the Deviants, genetic cousins and ancestral enemies of the Eternals. Sersi knows she must learn what Kro is after before it is too late.

All Eternals can break down their molecular structure as a means of teleportation, but it isn't pleasant. To ease the strain of the process, the Machine assists Sersi in traveling across its network of subdimensional threads.
Arriving in Babylon, Sersi finds the ancient site under attack by a Deviant army. Having no tolerance for lesser beings mucking up her day, she engages their forces in battle.
Arriving at the heart of Babylon, Sersi confronts Warlord Kro in battle. Whatever his plans may be, she vows to end them now and send him back to Lemuria to lick his wounds.

Kro escapes, but Sersi discovers the truth behind his plan. He has uncovered forbidden knowledge about the Celestial experiments and equipment that created the Eternals and the Deviants millennia ago!

By rebuilding the Celestial equipment, Kro hopes either to evolve all life on Earth... or to destroy it once and for all! Sersi has no choice but to call in her fellow Eternals to help save humanity from Kro's machinations.

The Machine has identified six Celestial Components required to recreate the ancient evolutionary experiment. The Eternals split up and track down the individual pieces simultaneously, hopefully before Kro can locate them...
Sersi's search for a Celestial Component leads her to Stark Tower, the home of her mortal allies, the Avengers. By the time she arrives, the tower is already under attack by the Deviants.
Sersi fights her way through the hordes of Deviants to gain entry into Stark Tower. Fortunately, her Avengers identification card is still active and allows her access.
Realizing that any structure crafted by mortals is unlikely to withstand the full might of a Deviant assault, Sersi uses her matter transmutation abilities to build barriers around the Tower's base.
Reach level 21 with all of Sersi's gear.
Arriving at the control room of Stark Tower, Sersi uses her status as an Avenger to gain access to Tony Stark's private database, searching for any clues to the Celestial Component's location.

Sersi locates the file on the Celestial Component, but is insulted to learn that she doesn't have the proper clearance level to access the data. She communes with the Machine in hopes of breaking Stark's encryption protocols.
As the Machine hacks into the Avengers database, Sersi turns her attention back to the Deviant army, which has broken through her enhanced fortifications and found its way into the tower.
Reach level 22 with all of Sersi's gear.

Iron Man blasts his way into the battle and is shocked to find his old teammate at the heart of the action. Sersi has a history of serving her own needs before those of the Avengers, so Iron Man assumes she's behind the attack...

Sersi attempts to reassure Iron Man of her allegiance, but he quickly points out that she's hacking his private files. Offended by Iron Man's accusations, Sersi has no choice but to put the metal-clad mortal in his place.
Reach level 23 with all of Sersi's gear.

Once tempers cool, Sersi and Iron Man join forces to eliminate the Deviant threat to Stark Tower. Their trust may now be strained, but Sersi is reassured by the fact that Tony Stark will die long before her...

With the Deviant threat over, Iron Man decides to help Sersi locate the Celestial Component. He claims he recently lent the device to another of his allies, the Blue Marvel, who wished to study its ancient technology.
Reach level 24 with all of Sersi's gear.
Sersi and Iron Man travel to the Triskelion together to meet with the Blue Marvel. When they arrive, they find the base already on lockdown as another faction of Deviants stages an assault.

The heroes fight their way through the Deviants and towards the entrance of the Triskelion. The protective barriers cannot be breached by traditional means, but Sersi's matter manipulation powers are up to the task.
Reach level 25 with all of Sersi's gear.

Upon entering the Triskelion, Sersi wonders how the Deviants were able to learn the Celestial Component's location and shift their target so swiftly. She must check to see if the Machine has been compromised...

Sersi discovers a glitch in the Machine, one that Warlord Kro could have exploited to gain access to the hacked files at Stark Tower. This could explain how Kro and his Deviants are a step ahead of the heroes...
Reach awakened skill level 2 with Sersi.
As the Machine closes the loophole that gave Kro access to its systems, the Blue Marvel meets with Sersi and Iron Man to explain his research on the Celestial Component.

The Blue Marvel hopes to tap into the Celestial Component's otherworldly technology to advance modern society in ways mankind has only dreamed about. He leads Sersi and Iron Man to his lab to show them his work...
Reach awakened skill level 4 with Sersi.
Upon entering the Blue Marvel's lab, Sersi and her allies discover that Warlord Kro and his Deviants have already beaten them to the punch and have taken the Celestial Component for themselves.
Fortunately, the Blue Marvel has already completed extensive research on the Celestial Component. Sersi must scour the data to uncover clues on how to find the stolen device.
Reach awakened skill level 6 with Sersi.
Using the data gathered by the Blue Marvel, Sersi and Iron Man attempt to design a method of tracking the Celestial Component back to Kro... preferably before he manages to gather the other five...
[Epic Quest] Complete A Modern Crisis Story 1 time
The search for Celestial Components leads Ikaris to Wakanda. But Wakanda has never been known for eagerly welcoming outsiders... and Ikaris is not one who often waits for permission to act.

When Ikaris arrives in Wakanda, he is surrounded by the king's guards, the Dora Milaje. He could decimate them all with a single cosmic blast from his eyes... but he decides to reserve his righteous fury for his true target.

Escorted to the heart of the sacred city, Ikaris is greeted by the ruler of Wakanda, the Black Panther. T'Challa immediately understands the gravity of the situation and offers to lead Ikaris to the component.
Reach level 21 with all of Ikaris's gear.

In exchange for his help, the Panther asks Ikaris to seek out any potential access points that the Deviants could use to invade his kingdom and to help develop technology that could repel their forces.
Ikaris identifies a number of weak points throughout Wakanda's terrain that could potentially lead to the Deviants' subterranean land of Lemuria. He uses his cosmic energy to seal these fissures.
After the access points are sealed, Ikaris works with T'Challa and his sister, Shuri, to design Vibranium weaponry capable of defending against even the most durable of Deviants.
Reach level 22 with all of Ikaris's gear.
Before the heroes can complete their designs, Wakanda falls under attack. The Deviants have found a way into the royal palace itself... and they seem to be coming from the depths directly below!
As Shuri scrambles to complete the new weapon, Ikaris and the Black Panther battle the Deviants the old fashioned way— with their fists, claws, and god-like cosmic powers.

Just as the Deviant forces are about to overwhelm Ikaris and T'Challa, Shuri manages to set off one powerful blast from her newly-designed weapon. The Deviants are instantly sent scrambling back into the depths.
Shuri's weapon shorts out after its first test blast, but there's no time for repairs. Ikaris and the Black Panther must follow the Deviants down into the Necropolis, the Wakandan City of the Dead.
Reach level 23 with all of Ikaris's gear.

Ikaris learns that it is not just the dead kings of Wakanda who inhabit the Necropolis. This is also where T'Challa keeps some of his most sacred treasures... including a certain Celestial Component...

Ikaris and the Black Panther must fight their way through an army of Deviants blocking their path. When it looks as if they can go no further, T'Challa suggests an alternate route through the catacombs...

As the heroes navigate the dark catacombs, they soon find themselves at a dead-end caused by a cave-in. Clearing the rubble without causing even greater damage will require power and precision that only Ikaris can offer.
Reach level 24 with all of Ikaris's gear.

Once past the debris, Ikaris and the Black Panther enter a grand burial chamber. The door is sealed shut from the outside and is rigged with deadly traps. The heroes must find another way out... fast!

T'Challa communes with his ancestors on the Djalia -- the Wakandan spirit plane -- to ask for safe passage from the chamber. Before the Panther's plea can be answered, the impatient Ikaris pries the door open himself.
Ikaris sets off the traps guarding the burial chamber, flooding the room with water. He must focus all of his energy to safely teleport himself and T'Challa from the drenching danger.

Narrowly escaping death (or at least an inconvenient resurrection), Ikaris follows T'Challa to the heart of the Necropolis. But it's too late! The chamber where the Celestial Component was stored has been looted!
Reach level 25 with all of Ikaris's gear.
The heroes track down Warlord Kro, who has taken the Celestial Component and is ready to make his exit. Ikaris and the Panther must fight valiantly to prevent the Deviants from escaping Wakanda.
[Epic Quest] Complete Outsiders Off-limits Story 1 time

Despite a battle well-fought, Kro manages to flee Wakanda with the Celestial Component. Ikaris vows to complete his mission... but secretly hopes that his fellow Eternals are faring better on their legs of the journey...
Makkari tracks one of the missing Celestial Components to Titan, a moon of Saturn that was once home to its own settlement of Eternals. The moon is like a graveyard now... but something has awoken...
As Makkari explores Titan, it's not Deviants that await, but rather an army of Outriders. These vicious aliens serve the whims of the most notorious son of Titan, the Eternal known as Thanos.

A swarm of Outriders attack Makkari! Even the Eternal's legendary speed is not enough to avoid the sudden onslaught of claws and fangs. The only path to safety lies on the other side of their assault...

Makkari defeats the first wave of Outriders, but knows the worst is yet to come. Seeking safety within the desolate halls of the fallen Eternal settlement, Makkari begins a frantic search for the Celestial Component.
Makkari finds the home of A'lars, the leader of Titan's Eternals and attempts to access the colony's super-computer, I.S.A.A.C. But the system has been corrupted and will require time to reboot...
Once I.S.A.A.C. is fully operational again, Makkari searches its vast database to see where the Eternals of Titan might be storing the Celestial Component.
Finding valuable information in I.S.A.A.C.'s database about the origin and function of the Celestial Components, Makkari links the datastream between Titan's super-computer and Earth's own Machine.
Reach level 15 with all of Makkari's gear.

More Outriders arrive, chasing Makkari from the abandoned home of A'lars. Their chilling howls are enough to paralyze their prey with fear... but fortunately, Makkari moves faster than the speed of sound!

Makkari locates a secret vault full of unusual equipment, both Eternal and Celestial in origin. But after a swift search, it's clear the Celestial Component Makkari was hoping to locate is nowhere to be found...
Outriders flood the vault, slashing and clawing with a speed that almost matches Makkari's own. From behind the horde of ravenous creatures, a deep and foreboding laugh can be heard...
Thanos steps from the shadows, holding the Celestial Component in his hand. Makkari fears that ancient power such as this could be even deadlier in Thanos' hands than Kro's.
Reach level 20 with all of Makkari's gear.

The Mad Titan reveals he has struck a deal with Kro, recovering the lost Celestial Component in hopes that the experiment will decimate Earth's population. Makkari attempts to strike a better deal with Thanos... but to no avail.
Makkari charges into battle, knowing full well that Thanos cannot be beaten by any single Eternal. But this speedster is determined to finish the race nonetheless.
[Epic Quest] Complete Space Race Story 1 time
After the battle, Thanos departs Titan with the Component, leaving Makkari with the clear realization that the Eternals cannot win the battle to come on their own...

The Machine has identified six Celestial Components required to recreate an ancient evolutionary experiment. The Eternals split up and track down each individual piece simultaneously, hopefully before Kro can locate them...

Kingo is shooting a film in Shanghai when he gets the call from Sersi about the Celestial Components. As soon as the director yells "Cut!", Kingo leaves the set to go searching for the piece of ancient technology.
[BROKEN HARMONY] Clear Smaller Heads Prevail 3 times
Kingo begins his search by the docks, where he hears rumors of an underground operation smuggling high-tech items into the area. He follows the lead to a nearby warehouse.
