Kingo discovers that the smuggling operation is being run by A.I.M. They are providing local gangs with advanced weaponry. It may not be the device he's seeking... but Kingo knows he has to intervene.
Reach level 15 with all of Kingo's gear.

As he monitors the situation, Kingo notices members of a local gang arriving to complete a transaction. He intercepts the criminals and offers them a better deal: Leave now... and they get to keep their lives!

Kingo breaks into the A.I.M. warehouse and swiftly takes down the scientists-turned-smugglers. Despite his big-screen fame, it's instantly clear that Kingo's skills are more than just special effects!
Reach level 20 with all of Kingo's gear.

As Kingo examines A.I.M.'s weaponry, he notices that there are unmistakable elements of Celestial origin worked into their designs. Before he can dig further, Kingo hears someone else entering the warehouse.
Shang-Chi arrives on the scene and sees the Eternals' resident ninja in possession of the arms shipment. The Master of Kung-Fu assumes that Kingo must be the mastermind behind the illegal operation.

Kingo and Shang-Chi face off against each other in a heated martial arts face-off! The two legendary warriors match each other blow-for-blow in a fight so epic it deserves its own feature film franchise!

Shang-Chi and Kingo fight to a stalemate and soon realize that they are on the same side. Together, they track down a hidden A.I.M. Research Center in Shanghai to put an end to the weapon distribution scheme.
As they get closer to the A.I.M. Research Center, Kingo and Shang-Chi find themselves facing off against some local gangs who have clearly been paid to protect A.I.M.'s assets.
Reach level 22 with all of Kingo's gear.

After making quick work of the hired thugs, the heroes arrive at the A.I.M. Research Center. Finding a point of entry might be trouble for most, but not for two warriors trained in the ways of stealth.
While navigating the corridors of the hidden A.I.M. lab, Kingo and Shang-Chi must push their agility to new heights to avoid detection by automated security scans and laser grids.
Reach level 23 with all of Kingo's gear.

Kingo and Shang-Chi launch a surprise attack on the A.I.M. Scientists running the Research Center. A.I.M. may not be fighters by nature, but the Celestial-enhanced weapons they carry pack a serious punch!
Reach level 24 with all of Kingo's gear.
As Shang-Chi secures the A.I.M. Scientists and confiscates their weapons, Kingo turns his attention to A.I.M.'s computers, scouring their files for any information on the Celestial Component.

Kingo locates data on the Celestial Component and races towards a top-secret lab within the Research Center. The door to the lab is secured by an encrypted lock, so Kingo communes with the Machine to help him break the code.
Reach level 25 with all of Kingo's gear.

When the door to the lab opens, Kingo is greeted by the head of A.I.M. himself, the megalomaniacal M.O.D.O.K. He claims to have a deep personal interest in the new technology being tested on the streets of Shanghai...

Just as M.O.D.O.K. unleashes a powerful wave of psionic blasts, Shang-Chi arrives to join Kingo in the fray. It's four deadly fists versus one deadly mind as these powerful forces clash head-to-enormous-head!
Reach awakened skill level 4 with Kingo.

Once M.O.D.O.K. is defeated, Kingo questions him about the Celestial Component. A.I.M.'s leader admits to having possessed it, but claims that he just sold the component to a high bidder... by the name of Kro.
Reach awakened skill level 6 with Kingo.

Kingo leaves Shang-Chi to clean up after A.I.M. while he returns to join his fellow Eternals in their mission to stop Kro. Hopefully, Kingo's agent can smooth things over with the director until he gets back...
[EPIC QUEST] Complete Story: Not An Act

Few Eternals are as strong-fisted or as strong-headed as the Forgotten One, Gilgamesh. When the Machine locates one of the Celestial Components within the Royal Palace of Asgard, it's decided that he's the perfect warrior for the mission.

When Gilgamesh arrives in Asgard, he is greeted by a battalion of Asgardian warriors who are determined to prevent any invaders from entering their sacred land. The Forgotten One gladly accepts the challenge.
Plowing his way through the Asgardian soldiers and bursting through the front gates of the Royal Palace, Gilgamesh refuses to let anyone, even the gods themselves, stand in the way of his mission.
[HEROES REUNITED] Clear Shock and Awe 3 times
Gilgamesh searches the Asgardian Royal Palace for the Celestial Component. He discovers countless ancient artifacts and weapons of war, but none seem to match Sersi's description.

Storming into a castle full of gods might not seem like a big deal to Gilgamesh, but it certainly ruffles the helmet-feathers of Asgard's current All-Father, Thor, who arrives hammer-in-hand to greet the Eternal warrior.
Unwilling to allow such a brazen assault on Asgard, Thor hurls his mighty hammer at Gilgamesh, beginning an epic battle between immortals that will not soon be forgotten.
Once the thunder of battle subsides, Gilgamesh convinces Thor of the danger that Kro and his Deviants pose. Unwilling to let his beloved Midgard suffer, Thor calls for a momentary truce.
Reach level 15 with all of Gilgamesh's gear.
Thor leads the Forgotten One to Odin's Vault, a chamber deep within the Royal Palace which holds the most valuable -- and most dangerous -- of Asgard's treasures.
Odin's Vault is not easily opened. Since Thor's Odinforce was depleted during battle, he must wait until he has fully recovered to break the vault's seal. Gilgamesh decides to use his fists instead.
As the dust settles, Thor is shocked to learn that his Eternal companion is not the only one to break into Odin's Vault. Awaiting them inside is Thor's brother, the Asgardian God of Mischief, Loki.
Loki sheepishly grins as he admits that the Celestial Component is no longer in the Vault. He then hints that... just perhaps... he might have had something to do with its sudden disappearance...
Reach level 20 with all of Gilgamesh's gear.
When Loki reveals that a certain Deviant warlord may also have played a part in the component's absence, Gilgamesh can no longer contain his rage. He turns his full fury against the God of Mischief!
Even after Loki gets the pummeling he deserves, Gilgamesh refuses to relent. Thor must once again enter the fray, this time to save his own brother's life from the wrath of the Forgotten One.
[EPIC QUEST] Complete Story: Land of the Gods

Thor promises that Loki will face Asgardian justice for what he has done, but now is not the time for revenge. Instead, Asgard's All-Father attempts to shift Gilgamesh's anger back towards its true target: Kro.

Despite her previous alliances with the Deviants, Thena knows that she must side with her fellow Eternals in the search for the Celestial Components. Her leg of the mission takes her to the nation of Latveria.
[BROKEN HARMONY] Clear Brains VS Blades 3 times

The Machine believes that a Celestial Component is being kept within Castle Doom, the home of Latveria's monarch, Victor von Doom. Thena is greeted at the castle gates by a squadron of fully-equipped Doombots.
The Doombots open fire on Thena, who is less than amused by the welcome she has received. Thena uses her cosmic powers to manifest a spear, which she uses to eviscerate Doom's digital doppelgangers.
Thena enters Castle Doom and begins her search for the Celestial Component, striking down more Doombots at every turn. She can feel a strange energy in the air and follows its trail...

Upon arriving in a hidden laboratory, Thena discovers a piece of Celestial technology. It is not the component she seeks, but it does contain great power within... power that does not belong in Doom's hands!
Reach level 15 with all of Thena's gear.
Thena carefully removes the Celestial power source from the lab, but her actions have drawn the attention of another wave of Doom's robotic sentries, this batch even more powerful than the last.

Not expecting much from Doom's mechanical minions, Thena momentarily lets her guard down and suffers an unexpected wound. She must use her powers to heal herself before more automated attackers arrive.
As the waves of Doombots keep coming, Thena realizes that her only chance of ending this unnecessary distraction is finding the king of this castle and appealing to his fragile mortal ego.
Reach level 20 with all of Thena's gear.

Thena reaches the castle's throne room, where she finally finds herself face-to-face with Doctor Doom himself. She attempts diplomacy, but the metal-masked monarch refuses to surrender the Celestial Component... without a fight!
Unable to withstand Thena's assault, Doom makes the wise decision to broker a deal with his powerful foe. She can have the component... but only if she allows him to study her Eternal physiology.

Thena reluctantly accepts Doom's offer, knowing full well that he might betray her at any moment. As Doom runs his scans on her unique Eternal genetic structure, Thena senses a familiar presence nearby...
Warlord Kro has arrived at Castle Doom to seize the Celestial Component for himself. Doom attempts to defend what he believes to be his property, but is quickly struck down by Kro's Deviant army.

Having already faced a foe as formidable as Doom, even Thena's nearly limitless energy may not be enough to win the day against Kro's forces. Instead, she decides to use her history with the Deviants to her advantage...

When all looks lost, Thena calls for a truce, giving Kro the Celestial Component. It may not be the result she sought, but she hopes it will buy her and her fellow Eternals time to find another solution.
Reach level 22 with all of Thena's gear.
Their individual quests might not have succeeded as hoped, but the Eternals have learned over the centuries how powerful they are when they fight together as one. Now, they must reunite once again!
Using the technology developed alongside Iron Man and the Blue Marvel, Sersi hopes to pinpoint the final destination of Warlord Kro and his Deviants. But the device requires a massive power source...
Reach level 23 with all of Thena's gear.
Thena offers the Celestial technology she recovered from Castle Doom as a possible source of energy. However, it will take time for the Machine to determine how to harness its immense power safely.
The power source is activated and the device comes online. Keying in on the six Celestial Components, it tracks Kro back to the place where his quest began -- the Celestial temple in Ancient Babylon.

With the aid of the Machine, the Eternals teleport to Babylon, only to discover a vast army of Deviants awaiting them. But six against a thousand is nothing compared to the odds these Eternals have faced over the centuries!
Reach level 24 with all of Thena's gear.

A final epic war erupts between the Eternals and the Deviants. As they fight their foes together in perfect unison, they are all aware that the true threat still lies ahead in the hands of Warlord Kro.
[TRUE EVOLUTION] Clear The Final Showdown 2 times

Kro attempts to activate the combined Celestial Components to reproduce the experiment that created the Eternals millennia ago. He is moments away from evolving Earth's populace... or obliterating it!
Reach level 25 with all of Thena's gear.

The only hope is for the heroes to combine their energy to form the legendary Eternal Uni-Mind, uniting their vast cosmic power and sharing the knowledge they have uncovered during their individual quests.
With their powers boosted by their deep psychic connection, the Eternals defeat Kro and foil his scheme, sending the Deviants scurrying back to the shadows of Lemuria.
[EPIC QUEST] Complete Story: Dance With Doom
The Eternals decide to destroy the Celestial Components, ensuring the continued safety of the Machine and humanity... at least for a few centuries longer...
As Cable and Havok head towards the Arbor Magna to find Hope Summers, they must fight their way through the demonic hordes that have invaded Krakoa.
As the heroic duo battles their way across Krakoa, they spot more Mutants in peril and race to the rescue.
Cable and Havok gladly welcome the powerful Mutants known as Kid Omega and Exodus into their makeshift squad. Together, they continue on their mission to find Hope.

The heroes reach the Arbor Magna only to discover it has been sealed off by the sentient island. Even their telekinesis combined with Havok's plasma bursts fail to force entry. They must find another way in.
Exodus reveals that Krakoa can grow them an organic key that will grant them entry to this scared spot. But the process will take time... which is something they have precious little of...
The Krakoan Key has grown and the Arbor Magna is unlocked. Cable and his crew race inside to find Hope Summers.
After entering Arbor Magna, Cable's squad is unexpectedly attacked by a mind-controlled Hope. Cable is reluctant to fight his own daughter, but knows he has no choice.
When Hope is defeated, she regains her senses and reveals who the true villain is: Cable's biological mother, Madelyne Pryor -- The Goblin Queen.
The Goblin Queen seems to have vanished from Krakoa, but Cable manages to pick up on traces of temporal energy. It seems Maddie has jumped into an alternate future...
In order to cross both time and space simultaneously, Cable will need to use Forge's tools to give his time-traveling technology a reality-bending upgrade.
The enhancements to Cable's time-tech are fully functional. The heroes jump through a portal into an unknown reality, curious about what the future may hold...
The heroes arrive in a dystopian future where Mutants have been targeted for extinction. As Sentinels arrive on the scene, Cable and his crew realize that they are next on the list.
Hope senses something amiss. This future isn't just the result of a war between Mutants and humans. It's been altered by the Goblin Queen's sinister magic.
The Goblin Queen's spells are preventing the telepaths in Cable's group from getting a lock on her location. They must continue to navigate the treacherous landscape searching for clues.
[TIME TRAVEL] Clear A Bleak Future 3 times
The heroes' path is blocked by a corrupted future version of Cable's own sister, Rachel Summers. They have to take Rachel down if they hope to restore the future and locate the Goblin Queen.
Once Rachel is defeated she regains her memories and reveals that Madelyne may have already departed this reality. The heroes know they have to continue the chase.
Rachel leads the heroes to a high-tech Cerebro unit that can track Madelyne to her current whereabouts, no matter what reality she may have jumped to.
Despite his best efforts, Cable is unsuccessful in powering up the Cerebro unit. The device has clearly taken significant damage over the years and requires repairs.
The team sets out to salvage some Sentinel Circuits in order to get the Cerebro unit operational again.

The Cerebro unit is repaired, but the Goblin Queen's residual magic is still interfering with the signal. The multiple powerful telepaths on their team should be able to give the signal a massive boost.
Using their telepathic powers in unison, linked together by Hope, the heroes are able to pinpoint Madelyne's most recent location: present day Alaska.

Cable opens a portal back to our reality, and the team prepares to step across dimensions once again. With nothing left for her in this dark future, Rachel asks to accompany her friends on their adventure.
Cable and his squad make their way to the Summers home. But the idyllic scene suddenly becomes a lot less perfect as demons burst forth from the Alaskan snow.
The Goblin Queen's demon hordes attack, and the Mutant heroes find themselves fighting for their lives.
The demons are momentarily defeated, but even greater trouble lies ahead. The heroes must push through massive drifts of snow to reach their destination.
Madelyne Pryor awaits the heroes on the porch of the Summers homestead. When Cable refuses to join his mother's crusade, she calls on his father to knock some sense into him.
[BROTHER IN CRISIS] Clear Faded Memories 2 times
Cyclops has fallen completely under the spell of his ex-wife, Madelyne, and doesn't hold back. He confronts his fellow X-Men in an epic battle that pits a father against his own children.
The battle with Cyclops provided the perfect distraction, allowing Madelyne to escape once again. The heroes must find a way to follow her.
Exodus senses that Madelyne is still in this timeline, so Cable can't use his time-travel tech to follow her. But Cyclops suggests a more "classic" solution.
Cyclops leads the heroes to an aviation hangar behind the family home. There, they find one of the X-Men's legendary Blackbird jets in storage.
Cyclops admits that the Blackbird hasn't flown in quite some time, so they'll need to perform some maintenance before it can lift off. But the parts should be readily available in the hangar.
After collecting all of the Blackbird Parts, the heroes make the necessary repairs to get the X-Jet air-worthy once more.
In her increasing panic, Madelyne is not covering her tracks as well as before. Exodus uses his vast telepathic powers to locate her at the abandoned X-Mansion in Westchester, NY.
The heroes follow Madelyne to the X-Mansion, where they come under attack from a legion of the Goblin Queen's loyal demon soldiers.
While fighting the demons, Cyclops finds a broken piece of an ancient Rune that was once used to protect the Mansion grounds from demonic forces.
The heroes scour the grounds of the X-Mansion to collect the other scattered Rune pieces. Once combined, Cyclops believes they might help end the demonic invasion.
The heroes assemble the shattered Rune and expel Madelyne's demonic minions. Now, to find their Goblin Queen...
The heroes pursue Madelyne into the heart of the abandoned X-Mansion. Her dark magic warps their path, allowing her to stay just out of reach.
The Goblin Queen's magic has altered the Mansion's own high-tech defense systems, and the building itself begins to fight back against the heroes who once called it home.
Reach level 20 with all of Havok's equipment

When the heroes finally locate Madelyne, Cyclops reaches out to her in hopes of ending this madness. But Madelyne isn't interested in hearing what her ex-husband has to say. She has her eyes on another Summers bother...
[BROTHER IN CRISIS] Clear Manipulated Will 5 times

Havok temporarily falls under the sway of Madelyne's magic and attacks his allies. In his current state, he would do anything to protect the woman he thinks he loves -- even if it means destroying his own family!
Reach level 21 with all of Havok's equipment
Fortunately, the full might of Havok's cosmic energy wasn't enough to defeat the combined forces of the Summers family. It was, however, enough to rip a fracture between realities!
Madelyne flees through the rift between realities, but the heroes are slightly more cautious. Before leaping after her, they decide to investigate what lies on the other side.
Reach level 22 with all of Havok's equipment

The heroes discover that the rift leads to Limbo, the demonic dimension where the Goblin Queen reigns supreme! They know they are in for serious trouble, but they must step into the breach nonetheless.
[UNFORTUNATE FATE] Clear Ready For Battle 3 times
Cable and his extended family forge ahead into the demonic realm of Limbo to face off against Madelyne. But they are fully aware that it won't be easy to defeat the Goblin Queen in her own kingdom.
Reach level 23 with all of Havok's equipment
The demons of Limbo are significantly stronger in their home dimension. The heroes will have to fight harder than ever if they hope to prevail.
Kid Omega remembers that, when Magik ruled Limbo, her Soul Sword made her almost unbeatable. Perhaps if the heroes forged similar weapons they might stand a chance...
The heroes search for the ancient scroll that holds the enchantment for crafting powerful Soul Swords. These weapons could be the key to defeating The Goblin Queen.
Once the Soul Swords are forged, the heroes must test their might on some of Limbo's most dangerous demons.
Reach level 24 with all of Havok's equipment
The Soul Swords prove to be as powerful as the heroes had hoped. With their new weapons at the ready, they must seek out the Goblin Queen herself for the final battle.
[UNFORTUNATE FATE] Clear Queen of Limbo 2 times
With Soul Swords in hand, the assembled heroes rush into battle, ready to strike down the Goblin Queen once and for all.
After her defeat, Madelyne makes a desperate plea to her son, Cable, to spare her life. Havok comes to Maddie's defense as well, leaving the other heroes with a tough choice to make.
Reach level 25 with all of Havok's equipment
Together, the heroes agree to give Madelyne another chance. After all, hero or villain, she is still family. And the X-Men never abandon their own.
The heroes decide to escort Madelyne back to Krakoa, where she will be closely monitored and given the support she needs to recover from the trauma that has haunted her for so long.
As they depart Limbo, Cable wishes that his relationship with his mother wasn't so complicated... but Hope offers some valuable insight that may change his perspective...

Hercules follows Amadeus Cho's tip, which leads him to a group of A.I.M. soldiers terrorizing the streets of New York. Led by the menacing  M.O.D.O.K., they are planning to use Dimensional Rift Generators to wreak havoc on the city!
[THE JOURNEY BEGINS] Clear Big-Headed Brawl 4 times

Hercules refuses to let M.O.D.O.K. and his A.I.M. lackeys ravage the streets of this fair city. With his Golden Mace in hand, Hercules leaps into action, hoping to pound some sense into M.O.D.O.K.'s enormous cranium.

M.O.D.O.K. proves to be no match for the Prince of Power! However, the trial is far from over. To fully resolve the threat at hand, Hercules must find and destroy all of the Dimensional Rift Generators installed by A.I.M.

While destroying the final Dimensional Rift Generator, Hercules's Golden Mace is pulled from his hand and vanishes into thin air. After finishing the job with his fists, Herc tries to contact Amadeus to help him find his sacred weapon... but he receives no reply...

Deciding to return to Olympus to seek his father's counsel, Hercules is met by his sister Athena on a mountain path. Hercules asks for Athena's great wisdom to help him find his lost weapon. She agrees, but says she needs Hercules to help her first.

On their morning walk through Olympus, Athena's owl Pallas became startled by something and flew deep into the forest below. Athena implores her brother to follow Pallas's trail and return her beloved bird to her.

Hercules returns with Pallas perched upon his shoulder. A relieved Athena admits that odd things have been happening in Olympus and that Pallas's sudden exodus is likely connected. Hercules is glad to help his sister get to the bottom of it... once she finds his Golden Mace...

Since the Golden Mace is no longer in this dimension, Athena must perform a complex ancient ritual to divine its location. Once she has found the weapon, a simple spell should swiftly return it to Hercules's hand.

With his Golden Mace recovered, Hercules prepares to charge into Olympus. But Athena reveals that she heard prophetic whispers during her ritual. They spoke the words "Pegasus is in danger" and showed her a vision of where Hercules must travel next...

The Prince of Power enters the Project: P.E.G.A.S.U.S. bunker, eager to stop the rampaging monster from destroying the irreplaceable research within. Herc has bested the Hulk in battle before, and he is confident he can do it again!
[THE JOURNEY BEGINS] Clear Brains and Brawn 4 times

Hercules is taken aback when her realizes that the Hulk attacking the bunker is not Bruce Banner, but rather his dear friend Amadeus Cho. After failing to persuade Amadeus to end his assault, Herc reluctantly resorts to a more physical solution.

Following an epic struggle, the Hulked-out Amadeus Cho has been defeated by Hercules. Yet even after Cho's temper has cooled, he can’t seem to revert to his original state. But Herc refuses to let his companion remain a brainless brute.

Following his sister Athena's advice, Hercules joins the grateful Project: P.E.G.A.S.U.S. scientists in their lab to help them construct a Gamma Siphon capable of removing excess radiation and restoring Cho to his normal self.

Back to normal, Cho tries to remember how he went full Hulk. All he knows is that he was assisting the team at Project: P.E.G.A.S.U.S. with their research... and then a beautiful woman bewitched him into attacking the base...

Hercules instantly suspects that the Asgardian seductress, Amora the Enchantress, may have been the one behind this attack. Cho isn't convinced, however, suggesting they check all of the bunker's security footage and entry logs to find out for sure.
[GODS OF OLYMPUS] Clear Beautiful Secret 5 times

The security footage proves Herc's initial theory wrong. The true culprit is his own half-sister, Aphrodite -- also known as Venus. It was she who charmed Amadeus into attacking. But for what purpose? Hercules is eager to find out, and plans to pull no punches!

Venus claims that she was merely testing Cho’s might, knowing she would need a Champion on her side. Hercules wonders who a goddess could possibly need protection from. Venus reveals that their uncle, Hades, has made plans to claim Olympus for himself!

With the help of Venus and Athena, Hercules and Amadeus Cho descend into the Underworld to stop Hades. But as they make their way through the serene Elysian Fields, they instead find themselves face-to-face with Ares, the God of War.

Ares is gathering the souls of fallen warriors to build a powerful army for Hades. The God of War warns the heroes not to interfere with him. Hercules considers doing battle with his bloodthirsty brother, but his allies stop him from making a reckless decision.

Hercules is frustrated by their inaction, but Athena suggests another less dangerous path to victory. To reach it, they must search for the shattered pieces of two legendary swords that were lost in the Elysian Fields.
Athena tells the tale of Grasscutter, the sword that was once used by Phobos, the son of Ares. Hercules and Amadeus scour the tall grass of the Elysian Fields for the fragments of this blessed blade.
With the pieces of Grasscutter retrieved, Athena next tells the tale of Godkiller. Whereas the first sword once belonged to Phobos, the second sword is the one that struck the boy down.
Just as they sought the pieces of Grasscutter, Hercules and Amadeus must now recover the missing fragments of Godkiller. These two swords may be their only chance to eliminate Ares and his army.
Hercules is skeptical about the plan, as he does not see how they can restore the shattered weapons without a forge. But Athena explains that she can temporarily mend the blades with her magic.

There's nothing Hercules hates more than sitting and doing nothing when glorious battle is on the horizon, but Amadeus manages to convince his immortal friend that Athena's spell to repair the swords is worth waiting for.
After Grasscutter and Godkiller have been fully restored to their former glory, Hercules and his allies prepare themselves to do battle with Ares and his army of souls!
[GODS OF OLYMPUS] Clear Deadly Duel 5 times

With Grasscutter in Amadeus's hand and Godkiller in Hercules's, the heroes return to Ares and demand that he face them in combat. Always eager to prove himself on the field of battle, Ares agrees without hesitation.

Upon recognizing Grasscutter and Godkiller, Ares yields, stating that Phobos wouldn't have wanted more bloodshed between the gods. He calls off his soldiers and allows the heroes to travel go deeper into the Underworld to stop Hades.

Before the heroes can depart, Ares warns them that a mere mortal like Amadeus will not survive in Hades' realm for long. He advises the party to find him a Golden Apple in the Garden of the Hesperides at the end of the Elysium Fields before they descend further.

Hercules and his allies find the apple tree that Ares told them of, but are saddened to see that it bears no fruit. Venus says she can use her song to restore the tree back to its splendor and make the apples grow once more.

The tree blooms and Amadeus is able to pick a Golden Apple. He bites into it, tasting the most perfect fruit a mortal has ever eaten. As he feels a hint of immortality flow through him, he knows he's ready for the next step in their journey.

Upon arriving in the Underworld, Hercules is met by its ruler, Hades. Herc's uncle is clearly not pleased to see his nephew, and he is even less pleased when he sees that a mortal has invaded his sacred territory.

Infuriated by the presence of Amadeus Cho, Hades casts a spell and banishes the young hero to the far side of the River Styx. Hades warns the son of Zeus that a far worse punishment awaits him if he causes any further chaos.

Hercules knows the unspeakable horrors that hide in this wretched realm, and he is not willing to let his dearest companion suffer a fate worse than death. He implores Athena to help him find a solution.
Athena pulls out a mystical orb and uses it to consult an ancient oracle. Her magic is weakened in the Underworld, however, so it will take longer than usual to get the answers she seeks.

The oracle finally responds to Athena, revealing that Hercules will need a Gold Coin to cross the River Styx. Unfortunately, every coin in the Underworld has been horded by Hades and stashed away in his palace.
[HEAVEN AND HELL] Clear King of Hell 3 times

Hercules and his sisters boldly march into their uncle's palace, fighting their way through demonic guards before confronting Hades directly. Unwilling to surrender his treasure, Hades leaves the trio of gods no other option but to win their spoils in combat.

The Gods of Olympus defeat the Lord of the Underworld in combat. When the battle is over, Hades makes a swift escape. Hercules quickly shifts his focus to finding his uncle's treasure so that he can rescue Amadeus.

Hades' palace is fraught with dangers, but that doesn't deter Hercules from his search. Though it is well hidden, he vows to find the treasure stored within so that his friend's soul can be retrieved.

Hercules planned to take only a single Gold Coin, but is shocked to find one of Zeus's Thunderbolts among the hidden treasures. He takes both the Gold Coin and the Thunderbolt and sets out to rescue Cho.
Reach level 20 with all of Hercules's equipment
After paying the Gold Coin to the ferryman, Charon, Hercules crosses the River Styx and reunites with Amadeus. But time is short, and Hercules insists that they must return to Olympus immediately.

Hercules and his allies travel back to Mount Olympus, where they deliver information to Zeus about all that transpired. Their hope is that he will punish Hades accordingly. But they are shocked when Zeus shows barely any response.
Reach level 21 with all of Hercules's equipment

Hercules is baffled when Zeus admits that he has been the mastermind behind this ploy all along. It was Zeus himself who ordered Hades to have Ares gather an army. The Lord of the Underworld was merely a pawn to cover Zeus's tracks.

When asked why, Zeus explains that he's disgusted by a world that no longer worships him as they once did. He plans to attack humanity to instill fear and respect once more. He warns that he will never forgive Hercules if he interferes with his plan.
Reach level 22 with all of Hercules's equipment

Knowing he could not currently win a battle against the most powerful Olympian god, Hercules decides to take his leave. Though he is angry at himself for not even trying to fight back, Venus tells Hercules that he already holds a better solution in his hand...

Venus suggests that Hercules should collect all of Zeus's Thunderbolts. Then, she will have her husband, Hephaestus, use his forge to infuse their power into Herc’s own Golden Mace. Hercules carefully sets off to gather his father's most sacred weapons.
Reach level 23 with all of Hercules's equipment

Athena believes that Venus's plan may indeed work, but says that they'll need to line the Golden Mace with Adamantine, the fabled Metal of the Gods, to properly channel the near-omnipotent power of Zeus's Thunderbolts.

Hercules and Amadeus search Mount Olympus for any traces of the rare metal known as Adamantine. Though it is not an easy element to find, they are not willing to give up until they have all that they need.

With both the Adamantine and Zeus's Thunderbolts now in hand, Hercules gives his Golden Mace to Venus. She promises that she will take the gathered materials to Hephaestus's forge so that he can craft the ultimate weapon.
[RESEARCH] Brilliant Grasscutter and God Killer Crafting

While Hercules's Golden Mace is being enhanced, Zeus prepares to unleash his army upon the world below. There is no more time to delay. Before they enter the fray, Athena searches for a spell to strengthen the blades of Grasscutter and Godkiller.
Reach level 24 with all of Hercules's equipment

With Grasscutter and Godkiller stronger than ever, Hercules and his allies arrive for the final showdown with Zeus. Just as the battle is about to begin, Venus returns with the enhanced Golden Mace and hands it to Hercules.
[HEAVEN AND HELL] Clear Sky Father 3 times
Hercules, Amadeus, Athena, and Venus join forces in an effort to bring down Zeus and end his attack on the mortal world before it can truly begin!

Using Zeus's own power against him, Hercules and his team narrowly defeat Zeus and thwart his plan. When Ares realizes that he was a pawn in his father's game, he orders his army to lay down their weapons and return to the Elysian Fields.
Reach level 25 with all of Hercules's equipment
Athena delivers her disgraced father to a cell on Mount Olympus where she and Venus can watch over him. She thanks Hercules and Amadeus for saving both Olympus and the mortal realm.
Having written a bold new chapter in their legend, Hercules and Amadeus depart from Olympus, ready to begin planning their next great adventure together!

The Book of Cagliostro, which contains highly dangerous and ancient spells, has been stolen. Retrieve it before things get out of hand.

This sword engraved with the tusk of an extradimensional dragon has been lost since Ragnarok. Lady Sif asks Doctor Strange to replicate it.
Adamantium, one of the strongest metals on the planet, is a blessing and a curse to Wolverine. It is a necessary substance to shapen his claws.
Cyclops needs his visor to control his concussive blasts. Repair the visor to help him see again.

Infused with the power of Cyttorak, this ominous crimson jewel is extremely powerful. Retrieve it before it falls into the wrong hands.

Unable to control the Phoenix's immense power, Jean Grey occasionally goes berserk. Find a way to prevent her from losing control.
The submachine gun is simple enough for anyone to use, and it is highly effective. It is the weapon of choice for expert mercenaries.

To achieve his goal of creating extraordinary mutants, Mister Sinister is cloning an incredibly powerful mutant, Cable. Stop Mister Sinister before he clones Cable’s genes to produce an army of powerful soldiers.
This sword can be a useful weapon against superhumans. Produce as many as possible in case it breaks.
Cable from is trying to go back to the past and fix his mistakes. Produce a time travel device for Cable.
Fantasti-Flare is Fantastic Four’s signal flare. Produce as many as possible so that everyone could use it when they need help.

The unstable molecules adapt quickly as the Fantastic Four use their abilities, which allows them to be clothed at all times. Collect the unstable molecules to produce uniforms for the Fantastic Four.
A new blueprint is needed to expand the Baxter Building.
Doctor Doom’s creations, the Doombots, are equipped with cutting-edge technology. Dismantle it and find its weakness to collect intell on the real Doctor Doom.
This magnificent hammer was given to Beta Ray Bill by Odin. A sister to Mjolnir, it allows those worthy of wielding it to produce intense lightning power.
Vaccines need to be made to cure the Super Heroes of the corruption coming from a dark, alternate universe.
As Star-Lord's primary weapons, these blasters shoot elemental bolts and have fought in defense of the galaxy time and again.

This mystical sword is used in the Necropsiy Rite to eliminate the cosmic entity of Death in any universe. In order to stop the Many-Angled Ones and their dark plans to let life corrupt endlessly, the rite must be stopped.
S.H.I.E.L.D. may be gone, but Norman Osborn is creating his own organization to fill the void. Under his guidance, H.A.M.M.E.R., will deliver a new brand of justice across the world.

This Quinjet has fallen into the hands of the Dark Avengers, allowing them easy travel to any location. This vehicle's arsenal has been significantly upgraded from the original version used by the Avengers.

In order to convince the world that they are heroes, the Dark Avengers need to look the part. Dressed in the costumes of fallen protectors, each of these former villains look like heroes... but will their actions follow suit?

This ancient axe is wielded by the God of War, Ares. He has used it to cut through hordes of enemies on the field of battle for centuries. Now, he chooses to use its blades to save lives alongside the Dark Avengers.

As cosmic beings, the Celestials are those with the powerful ability to create and destroy planets and races. They arrived on Earth a million years ago and created the Sapiens, Deviants, and Eternals as part of their quest for universal knowledge.
The body cells of the Eternals have cosmic energy with which they can control every molecule in their body with their mind.

This race was created by the Celestials along with the Eternals, and unlike other races, it has mutation features that change randomly when passing from one generation to the next. Rivals with the Eternals, they have waged a war between races throughout their eons-long history.

The mental union of the Prime Eternal along with other Eternals forms a powerful psychic entity called the Uni-mind through mental consciousness. A Uni-mind ritual requires a minimum of three Eternals.
A special armor worn by Havok. This dedicated combat suit not only helps contain Havok's excess energy, but also helps him to direct it toward a specific target.
The signature rifle used by Cable. It can convert raw energy into powerful plasma bursts, and has been a key weapon in Cable's arsenal.
Unlike the other hosts of the Phoenix Force, Rachel Summers resisted against the entity's cosmic power. Eventually accepting her fate, she came to be known as the Daughter of the Phoenix.
Madelyne Pryor hid magic circles in various places to thwart Havok and Cable's efforts. To undo her plan, all of the concealed hexes must be located and removed.
Wisdom can be a great defense or a great offense. Athena, the goddess of wisdom, asks to retrieve her spear and shield.
Hacking is the only way to safely penetrate the enemy's security network. Cho must retrieve his personal computer in order to hack into the enemy's system.
Venus lost her belt, and the people of Earth have begun to forget love. You must help her find the belt and reclaim her title of "Goddess of Love".
Made of the Olympian metal, Adamantine, this axe is a deadly weapon used since the ancient wars against the Titans.

Conquer the universe with style. Thanos and his generals are on a mission to destroy everything in their path. Suit up with this collection to show the universe who's boss!

Thanos and his elite guard will stop at nothing to collect the Infinity Stones. Take a stand against this cosmic threat on the galaxy's final battleground: Earth! Harness this special gear crafted to save the universe from desruction.

Thanos and his elite guard will stop at nothing to collect the Infinity Stones. Bring the fight to outer space and face Thanos head-on with these uniforms crafted to defend the cosmos from complete collapse!
Fight the Age of Apocalypse and save mutantkind! These futuristic looks will help the X-Men stand against Apocalypse, the first and most powerful mutant of all time.
It's main event time! Hela, the Goddess of Death, has returned from Hel to conquer Asgard. Step into the arena with these gladiator outfits and defend Asgard from her wrath!
Choose your side and stand for what you believe in with these epic uniforms. Join team Captain America in support of super heroic autonomy.
Choose your side and stand for what you believe in with these epic uniforms. Join team Iron Man in support of super heroic accountability.
Open your mind with these mystic looks. Even a Master of the Mystic Arts wouldn't be able to pass up these magical threads.
Cause some trouble in style. Leave no galaxy in the universe unguarded with uniforms that are truly out of this world.

Monsters are falling from the sky like rain and Earth needs professional monster hunters to protect cities across the globe! Equip your team with these exclusive uniforms to defend the planet from the monster horde!
Earth is caught in an intergalactic war between two alien races! Suit up with these cosmic uniforms to fly higher, further, and faster in order to save the planet from the Kree and the Skrulls.
An elite mutant team needs an elite set of uniforms. Harness the power of the X-Force with these deadly looks.
The covert mutant unit, X-Force, will do whatever it takes to get the job done. Try on these special outfits to help them complete their mission!
Get your team ready with the new uniforms! It’ll help on the final battle against Thanos.
Save the universe with the heroes in their new and improved Avengers uniforms.
Avenge the fallen with the team uniforms.
Never give up! You must avenge the fallen.
Defend humanity and mutantkind alike with these new and improved X-Men uniforms!
Powerful villains have come to Earth through a dimension rift. Defend the neighborhood with these upgraded uniforms!
Protect the future of humanity from all threats with the Future Foundation uniforms.

The sovereignty of universal birth and destruction, the Phoenix Force selected each of these mutants as its vessels.\nNow the Phoenix Five fight for a better future for mutantkind with the flames of life!
The newest heroes of the East have become even stronger! At a moment's notice, the Agents of Atlas will gather anywhere around the world to protect Asia and beyond.

This new Avengers team formed as a representation of the peaceful coexistence of Inhumans, Mutants, and humans. The Uncanny Avengers fight for the unity of all races and to protect all earthly inhabitants!

There's moolah to be made!
Deadpool has formed a new team of mercenaries all looking to earn some extra coin.
Check out their “teamwork” and “marketable” battle skills,
because nothing is more motivating than money!

In the very distant future, the Avengers have come together once again to defend humanity from falling under the control of vastly powerful robots.\nFight for a new future with the Avengers, geared with advanced technology!\nAvengers, assemble!

In the midst of a reality warp, Captain America shockingly declared himself the supreme leader of Hydra, the evil organization he stood against for so long. He and new villainous allies don new costumes as they conquer the world. Hail Hydra!

In the face of discrimination and persecution, Mutantkind has rallied together, creating a nation dedicated only to the betterment of all mutants. Now united, the mutants will fight for a new future without fear!
The Black Widow's latest mission takes her deep into her dark and storied past. Meet the heroes and villains of this new story, complete with new looks, and stop the return of the insidious Red Room!

The Guardians of the Galaxy, complete with all-new members, unite to stop a crisis capable of consuming the universe! Fight against this infectious threat as some of the most powerful cosmic Super Heroes in the galaxy.
These new Hulks are ready to tear the world asunder with their massive power. Gamma radiation and powers from beyond our world manifest on these monsters as new uniforms!

Eons ago, the extraterrestrial Kree manipulated the genes of prehistoric humans to create a new race called Inhumans. Having once advocated for peace, the most powerful of the modern-day Inhumans now don armor from across time and space and rise to battle for the sake of their people.

The rise of Mephisto in Las Vegas has thrown the realms of magic and mortals into chaos. Only those equipped with the mystical power to handle such a threat can save us now. From the moonlit night to the Dark Dimension, this gathering of great power will put an end to Mephisto's reign.

Born of a dark god from before the birth of the universe, the symbiotes stir to life and claim new hosts as Carnage attempts to reconnect with their creator! Villains and heroes alike must join forces as the alien threat awakens, for god is coming...

Norman Osborn, once known as the Green Goblin, organized a new group of Avengers to win the people's trust. However, his true intentions remain hidden from anyone outside of his villainous team. Now united to protect our world, the Dark Avengers have arrived!

The Black Winter is nigh, threatening the Ten Realms and beyond. All-Father Thor rallies his fellow Asgardian heroes to defend their world as he accepts the Power Cosmic and becomes the Herald of Thunder!
The Mutants have established their ground on their own nation of Krakoa. Meet the mutants and their allies who have gained new power to protect their nation in the face of danger!

Four heroes have reunited to fight against a dark threat in the criminal underbelly of New York. Each of them has their own dark past, but it's time for them to unite as one to protect the chaotic streets of the city they call home.

Various heroes of the MARVEL Future Fight world are back with new looks! While some are classic and some are even from the heroes' darker times as villains, these costumes celebrate iconic moments for some of the most celebrated heroes.

The Black Order, the generals of Thanos and the most powerful warriors in the universe, is back with completely original looks. Armed with the latest technology, the Black Order continue their quest to conquer the universe and reshape it in their image!

The Super Heroes who inherited the will of Captain America have returned with new looks. The new Captain America and the Winter Soldier also join the conniving villain Baron Zemo in his new attire to accomplish their mission. Meet the unlikeliest of teams, bonded by a common goal.
THE FALCON AND THE WINTER SOLDIER

The Ultimates, having protected Earth and universes beyond mortal comprehension, return with new and classic looks. Since they take pride in defending the world from extradimensional threats, this team joins the battle to maintain the order of the universe!

It's doomsday! Armed with powerful technology, Doctor Doom travels through time and space to rule the world. But our heroes are prepared to avoid a catastrophic future. Don armor made with futuristic technology and prepare for war!
The team of Asian Super Heroes returns in new and updated looks. Lead the Agents of Atlas on their individual journeys of growth!

One of the most powerful entities in the universe, the Phoenix Force has returned to Earth to find its next host. These Super Heroes have become more powerful with the power of the Phoenix coursing through them!

Ancient guardians tasked with protecting the Earth and humanity for eons have returned. Meet the Eternal warriors who have reunited after eons apart in order to stop the Deviants, genetic terrors who have reappeared to conquer Earth.

A grand festival is being held in the mutant base Krakoa to nominate the next X-Men. Heroes from all over the galaxy have arrived to promote peace for all races. Check out the beautiful outfits of the mutant heroes in attendance.

Heroes have reunited to defend the Infinity Stones from those that seek one of the most powerful forces in the universe. These super heroes don new uniforms to protect the order of the Multiverse from these cosmic Super Villains.
Kate Bishop becomes a hero when she meets her idol, Hawkeye, and is thrust into the middle of a world of trouble. Now meet the newest heroes who defend their city and people in new costumes!

The time has come for Doctor Strange to once again use mystical might to save the Multiverse before it falls into chaos. As its borders collapse, these heroes from across time and space unite with new looks to save the Multiverse from a chaotic crisis.
These unique heroes have formed a united team to keep peace across the planet. When they join forces, they fear no threat. Behold, the newest Avengers uniforms!

New Asgard, home to the remaining Asgardian people, has been attacked by a darkness from beyond the stars. The Mighty Thor and her allies must unite to overcome their own adversity and rediscover what it means to be a god and a hero!
After mysterious hammers fell to Earth, heroes and villains alike were drawn to pick them up, gaining Asgardian power. Behold the new faces of these warriors who might very well break the world.

With the power of light, Venom defeated Knull and became the new King in Black. However, after the symbiote's great war ended, an age-old enemy took advantage of the chaos to strike. The symbiotes had no choice but to reunite again to thwart this evil.

TALOKAN, the advanced city sleeping in the depths of the sea, has finally been revealed to the world. Behold the new uniforms of the heroes united to protect Wakanda against the ruler of the sea, Namor.
The X-Men have returned to stop Jean Grey, who has fully unleashed the power of the Dark Phoenix. This X-Men team, with new and familiar faces alike, is poised to stop her rampage!
The Super Hero protectors of the Moon Temple have returned with new looks. Behold the Warriors of the Sky, who overcame their own adversities and unite as true heroes to protect our world!

A massive force from beyond time seeks to conquer every dimension beyond the Quantum Realm. Behold the new uniforms of the Pym and Lang heroes, fighting to keep the peace of a world twisted in time and space!
The villainous enemies of Spider-Man have set aside their differences to wreak havoc on the city together. Behold the new uniforms of these Super Villains ready to take down their Web-Warrior foes!
The Guardians of the Galaxy are back with a new style! Meet the Guardians, wearing film-inspired uniforms and embarking on a dangerous mission to protect the universe!
Miles' adventure as Spider-Man enters a new chapter! Behold the new uniforms of these interdimensional Spider-Heroes.
Malekith, king of the Dark Elves, has lead his soldiers to invade all of the Ten Realms. Behold the new looks of the Asgardian warriors from across time who have returned to protect all worlds!
The villain Stryfe is back stronger than before! Meet the members of the X-Force, see their new uniforms, and embark on a dangerous mission to stop him!
Meet the new members of the Midnight Suns, formed by Doctor Strange and other heroes to fight against unleashed mystic forces!
Adventure with The Marvels, a group of powerful super heroes protecting the Earth using a variety of light energy and incredible teamwork!

Across the multiverse, completely unexpected things occur that change the course of the world as we know it. Behold the characters who have had their world changed by the simplest occurrences when we ask the question: What if...?
The galaxy's greatest heroes come together to prevent crisis from threats across the universe. Meet the heroes and their new uniforms who are the true protectors of boundless space.
Sentry has returned after embracing the Void! Check out his new look and the new uniforms of the powerful heroes who dare to challenge him.
Franklin and Valeria Richards, the new generation of Super Heroes have joined!\nCheck out the new look of the Fantastic Four, who join forces to face an even greater threat!
TVA has requested help from the greatest Mutant duo!\nThey must save the world from Cassandra Nova's evil plan!
To resolve a case that will shake the Marvel Universe, Iron Man and his allies join hands to face a new threat!\nMeet the new look of Iron Man and his allies returned with stronger armor!

What if Earth's mightiest heroes...were zombies?!\nThe entire world has been infected with the Quantum Virus from an unknown world. Can Okoye fight through the zombie heroes and find Black Panther, who is missing?
The symbiote heroes and the darkly empowered Spider-Man come together! Will they be able to stop Knull's heinous ambitions and protect the world?
Justice defeated... There are heroes who survive in a desolate world ruled by villains. Will Hawkeye and Star-Lord succeed in avenging their dead comrades and find hope?
The new Captain America, Sam Wilson faces an invisible threat. Can Captain America and Falcon stop the enemy's evil plot to take over the entire world?

The Devil's Work Is Never Done

The heroes seek to uncover the ugly side of the Kingpin in power.
Can they teach the Kingpin that sin comes with a price?
Meet the battle between those who seek to protect peace and those who seek to bring about chaos!

Careful who you assemble.

A Secret agent, a hitman, a Red Room assassin, and a fake Captain America.
It's the worst combination, but they need each other.
No superpowers, no heroes, but no surrender. Can they escape their own past?

Check out the Thunderbolts in action!

Back to the 90s! The story continues as the X-Men, a band of mutants who use their uncanny gifts to protect a world that hates and fears them, are challenged like never before, forced to face a dangerous and unexpected new future.\n\nMeet the X-Men in action now!

Welcome to the Family.\n\nFour brave astronauts go into space and return as heroes! Together, the Fantastic Four overcome any obstacle. Can they protect Earth from Galactus and the Silver Surfer who are trying to devour it? Meet the First Family in action now!

The toughest and most savage heroes have come together! Can they protect the world from the chaos unleashed by powerful dark forces?\nA team of warriors, not heroes! Meet the Savage Avengers in action now!

A new generation of heroes must battle against an ever-spreading zombie scourge. Can the surviving heroes bring hope to a devastated world? Meet Shang-Chi and Ms. Marvel in their desperate battle to survive now!
The next generation of Super Heroes has arrived!\nFormed by Vision's "Avengers Fail-Safe Program," will they be able to fill the void left by the missing Avengers?\nMeet the next generation now!

Machines of immense destructive power have appeared!\nAs humanity stands before these unstoppable forces, which path will we choose? Are we destined for destruction or salvation? Meet the grease-stained machines in action now!

Mutants with extraordinary powers have gathered!\nFrom the silver-armored samurai to the Omega-level rebel, from the underground punk rock star to the forsaken bride...\nMeet these diverse and unique mutants right now!

The heroes of Marvel Rivals have burst into Future Fight!\nAs the Timestream spirals into chaos, can they put an end to Doctor Doom’s ruthless ambitions?\nStep into battle with powerful champions from across the Timestream Entanglement!

The All-Father, the warrioress who protects Asgard, the agent who inherited the power of the divine beast, the thief who stole the power of the World Tree, and the butcher who hates their power have gathered in one place. Amid the chaos where creation and destruction intermingle, where will their destiny lead them? Now, witness the moment when might and wrath clash!

The X-Men saved Earth from the crash of Asteroid M!
But their story is not over.
Scattered across various timelines—from Egypt in 3000 BC, where a young En Sabah Nur resides, to the future year 3960 AD, where a young Nathan awaits—what challenges await them?
Meet the X-Men in action now!

The name Peter Parker may not exist anymore, but Spider-Man is still protecting New York City. Amidst a strangely interconnected string of crimes, will he be able to escape the labyrinthine web? Watch Spider-Man's latest adventure unfold now!

Annihilus, ruler of the Negative Zone and the living embodiment of death, has launched a massive invasion. While some unite against this cosmic threat, others exploit the chaos or even join his ranks. Witness the fate of a universe teetering on the brink of destruction.

Orphaned from a young age and raised by his uncle and aunt, Peter Parker is a student, a scientist, and a photographer, depending on the occasion. He sells pictures of Spider-Man to J. Jonah Jameson while hiding his true identity.\n\n"He thinks I'm just a typical teenage kid!"

When Spider-Man first acquired his superpowers, he didn't use them to help those in need. However, when he lost his Uncle as a result of his decision, he learned a lesson that changed his life forever.\n\n"With great power comes great responsibility."
Aunt May is Peter Parker's aunt who runs F.E.A.S.T. to help her community. Whenever Peter visits her, she says this with a warm smile:\n\n"I made your favorite, Petey. It's a Whitcake!"

He took in Peter after the child lost his parents and raised him like his own. He was the father figure to Peter until the very end, for his death taught Peter a life-changing lesson.\n\n"My death is one of the greatest gifts the universe ever gave you."

She is Spider-Man's love interest adorned with red hair and freckles. Peter Parker is able to endure his life full of misfortune and hardships thanks to MJ by his side.\n\n"Face it, Tiger... You just hit the jackpot!"

Gwen Stacy is Peter's colleague from university and his first love. She was attracted to Peter's intellect and eventually became his partner, only to be killed accidentally during a battle between Spider-Man and Green Goblin and mark an irreversible turn of events in Peter Parker and Norman Osborn's relationship.\n\n"In every other universe, Gwen Stacy falls for Spider-Man. And in every other universe... it doesn't end well."

She's the daughter of Walter Hardy, an infamous thief. She learned combat skills and acrobatics to overcome the trauma caused by her ex-boyfriend from college. Felicia wanted to exact revenge on her ex, but found a new lease on life in her father's footsteps.\n\n"I'm just your bad-girl ex-girlfriend, so what does it matter?"

The iconic thief of New York. She doesn't call herself a hero and she doesn't discriminate between heroes and villains when picking her target. Anyone who stands in her way will suffer from misfortune, as expected of Black Cat.\n\n"Darling I'll take larceny over virtue every time!"
Like many teenagers, she has had many confrontations with her parents regarding her future career.\n\n"What am I doing with my life?"

The life of walking the beaten path is over for her. Ever since a radioactive spider bit her, she has become a hero and paved her own path.\n\n"My future? I don't even know what I'm going to have for dinner tonight."
She used to be an ordinary girl with parents who were scientists. That was, until she almost lost her life from a radiation exposure.\n\n"They controlled me. I was their puppet."

After being exposed to radiation, she was injected with a spider serum and acquired superpowers. Even in her pregnancy, she fights on to make the world a better place for her child.\n\n"Spiders don't have families. But I do."

A mercenary and bounty hunter from Symkaria, she is the leader of the Wild Pack. Inheriting leadership from her father, she practiced combat skills and founded Silver Sable International, a private security company.\n\n"I have a proposition to make. A business proposition. I'd like to add you--to the payroll of Silver Sable International!"

She is known as Agent 19, a level 6 agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. who participated in numerous operations. What's deadlier than her iron baton is her sharp tongue that knows no rest.\n\n"Avengers Assemble! As in get your butts up and let's go!"

This cocky rich boy is one of the best friends of Peter Parker. Just because he shares a name with his father doesn't necessarily mean that he's a villain.\n\n"My father! I loved that man, and respected him- but he was a criminal and a murderer!"

He is the CEO of a megacorporation called Oscorp, whose influence can reshape the very society of the United States. He wields power that can destroy common folks like Peter Parker with a breeze.\n\n"Fool! Your power is nothing compared to mine! Your strength is nothing, your intellect is NOTHING!"

Killing Spider-Man's lover, he is the archenemy of Spider-Man and tragedy incarnate.\n\n"What did I do? Oh, nothing much... I kidnapped his girlfriend. And killed her. Right in front of him. It was a blast!"

He turned into a mad scientist when he accidentally damaged his central nerve system during a precarious experiment. It is truly an irony that Spider-Man shares so many qualities with one of his archenemies. As the two understand each other well, they tend to cross paths often.\n\n"Peace for Octopus is at hand. All I require to achieve it is- the death of Spider-Man!"
He used to be a doctor who lost right arm, until the lizard serum he created granted him a new arm. But it gave more than what he bargained for...\n\n"Don't you just love the scientific method?"

Armed with a powerful whipping tail, sharp hook-like claws, thick hide, and razor teeth, he's now a reptilian villain. Still, he's more conscientious and intelligent than most villains.\n\n"I have done terrible, unspeakable things. I have done the worst thing a man can do."

The editor-in-chief at the Daily Bugle who hates Spider-Man. If you want to work at the Daily Bugle, you better learn how to polish his apple. Or else, ready yourself to hear him coming:\n\n"You're Fired!"
It's Spider-Man. But he's not Peter Parker. ...Then who is this Spider-Man?\n\n"There has to be a Spider-Man out there. I'm just not sure which of us it should be!"
A life as a clone of a particular person took an unexpected turn and stripped the Scarlet Spider of his memories.\n\n"No. Ben is gone. And where you were...there is only a Chasm."

He is a genius, billionaire, and philanthropist, one of the most brilliant scientist known to mankind, and an unmatched public persona. Some might even consider him a villain.\n\n"I'm tired of being a hero. I want to relax and have some fun."
I am a pioneer. I am an inventor. I give freedom to the world.\n\n"I am Iron Man."

James Rhodes is a soldier of the United States who is loyal to his country. He became one of the most devastating weapons of his nation, thanks to his superpower: being Tony Stark's best friend.\n\n"Okay, Tony. Let's see what this new toy of yours can do..."

As its name suggests, War Machine is an effective "mode of communication" protecting the United States.\n\n"He doesn't want to talk with James Rhodes- fine. He'll just have to take a meeting- with War Machine!"

At first, she was a vain woman who fantasized about becoming Tony Stark's wife, but she is now Tony Stark's most capable hand, responsible for sorting out any mess caused by her boss. Rescue can be described in three words: "female Iron Man." But she actually has a critical difference from her counterpart. Instead of taking down the hostile, she rescues people.\n\n"If I can't save you, then I have to save the world from what you've become."

The ultimate weapon built by Tony Stark to suppress Hulk. Unfortunately, this machine was never able to execute its purpose. It is infamous for wrecking havoc in the perimeter while fighting Hulk.\n\n"Everybody, Stand Down!"
One of the smartest girls in the world who got accepted to MIT at the age of 15.\n\n"Those who move with courage... make the path for those who live with fear."
She stays true to her own word to become the next Tony Stark.\n\n"I'm totally going to be Tony Stark. Except for that weird facial hair."

As the father of Tony Stark, he disciplined his prodigy son so that Tony wouldn't turn out to be cocky. Whether his discipline worked or not is up for discussion.\n\n"Son, your school tests may prove you're a genius, but you act like an idiot!"
A capable butler who has aided the Avengers multiple times. His ginger cake is delicious.\n\n"My association with the Avengers is far more than a job. It's more of a duty of friendship and loyalty."

A friend of Tony and his chauffeur, he earned his nickname Happy as an oxymoron to his depressed face on the ring when he was a boxer.\n\n"This is my overjoyed expression! You should see me when I'm really unhappy."
He is Tony's savior and a crucial contributor to the birth of Iron Man.\n\n"So you're a man who has everything.. and nothing"

One of the most important figures in Tony Stark's life, as she was able to keep him from a dangerous, addictive path.\n\n"Can't you see you're becoming your own worst enemy? And you're trying to kill that enemy with a bottle.."
A ruthless businessman who does anything to win. There is no play that is too below the belt.\n\n"It will give me much pleasure to checkmate such a resourceful opponent."

The villain of Iron Man who tried to steal from Tony and kill him with his own invention.\n\n"How ironic, Tony! Trying to rid the world of weapons, you gave it its best one ever! And now, I'm going to kill you with it!"

He's one of the many villains who tried to steal from Tony. He got an incurable disease and was waiting for the final moment in space, when he was frozen alive by Iron Man. He is still floating in the space to this day.\n\n"Why not simply let me die?"

The archenemy of Iron Man who wields terrifying whips. He is a henchman of Maggia, and he infiltrated Stark International once, only to be found by Iron Man.\n\n"I've smelled your blood now an you're never gonna outrun my whip!"
His secret to smashing Hydra since the World War II is ingesting lots of Infinity Formula that prevented him from aging.\n\n"No Hydra Agent's gonna score while Nick Fury's breathin'!"
While he couldn't live his childhood dream of becoming a super hero himself, he is aiding them from backstage.\n\n"I love working with telepaths."

She's the spitting image of her aunt Peggy Carter. So much so that Captain America mistook her for Peggy.\n\n"Aunt Peggy's memory is like the lost and found. It makes me miss her when she's smiling right at me."

She's a member of S.H.I.E.L.D., but she doesn't get along well with the heroes.\n\n"Attention all personnel! This is Director Hill! Effective immediately Agent Natasha Romanoff, codename Black Widow- is to be considered an enemy of S.H.I.E.L.D.! She is to be stopped at any cost!"
It is wise not to anger her unless one wants the building to collapse over.\n\n"The Avengers!! Bring them to me! Or I will bring this entire building down on you!"
Once the best agent of the former Soviet Union, she is now freed from brainwashing and works for S.H.I.E.L.D. instead in the USA.\n\n"The money we can recover.. but the Russian earth loves blood."
The best archer in the world. He can make anyone a pincushion without hesitation. Does he ever miss his target?\n\n"Funny... I never miss anything."

She used to be a super spy of the former Soviet Union on par with Natasha Romanoff. When she got herself free from the Red Room, she became White Widow who helps other female spies to escape their grim fate.\n\n"There is always an escape route."

When he learned that S.H.I.E.L.D., wanted to take over Stark Industries, he did nothing but drinking. That is, until Bethany Cabe came to rescue him.\n\n"Thanks for showing me how hard it is... for forcing me to realize alcohol is my problem."

A genius athlete who has inhumane muscle memory. The only problem is that he often uses his abilities for acts of crime.\n\n"I thought if I remembered your moves, I might remember you. But all your moves... are somebody else's. Just like mine."
The most dangerous person in the world as his immense intellect masks an even more vicious rage.\n\n"Hulk Smashes, Banner Builds."
While not as strong as that of Black Bolt, her voice is still very powerful, making her an incredible member of the Thunderbolts.\n\n"I create constructs out of solid sound."

Even though Thanos killed her husband, she remains loyal as Thanos' most powerful warrior.\n\n"In the name of death! In the name of sorrow! In the name of chaos and war! In the name of Thanos! HUNT AND KILL!"

The leader of the Black Order, he is the destroyer of all.

"When he fell in love with Lady Midnight, It was I he sought for guidance. Even though I was in love with her also."

Behind his ordinary appearance lies an unstoppable rage.\n\n"When Hulk smashes something, it stays smashed!"

A big enforcer who keeps Las Vegas, the vice city, free.\n\n"You know who you're messin' with? I'm the Hulk, you hear me? The Hulk! The worst Hulk of 'em all!"

As the Earth is devastated by nuclear war,

Hurt by his father as a child, he repeats those sins against his own son.\n\n"Hello there, son."

Bruce Banner's mother, who tried to protect him with love.\n\n"Run, baby!"
The other hidden daughter born between Thundra and the Hulk, whose genes were stolen.\n\n"I wasn't hiding. I was fighting to save my planet."
