When Doom is nearly defeated, a flash of blinding light washes through the throne room of Castle Doom, disorienting Doom and the Fantastic Four alike.

The Fantastic Four confront Doctor Doom and demand that the tin-plated tyrant reveal whatever scientific scheme he has cooked up this time. Doom refuses to reveal his plans, attacking his esteemed guests instead.
When Doom is nearly defeated, a flash of blinding light washes through the throne room of Castle Doom, disorienting Doom and the Fantastic Four alike. Wait... hasn't this happened before...?

The Fantastic Four confront Doctor Doom... but Reed Richards manages to briefly stop time to run some calculations, discovering that the Dimensional Rift that has plagued this reality for so long is beginning to expand, warping the very fabric of time and space.

Reed decides he and his fellow members of the Fantastic Four will have to leave Latveria and shift their efforts to reconstructing the long-lost Convergence Device that once seemed the only hope to ending the threat to this dimension and all others.
Upon returning to the Baxter Building, Reed Richards splits the team up, sending each member of his fantastic family to different locations in order to secure components for the Convergence Device.

Reed travels to Attilan, where he intends to ask King Black Bolt for critical parts needed to develop a new Convergence Device. However, when he arrives, Reed is surprised to find the Inhuman city in disarray.

Mister Fantastic soon encounters Crystal, part of the Inhuman Royal Family and a former member of the Fantastic Four. She informs him that Black Bolt has once again been taken captive by his brother, Maximus.
Before they can manage to locate Maximus, Reed and Crystal are unexpectedly attacked by an Inhuman army devoted to serving their new, corrupt king.

Once the Inhuman army is defeated, Crystal leads Mister Fantastic through Attilan to the royal palace. Maximus has always sought the throne, so now that he has it, it's unlikely that he'd stray far from it.
Reed and Crystal arrive in the throne room and confront Maximus. As expected, the mad prince is not about to relinquish his newfound power without a fight.
Once Maximus is defeated, Reed and Crystal release Black Bolt from captivity. Mister Fantastic's noble efforts have managed to secure the gratitude and the assistance of the true Inhuman ruler.
Sue Richards has been sent to infiltrate a Hydra factory to obtain a part for the Convergence Device. Too bad the Red Skull happens to be on-hand at the factory for a routine inspection!

Even with the spectacular stealth of her invisibility powers, Sue knows this isn't a one-woman job. So she calls in another former member of the FF with plenty of history sneaking into tight spaces: the Astonishing Ant-Man.

The Invisible Woman and Ant-Man manage to sneak past the first wave of Hydra guards with ease and get into the factory. Unfortunately, Ant-Man gets a bit overconfident and accidentally triggers an alarm system.
As the alarm blares, Hydra Soldiers rush towards Ant-Man and the Invisible Woman. This isn't a battle they can hide from any longer, so they'll have to face the forces of Hydra head-on!

With the Hydra troops defeated, Sue and Scott get back to their original mission: locating the component for the Convergence Device. Together, they scour the factory for clues as to where it is being stored.

When the heroes arrive at the component's location, the Red Skull is waiting for them. His minions may have failed, but now this fearsome fascist is eager to show his foes the true power of Hydra firsthand!

The Red Skull is down for the count... but history shows that he never stays down for long. The Invisible Woman and Ant-Man take advantage of their momentary victory to escape the Hydra factory with the critical component in hand.

The Human Torch has been sent to obtain a specialized component for the Convergence Device, and there's only one company that makes it: Oscorp. Johnny decides to bring in an expert on all things Osborn, his best pal, Spider-Man.

The duo defeat the Oscorp guards and decide to go back to something a bit more traditional: raiding Oscorp HQ for the component and destroying anything that looks like it could be used against them as a weapon.
Johnny and Spidey reach the Oscorp R&D Lab, where Norman Osborn is holding the component they need.
He is not amused by the damage the heroes have caused to his company. Norman unexpectedly dons his Iron Patriot armor and attack

As the battle ends, the heroes recover the component. But Norman Osborn isn't about to accept defeat. The humiliation he just endured pushes him over the edge, causing him to lose his grip on reality and become the Green Goblin!
Not eager to go another round with a psychotic super-villain, Spidey and the Human Torch race to escape from Oscorp HQ... with the Green Goblin hot on their trail!

The Convergence Device will require a massive power source... and there aren’t many things more powerful than gamma energy. Reed tasks the Thing with procuring an experimental gamma generator from his colleague Bruce Banner.

Ben locates Bruce Banner at an abandoned lab out in the American Southwest. After a brief discussion, it's clear that Bruce isn't willing to hand over the generator, even with the fate of the universe at stake.
Luckily, the Thing didn't come alone. She-Hulk steps into the fray and tries to talk some sense into her green-skinned cousin. For a moment, it looks like cooler heads might prevail.

Just when it looks like the Hulk might be willing to listen to reason, the Thing says something that sends the jade giant into another rage. Ben and Jen have to resort to less cerebral methods to get what they need. In other words, It's Clobberin' Time!

Together, the Thing and She-Hulk manage to end the Hulk's rampage. As the Hulk changes back into Bruce Banner, he apologizes for the misunderstanding and offers the generator to the Thing. Too bad it's been damaged in battle!
After the necessary repairs are complete, Ben departs with the gamma generator, leaving Jen behind to help her cousin Bruce recover from the damage his monstrous alter ego caused.

Unbeknownst to their family, Franklin and Valeria Richards secretly snuck onto the Fantasti-Car and accompanied their family to Latveria. Now that their parents have hastily departed, the kids have been left behind in Castle Doom!

Doctor Doom muses that he used science and sorcery to manipulate Reed Richards into rebuilding the Convergence Device. But he is not alone. A Doom from the distant future is there, and claims to be the true mastermind behind the plan.
Franklin and Valeria have heard every word that the two metallic monarchs have uttered. Unfortunately, the Dooms aren't the only ones whose conversation may have been overheard...
Before Franklin and Valeria can send a signal to their family, the duo of Dooms discover the children and take them captive.

Meanwhile, back in Latveria, Franklin and Valeria Richards are being held captive in a high-tech cell. Luckily, Val is a genius when it comes to high-tech devices and knows how to bypass just about any security system.
Once Val disables the locks on the holding cell, she and Franklin attempt to make their escape. But it won't be easy. The halls of Castle Doom are patrolled by dangerous Doombots!
The two young heroes manage to fight off a horde of Doombots, providing them a much-needed boost of confidence as they continue to search for a way back home.

While looking for a way out of Castle Doom, Franklin and Val find their way Doom's secret lab. Franklin wants nothing more than to get out of this creepy place, but Val sees an opportunity to research what the Dooms are really up to.

Val finishes her research of Doom's files and discovers a startling truth. The device that their father is building might not save the future... it might actually end up destroying it! They need to get home and warn him!

As more Doombots arrive, Valeria manages to get an old teleportation device working, and the kids hastily jump through the portal, knowing that any place it sends them to is better than where they are now.
Franklin and Valeria Richards have escaped Castle Doom and have teleported right into the heart of NYC, not far from their home. Val is impressed by her accuracy under pressure.

Before they can head home, the Richards siblings see their Uncle Johnny and Spider-Man race by overhead... with the Green Goblin in hot pursuit! Franklin uses his reality warping powers to try to distract the Goblin.
The Green Goblin changes course and attacks Franklin and Val! They’ll have to defeat this cackling creep if they hope to make it safely home to the Baxter Building.
After defeating the maniacal Goblin, Franklin and Valeria leave Spider-Man to clean up the mess while they head to the Baxter Building.

Finally back home at the Baxter Building, Valeria and Franklin prepare to send an alert to the missing members of their family. But before they can, the Baxter Building's systems unexpectedly go offline...

Franklin and Val trace the power disruption to their father's lab... where they discover the superhuman spy known as the Ghost! Apparently, the villain saw the FF's absence as the perfect opportunity to steal their secrets!
With the Baxter Building's security systems turned off, the Ghost tries to hack into Reed Richards' secret files. But Franklin and Valeria aren't about to let that happen

The Richards siblings defeat the Ghost and put the villain in lockdown. As soon as the Baxter Building's systems are back online, a powerful cosmic energy signature is detected... and it's heading straight towards them!

Victorious arrives at the Baxter Building, intent on capturing Franklin and Valeria Richards at the behest of her master, Doctor Doom. But the champion of Latveria has no idea how prepared the young Richards' are for her arrival.
The Richards children turn all of the Baxter Building's defense systems against Victorious as they send out an urgent distress call to the members of their family.
Victorious soon realizes that she has been deceived by Franklin Richards' reality warping abilities. The children have led her into a containment room and have sealed the door shut behind her.
Summoning all of her cosmic might, Victorious manages to escape from containment and continues her hunt through the Baxter Building for the Richards children.

Finally locating Franklin and Valeria, Victorious attempts to subdue the children. But if these young heroes have learned anything from their fantastic family, it's that they don't surrender without a fight!
Despite putting up an impressive fight, Franklin and Val are defeated in combat. Victorious has no choice but to honor her master's wishes and return the Richards children to Latveria.

As Doom powers up the Convergence Device, the Fantastic Four get ready for the final battle. They aren't just fighting to save their family anymore, they're fighting to save countless futures as well!

Doom is defeated. After he frees Franklin and Val, Doom offers Reed the final piece needed to construct the Convergence Device. If Doom and Richards can work together, perhaps there is a chance to save every reality after all!
Back in Latveria, Franklin and Val are welcomed back by the modern day Doom and his futuristic counter part. They try to fight back, but are thrown into a new cell, this time with enhanced security.
Val can't hack the security system this time, but the kids convince Victorious that she is on the wrong side of the battle. Victorious opens the cell door.
Despite the noble actions of Victorious, Franklin and Val can’t take any more risks. They decide to remove Doom's champion from play, just to be safe.
Franklin and Valeria succeed in defeating Victorious, getting some welcome payback for their recent defeat at the Baxter Building. But their victory celebration won't last long...

The Richards children prove no match for Doom! The ruler of Latveria swiftly defeats Franklin and Valeria, sending them back into their cell before storming off to his throne room to deal with other matters...
Together, the modern Doom and the FF must join forces to defeat the time-traveling tyrant. It's an all-out battle between Dooms for the fate of the Multiverse!

Doom and the FF get the upper hand against Doom 3099, but it is Franklin and Val who save the day, powering up the Convergence Device and sending the dimension-hopping despot back to his future timeline for good.

Before Doom and Reed can power up the new Convergence device, Doom 3099 steps from the shadows and claims the device for himself. With it, he can stitch together countless realities in an effort to make sure that all futures are ruled by Doom!
